fields.title: Ekisenge Eky'omunda
fields.description: Ekisenge Eky'omunda kikulembera abasomi mu lugendo olw'omwoyo olw'amaanyi, nga kissa essira ku bukulu bw'okwesiga amagezi ga Katonda okusinga okutegeera kw'omuntu. Nga kiyita mu kunnyonnyola kw'Ebyawandiikibwa, kiraga nti okutegeera okw'amazima kuva mu mutima ogwetoowaza ogukulemberwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

fields.title: Essaawa ey'Enkya
fields.body_html:
"Ayi Mukama, buli nkya owulira eddoboozi lyange; buli nkya ndeeta gy'oli okusaba kwange, ne nnindirira onziremu." — Zabbuli 5:3.

"Mukama Ayinzabyonna ampadde olulimi oluyigirizibbwa, mmanye ebigambo ebigumya abo abakooye. Anzukusa buli nkya, buli nkya anzukusa okuwulira by'anjigiriza." — Isaaya 50:4.

Okuviira ddala mu mirembe egy'edda ennyo, abaweereza ba Katonda baalowoozanga ku makya ng'ekiseera ekigwanira okusinza Katonda. Ne kaakano Abakristaayo bonna bakitwala ng'obuvunaanyizibwa era ng'enkizo okuwaayo ekitundu ku ntandikwa y'olunaku okunoonya okussa ekimu ne Katonda. Abakristaayo bangi, naddala ekibiina Student's Christian Association, bakwata ekiseera ekiyitibwa Okukuuma okw'Enkya (The Morning Watch); ekibiina Y. P. C. E. kikiyita Essaawa ey'Emirembe (Quiet Hour); abalala bakiyita Essaawa Etewuubaala oba Ekiseera eky'Emirembe.

Bano bonna, ka babe balowooza ku ssaawa yonna, oba ekitundu ky'essaawa, oba ekitundu eky'okuna ky'essaawa, beegatta ne Muzabbuli mu ky'ayogera nti, "Ayi Mukama, buli nkya owulira eddoboozi lyange."

Ng'ayogera ku bukulu obungi obw'ekiseera kino eky'emirembe eky'okusaba n'okufumiitiriza ku Kigambo kya Katonda buli lunaku, Mukama Mott yagamba nti: "Oluvannyuma lw'okwaniriza Kristo ng'Omulokozi, n'okwesigira okubatizibwa kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, tetumanyi kikolwa kirala kireeta obulungi obungi gye tuli oba eri abalala okusinga okuteekawo omaliriro ogunywevu okukuuma essaawa ey'enkya, n'okumala ekitundu eky'olubereberye ky'essaawa ku ntandikwa y'olunaku wekka ne Katonda." Bw'osooka okukiwulira, ekigambo kino kirabika ng'ekigezizza ennyo. Ekikolwa eky'okwaniriza Kristo ng'Omulokozi kirina ebivaamu ebitakoma eby'emirembe n'emirembe, n'ekikolwa eky'okwesigira Omwoyo Omutukuvu kireeta enkyukakyuka enkulu mu bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo, olwo ekintu ekyangu bwe kityo ng'omaliriro ogunywevu ogw'okukuuma essaawa ey'enkya tekirabika nga kya bukulu bumala okuteekebwa okumpi nabyo.

Naye singa tulowooza ku ngeri gye kitasoboka okutuukiriza obulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku mu Kristo ng'Omulokozi waffe okuva mu kibi, oba okukuuma okutambula mu bulagirizi n'amaanyi ag'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, awatali kussa ekimu ne Katonda okumpi buli lunaku, tunaatera okulaba amazima g'ekigambo kino. Kubanga kitegeeza kyokka omaliriro ogunywevu nti Kristo anaabanga n'obulamu bwonna, era nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu buli kimu anaagonderwanga mu bujjuvu. Essaawa ey'enkya ye kisumuluzo eky'ekifo omuntu mw'ayinza okuweerayo obulamu bwe eri Kristo n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu awatali kukoowa era mu bujjuvu.

Okusobola okukitegeera, ka tusooke okulaba ekigendererwa ky'essaawa ey'enkya kye kisaanidde okuba. Essaawa ey'enkya teri kya kutwalibwa nga kigendererwa kyokka mu yo yennyini.

Tekimala nti etuwa ekiseera eky'omukisa eky'okusaba n'okusoma Baibuli, ne kiretera bwe kityo okuwummulamu n'okuyambibwa. Kigwanira okukola ng'ekkubo eritutuusa ku kigendererwa. Era ekigendererwa ekyo kwe kufuna okubeerawo kwa Kristo mu lunaku lwonna. Okwewaayo eri mukwano gwaffe oba eri ekintu kye tunoonya kitegeeza nti mukwano oyo oba ekintu ekyo binaabeeranga ne bikuumira ekifo kyabyo mu mutima, ne bwe tuba tukola ebintu ebirala ebijjula obuulamu bwaffe. Okwewaayo eri Yesu kitegeeza nti tetuganya kintu na kimu kutwawukanya naye ne kaseera kamu.

Okubeera mu ye n'okwagala kwe, okukuumibwa ye n'ekisa kye, okukola by'ayagala n'okumusanyusa — kino tekiyinza kubeera kya luusi eri oyo eyeewaddeyo ddala eri ye. "Nkwetaaga buli ssaawa," "Buli kaseera nkuumibwa mu kwagala kwe." Ennyimba zino ze bigambo eby'obulamu n'amazima. "Mu linnya lyo banaasanyukiranga olunaku lwonna," "Nze Mukama ndigikuuma; buli kaseera ndigifukirira." Bino bye bigambo eby'amaanyi aga Katonda. Omukkiriza tayinza kwesimba na kaseera kamu awatali Kristo. Okwewaayo eri ye tekukkiriza kumatira na kintu kitono okusinga okubeera bulijjo mu kwagala kwe ne mu kwagala kwe. Ekitasukka ekyo si bwe bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo obwa nnamaddala obw'omu Byawandiikibwa. Obukulu n'omukisa n'ekigendererwa ekituufu eky'essaawa ey'enkya tebiyinza kulabika okuggyako ng'ekigendererwa kyayo ekisooka.

Ekigendererwa kye tunoonya gye kyeyongera okutegeerekeka bulungi, gye tweyongera okusobola okukozesa amakubo agatuutuusa ku ky'okukituukako. Kaakano lowooza ku ssaawa ey'enkya ng'ekkubo eritutuusa ku kigendererwa kino ekikulu: Njagala okufuna ddala okubeerawo kwa Kristo mu lunaku lwonna, obutakola kintu kyonna ekiyinza okukiziyiza. Ntegeera amangu nti okusobola kwange mu lunaku kunaava ku bukalimu n'amaanyi ag'okukkiriza okunoonya, okuzuula, n'okukwata Ye mu kisenge eky'omunda. Okufumiitiriza, okusaba, n'ekigambo byonna binaakozesebwa ng'ebiyamba ku kino: akakwate ak'olunaku wakati wa Kristo nange kagwanidde okuzzibwa obuggya n'okunywezebwa mu ssaawa ey'enkya. Okusooka, kiyinza okulabika ng'okulowooza ku lunaku lwonna, awamu n'ebiraliikirivu byalwo byonna ebiyinzika, n'ebisanyusa, n'okukemebwa, biyinza okutabula okuwummula kwe nfuna mu kwewaayo kwange okw'emirembe. Kiyinza okubaawo; naye tekijja kuba kufiirwa.

Eddiini ey'amazima egendereza okubumba engeri ya Kristo mu ffe okutuusa ne mu bikolwa byaffe ebya bulijjo, endowooza ye n'engeri ye bwe binaayolesebwanga. Omwoyo n'okwagala kwa Kristo bigenderezebwa okututwala olwo mu bumu bwaffe n'abantu, mu kuwummula kwaffe, mu mirimu gyaffe, kifuuke ng'obuzaale bwaffe okukola ng'ebyo bwe biri. Bino byonna bisobola okubaawo, kubanga Kristo yennyini, ng'Omulamu, abeera mu ffe. Toteganyizibwanga singa okusooka ekigendererwa kirabika nga kya waggulu ennyo oba nga kizibu, era nga kitwala ekiseera kingi mu ssaawa ey'okusaba mu kyama. Ekiseera ky'okiwa kijja kusasulwa n'obugagga. Ojja kuddayo mu kusaba ne mu Byawandiikibwa n'ekigendererwa ekiggya n'okukkiriza okuggya.

Nga essaawa ey'enkya bw'etandika okukola ku lunaku, olunaku lujja kuddamu okukwata ku kitundu kyayo eky'olubereberye, era okussa ekimu ne Kristo kunaabanga n'amakulu amaggya n'amaanyi amaggya. Naddala kunaabanga n'obuyinza ku mwoyo gw'okuumamu essaawa ey'enkya.

Nga obukulu obw'ekigendererwa — okussa ekimu ne Katonda mu Kristo okutakutuka mu lunaku lwonna — n'obutonde obw'amazima obw'ekkubo eritukituusaako — okusisinkana Kristo mu bujjuvu era mu kutegeera n'okufuna okubeerawo kwe mu lunaku — bwe bitutwala, kirabika nti ekintu kimu ekyetaagisa kwe kuba n'ekigendererwa eky'omutima gwonna: omaliriro ogunywevu, ka gube guyinza okutwala kutegana kutya oba okwefiiriza kutya, okuwangula ekirabo. Mu kuyiga oba mu ku kibuga ky'emizannyo, buli muyizi amanyi obwetaavu obw'okwagala okw'amaanyi n'omaliriro ogunywevu bwe tuba tulina okuwangula.

Eddiini yeetaaga, era ddala esaanira, si kutono naye okusingawo okw'okwewaayo okw'omutima gwonna. Singa waliwo ekyetaaga omutima gwonna, mazima ddala kwe kwagala kwa Kristo. Guno omaliriro ogunywevu okusooka byonna okufuna okubeerawo kwa Kristo gwe gunaawangulanga buli kukemebwa okuba abatali beesigwa oba abakwata ku ngulu mu kukuuma endagaano zaffe. Guno gwe mwoyo gufuula essaawa ey'enkya yennyini ekkubo ery'amaanyi ery'ekisa mu kunyweza engeri, n'okutuwa amaanyi okugamba nti Nedda eri buli kuyita okwokwewombeeka. Guno gwe mwoyo gunaatusobozesa amangu, bwe tuyingira mu kisenge eky'omunda ne tuggalawo oluggi, okubeera eyo n'omutima gwaffe gwonna, nga tweteeseteese amangu okussa ekimu ne Kristo. Era guno gwe mwoyo, okuva mu ssaawa ey'enkya, gunaafuuka ekigambo ekikulu eky'obulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku.

Mu nsi, kya bulijjo okugambibwa nti: Ebintu ebikulu bisoboka eri omuntu yenna amanyi ky'ayagala, era n'akyagala n'omutima gwe gwonna.

Omuyizi eyafuula okwewaayo eri Kristo ekigambo kye ekikulu, ajja kuzuula essaawa ey'enkya ng'ekifo obulabufu bwe mu kuyitibwa kwe okutukuvu mwe buzzibwa obuggya buli lunaku; omulundi ye gw'anyweza okutambula nga bwe kigwanira; n'okukkiriza kwe okuweebwa empeera olw'okubeerawo kwa Kristo alindirira okumusisinkana, n'okumulabirira mu lunaku. Tuli bawanguzi n'okusukka mu oyo eyatwagala. Kristo omulamu alindirira okutusisinkana.

fields.title: Oluggi Nga Luggaddwa — Wekka ne Katonda
fields.body_html:
"Naye ggwe bw'obanga osaba, oyingiranga mu nnyumba yo, ne weggalira mu kisenge kyo n'osabira eyo mu kyama. Kitaawo ategeera ebyama byo byonna alikuwa by'omusabye." — Matayo 6:6.

Omuntu yatondebwa lwa kussa ekimu ne Katonda. Katonda yamukola mu kifaananyi kye n'okufaanana kwe, alyoke asaanire kino, asobole okutegeera n'okusanyukira Katonda, okuyingira mu kwagala kwe, n'okwesiimira ekitiibwa kye. Kubanga Katonda ye oyo ali buli wamu era ayita mu byonna, omuntu yandiyinzizza okubeera mu kwesiima okw'okussa ekimu okutakutuka wakati mu mulimu gwonna gwe yandikoze.

Ekibi kyatunyaga okussa ekimu ne ye.

Tewali kirala wabula okussa ekimu kuno okuyinza okumatiza omutima gw'omuntu oba ogwa Katonda. Kino kye Kristo kye yajja okuzzaawo; okukomyawo eri Katonda ekitonde kye ekyabula, n'okukomyawo omuntu ku byonna bye yatondebwa. Okuba omu ne Katonda kwe kutuukiririra kw'omukisa gwonna ku nsi nga bwe kiri mu ggulu. Kujja ng'ekisuubizo, ekyaweebwa emirundi mingi, bwe kifuuka okumanyibwa okujjuvu: "Sirikuleka wadde okukwabulira," era bwe tusobola okugamba nti: Kitange abeera nange bulijjo, okuba omu ne Katonda kuno kugenderezebwa kubeera kwaffe olunaku lwonna, ka tube tuli mu mbeera ki oba mu mbeera ki ezitwetoolodde. Naye okwesiima kwakwo kuyima ku mazima ag'okuba omu mu kisenge eky'omunda. Amaanyi ag'okukuuma okussa ekimu okumpi era okujjudde essanyu ne Katonda olunaku lwonna ganaava ddala ku bunene bwe tunoonyeza okukufuna mu ssaawa ey'okusaba mu kyama. Ekintu kimu ekyetaagisa mu Okukuuma okw'Enkya oba mu Ssaawa ey'Emirembe kwe — Okussa ekimu ne Katonda. Kino Mukama waffe ky'atuyigiriza okuba ekyama eky'omunda eky'okusaba mu kyama: "Weggalire oluggi n'osabira eyo Kitaawo ali mu kyama." Matayo 6:6.

Ekintu ekisooka era ekikulu kwe kulaba nti eyo mu kyama olina okubeerawo kwa Kitaawo n'obwongefu bwe. Manya nti akulaba era akuwulira. Ekisinga obukulu okusinga okusaba kwo kwonna, ka kube kwa maanyi kutya, ekisinga obukulu okusinga obunyiikivu bwo bwonna n'okufuba kwo okusaba obulungi, kwe kintu kino kimu — okukakasibwa okulamu okuli ng'okw'omwana nti Kitaawo akulaba, nti kaakano omusisinkanye, era nti n'eriiso lye ku ggwe n'eriyo ku ye, kaakano osanyukira okuba omu ne ye okwennyini.

Ggwe Mukristaayo, waliwo akabi akabi ennyo k'ozze okumpi nako mu kisenge kyo eky'omunda. Oli mu kabi ak'okuwaanyisaamu Okusaba n'Okusoma Baibuli mu kifo ky'okussa ekimu okulamu ne Katonda, okuwaanyiziganya okulamu okw'okumuwa okwagala kwo, omutima gwo, n'obulamu bwo, n'okufuna okuva mu ye okwagala kwe, obulamu bwe, n'omwoyo gwe.

Obwetaavu bwo n'okubwoleka, awamu n'okwegomba kwo okusaba mu bwetoowaze n'obunyiikivu n'okukkiriza, biyinza okukutwala nnyo, ekitangaala eky'obwenyi bwe n'essanyu ery'okwagala kwe ne bitasobola kukuyingiramu.

Okusoma kwo Baibuli kuyinza okukusanyusa ennyo, ne kuzuukusa endowooza ey'eddiini esanyusa, olwo ekigambo kya Katonda kyennyini ne kiyinza okufuuka ekiwaanyisibbwa mu kifo kya Katonda yennyini, olwo ekisinga okuziyiza okussa ekimu kubanga kikwatiddwa emmeeme mu kifo ky'okugitwala eri Katonda yennyini. Ne tuzza mu mirimu gy'olunaku awatali maanyi ag'okussa ekimu okubeerera, kubanga mu kusaba kwaffe okw'enkya omukisa tegwafunibwa. Enjawulo ki gye kyandireese mu bulamu bwa bangi singa buli kimu mu kisenge kyali kikwatibwa ku kintu kino kimu: Njagala okutambula ne Katonda mu lunaku lwonna; essaawa yange ey'enkya ye kiseera Kitange w'ayingira mu ndagaano entuufu nange, nange naye, nti bwe kiri bwe kityo. Amaanyi ki agandeeteddwa okumanya nti: Katonda antutte, agenda nange yennyini; ŋŋenda kukola by'ayagala mu maanyi ge olunaku lwonna; nneeteeseteese okwaniriza byonna ebiyinza okujja! Weewaawo, ekitiibwa ki ekyandiyingidde mu bulamu singa okusaba mu kyama tekwabadde kusaba busaba kya kufuna kutegeera kuggya kwa mirembe, kitangaala, oba maanyi, wabula okuwaayo obulamu olunaku lumu lwokka mu kukuumibwa okw'amazima era okw'obukuumi bwa Katonda ow'amaanyi era omwesigwa!

"Sabira eyo Kitaawo ali mu kyama. Kitaawo ategeera ebyama byo byonna alikuwa by'omusabye." Awali okussa ekimu okw'ekyama ne Kitaawo mu mwoyo ne mu mazima gye kukuumibwa, obulamu obwa lwatu mu maaso g'abantu bunaaleeta empeera.

Kitaawo alaba mu kyama atwala obuvunaanyizibwa era awa empeera mu lwatu. Okwawukana ku bantu, mu kutebba ne Katonda, y'engeri entuufu era yokka ey'okubeeramu omu n'abantu mu maanyi ag'omukisa gwa Katonda.

fields.title: Oluggi Nga Luggule — Empeera ey'Olwatu
fields.body_html:
"Naye ggwe bw'osiibanga olongoosanga enviiri zo n'onaaba ne mu maaso, abantu baleme kutegeera nti osiiba, okuggyako Kitaawo ali mu ggulu era alaba mu kyama alikuwa empeera." — Matayo 6:17-18.

"Awo ab'Olukiiko bwe baalaba obuvumu bwa Peetero ne Yokaana, ate n'okutegeera ne bategeera nga tebaasoma, era nga si batendeke, ne beewuunya nnyo, ne bategeera ng'abasajja abo baabeeranga ne Yesu." — Ebikolwa by'Abatume 4:13.

"Musa bwe yaserengeta okuva ku lusozi Sinaayi ng'akutte mu ngalo ze ebipande byombi eby'Endagaano, teyakimanya ng'obwenyi bwe bwali bumasamasa kubanga yali ayogedde ne Mukama. Era Alooni n'abaana ba Isirayiri bonna bwe baatunula ku Musa, ne balaba ng'obwenyi bwe bumasamasa; ne batya okumusemberera. Naye Musa n'abayita; bw'atyo Alooni n'abakulembeze b'abantu ne bajja gy'ali, Musa n'ayogera nabo. Oluvannyuma abaana ba Isirayiri bonna ne basembera, n'abategeeza amateeka gonna Mukama ge yamulagira ku lusozi Sinaayi. Awo Musa bwe yamala okwogera nabo, n'abikka obwenyi bwe olugoye." — Okuva 34:29-33.

Okuva mu kussa ekimu ne Katonda mu ssaawa ey'enkya okudda mu kuba omu ne bannaffe abantu emirundi mingi kizibu. Bwe tuba tusisinkanye Katonda, twagala okukuuma okuwulira okubeerawo kwe, n'okwewaayo kwaffe eri ye. Tugenda ku mmeeza ey'eky'enkya, gye kiyinza okuba nga mu kifuba ky'amaka gaffe gennyini, embeera amangu ago n'ekyuka, era ng'okubeerawo kw'abantu n'ebirabika bwe bikakata, ne tutandika okufiirwa ekyo kye twali tuzudde. Abakristaayo abato bangi baawubira mu kibuuzo eky'engeri gye bandikuumye omutima gwabwe nga gujjudde ekyo kye batawulira nga bawereddwa oba abatafuna mukisa okwogerako. Ne mu bibinja eby'eddiini, si bulijjo kyangu okuba n'okussa ekimu okwa ddembe, olw'okubulwa obunyiikivu oba obuvumu, ku ekyo ekyandireese amagoba amasukkulumu n'essanyu. Ka tufubireko okuyiga engeri okuba omu kwaffe n'abantu gye kuyinza okubeera, mu kifo ky'okuziyiza, ekiyamba mu kukuuma obulamu obw'okussa ekimu okutakoma ne Katonda.

Amasomo obulambika bwa Musa n'olugoye ku bwenyi bwe ge gatuyigiriza gajjudde okulaga ebintu bingi. Okussa ekimu okumpi era okutakoma ne Katonda mu bbanga erituufu kunaaleka akabonero era kwelaga mu maaso g'abantu. Musa teyakimanya ng'obwenyi bwe bwamasamasa: ekitangaala kya Katonda ekyakira okuva mu ffe kinaaba ekitali kya kutegeera; kinaayongera bwokka okulaba nti tuli kibumbe kya bbumba (1 Abakkolinso 2:3, 4 ne 2 Abakkolinso 4). Okuwulira okubeerawo kwa Katonda mu muntu emirundi mingi kuyinza okuleetera abalala okutya, oba wadde okutabeera bulungi mu maaso ge. Abalala bwe balaba ekirabika mu ye, omukkiriza ow'amazima anaamanya obwo kye kitegeeza okubikka obwenyi bwe, n'akakasa mu bwetoowaze n'okwagala nti mazima ye muntu alina emmeeme efaanana n'eya abo abamwetoolodde.

Naye, wakati mu byonna, wanaabaawo obukakafu nti ye muntu wa Katonda, abeera mu, era alina enkolagana n'ensi etalabika.

Amasomo gaago gennyini gatuyigirizibwa Mukama waffe kw'ayogera ku kusiiba.

Toweeraga mu kusiiba kwo, olemenga okulabikira abantu ng'osiiba; basisinkane mu ssanyu n'ekisa eky'obuwombeefu bwa Katonda, ng'omwana wa Kitaffe omwagalwa era ayagala. Weesige Katonda, akulabye mu kyama, akuwe empeera mu lwatu, akuwe ekisa mu kuba omu n'abantu, akuume okussa ekimu kwo ne ye, era abamanyise nti ekisa kye n'ekitangaala kye biri ku ggwe.

Olugero lwa Peetero ne Yokaana lukakasa amazima gaago gennyini: baali babadde ne Yesu si bwe yali ku nsi kwokka, naye ne bwe yayingira mu ggulu, era baafuna omwoyo gwe. Baayolesa bwokka ekyo omwoyo gwa Kristo kye gwabayigiriza; wadde abalabe baabwe baayinza okulaba mu buvumu bwabwe nti baali babadde ne Yesu.

Omukisa ogw'okuba omu ne Katonda guyinza mangu okufiirwa olw'okuyingira nnyo mu kuba omu n'abantu. Omwoyo ogw'ekisenge eky'omunda gulina okutwalibwa mu kwekengera okutukuvu mu lunaku lwonna. Tetumanyi ssaawa omulabe gy'ayinza okujjira. Okugumira kuno okw'okukuuma okw'enkya kuyinza okukuumibwa mu kwefuga okw'emirembe, mu butawa ddembe eri obuzaale.

Mu kifuba ky'amaka ag'eddiini, emirundi mingi kunoonyezebwa obuyambi, buli omu ng'addamu ekyawandiikibwa ku mmeeza ey'eky'enkya ku nsonga eyategekebwa, ne kireeta omukisa omwangu ogw'emboozi ey'eddiini. Ekiseera okuwulira okubeerera okw'okubeerawo kwa Katonda n'okw'okuba omu ne ye — "Beeranga mu kutya Mukama olunaku lwonna" — bwe kufuuka ekigendererwa ky'essaawa ey'enkya, n'obwetoowaze obusinga obungi n'okuba omu okw'okwagala okusinga n'abo abatwetoolodde, ekisa kinaabanga kinoonyeddwa era kizuuliddwa okuyingira mu mirimu gy'olunaku n'okussa ekimu okutakutuse. Kintu kikulu okuyingira mu kisenge eky'omunda, okuggalawo oluggi, n'okusisinkana Kitaffe mu kyama. Kintu kisinga obukulu okuggulawo oluggi nate, n'okufuluma, mu kwesiima okubeerawo kuli okutayinza kutabulwa kintu kyonna.

Eri abamu, obulamu ng'obwo tebulabika bwetaagisa; okunywerera kuli kungi nnyo; omuntu ayinza okuba Omukristaayo omulungi awatali bwo. Naye eri abo abanoonya okuba abantu ab'ekintu kimu, abawulira nti bwe baba ba mazima era ab'amaanyi okukwatako ku kkanisa n'ensi ebeetoolodde balina okujjula Katonda n'Okubeerawo kwe, buli kimu kinaawa ekifo eri ekibuuzo ekimu: Engeri y'okutwalira mu kibumbe eky'ebbumba obugagga obw'omu ggulu, amaanyi ga Kristo agatuwummulako olunaku lwonna.

fields.title: Musa n'Ekigambo kya Katonda
fields.body_html:
Ku bikwata ku nkolagana wakati w'okusaba n'ekigambo mu kusinza kwaffe okw'ekyama, ebigambo by'omuntu eyakyuka okuva mu bakaafiri byawandiikibwa emirundi mingi nti: Nsaba, njogera ne Katonda; nsoma mu Baibuli, ne Katonda n'ayogera nange. Waliwo olunyiriri mu byafaayo bya Musa, endowooza eno mw'eyolekera bulungi. Tusoma mu Kubala 7:89 nti, "Awo Musa bwe yayingira mu Weema ey'Okukuŋŋaanirangamu okwogera ne Mukama, n'awulira eddoboozi nga lyogera gy'ali nga liva wakati wa bakerubbi ababiri abali waggulu w'entebe ey'okusaasira eri ku Ssanduuko ey'Endagaano. Bw'atyo Mukama bwe yayogera naye." Bwe yayingira okwesabira yekka oba okusabira abantu be, n'okulindirira ebiragiro, yasanga waliwo eyali amulindiridde. Nga kino kye kiyigiriza ekikulu ku ssaawa yaffe ey'oku makya!

Omwoyo ogusaba gwe mwoyo Katonda gw'anaayogeranga nagwo. Omwoyo ogusaba gunaabeeranga mwoyo ogutega amatu, nga gulindirira okuwulira Katonda ky'ayogera. Mu bumu ne Katonda, okubeerawo kwe n'omugabo gw'atambula biteekwa okuba eby'amazima nga bwe ntyo nze bwe ndi. Twagala okubuuza ekyetaagisa, ekigambo kya Katonda kye tusoma n'okusaba kwaffe bilyoke bibeere enkolagana ya mazima ne Katonda.

Ekisooka, yingira mu kifo ekituufu. “Musa yayingira mu Weema okwogera ne Katonda.”

Yeeyawula ku bantu, n'agenda gy'ayinza okubeerera awamu ne Katonda yekka. Yagenda mu kifo Katonda gy'ali okulabika. Yesu yatubuulira ekifo ekyo gye kiri. Atuyita okuyingira mu kasenge kaffe, ne tuggalawo oluggi, ne tusaba Kitaffe alaba mu kyama.

Wonna we tuli awamu ne Katonda yekka mu mazima, wayinza okubeera gye tuli ekyama ky'okubeerawo kwe. Okwogera ne Katonda kwetaaga okwawukana ku birala byonna. Kwetaaga omutima ogumalirivu era ogusuubira n'essuubi lyonna okusisinkana Katonda yennyini, n'okukolagana naye butereevu. Abo abagenda eyo okwogera ne Katonda banaawuliranga Eddoboozi ly'oyo ayogera nabo.

Ekiddako, tuula mu mbeera entuufu. Musa yawulira Eddoboozi ly'Oyo ayogera ng'asinziira ku ntebe ey'okusaasira. Vuunama mu maaso g'entebe ey'okusaasira. Awo okumanya obutasaanira bwo tekujja kukuziyiza, wabula kunaakuyamba mu mazima okwesiga Katonda. Awo oyinza okuba n'obwesige obukakafu nti okutunula kwo eri waggulu kunaasisinkana eriiso lye, nti okusaba kwo kuyinza okuwulirwa, era nti anaakuwa okuddamu kwe okw'okwagala. Vuunama mu maaso g'entebe ey'okusaasira, era kakasa nti Katonda ow'ekisa anaakulaba n'akuwa omukisa. N'oluvannyuma, tuula mu mbeera entuufu ey'omutima — omutima ogutega amatu. Bangi bali beemalidde ku bingi oba ku bitono bye balina okwogera mu kusaba kwabwe, ne kiba nti Eddoboozi ly'Oyo ayogera ku ntebe ey'okusaasira teriwulirwa, kubanga tebalisuubira wadde okulirindirira.

“Bw'ayogera Mukama. Naye ono gwe nnaatunuuliranga: oyo eyetoowaza era alina omwoyo ogwennyamivu, era akankana olw'ekigambo kyange.” Ka tuyingire mu kasenge, ne twemalira okusaba, n'omutima ogw'obwetoowaze ogulindirira okuwulira Katonda ng'ayogera; mu kigambo kye tusoma; ddala tunaawulira Eddoboozi ly'oyo ayogera naffe.

Omukisa ogusinga obukulu ogw'okusaba gunaaba kwe kulekeraawo okusaba kwaffe, tuleke Katonda ayogere.

Okusaba n'ekigambo bigatta wamu awatasobola kwawulwa: amaanyi mu kukozesa kimu ku byo gasinziira ku kubeerawo kw'ekirala. Ekigambo kimpa eby'okusaba, nga kinjigiriza ebisingawo ku Katonda era nga kimpa amaanyi ag'okusaba, obuvumu obw'obukakafu nti nnaawulirwa. Ekigambo era kindeetera okuddamu kw'okusaba, kubanga kinjigiriza Katonda ky'anankolera. Bwe kityo, ku luuyi olulala, okusaba kutegeka omutima okufuna ekigambo okuva eri Katonda yennyini, okusobola okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo atuwe okutegeera kw'omwoyo okukwata ku kyo, n'okukkiriza okugabana ku mirimu gyakyo egy'amaanyi. Ensonga lwaki kiri bwe kityo yeeyolese. Okusaba n'Ekigambo birina essiŋŋanga limu — Katonda. Okusaba kunoonya Katonda: Ekigambo kibikkula Katonda. Mu kusaba, omuntu abuuza Katonda: mu kigambo, Katonda addamu omuntu.

Mu kusaba, omuntu alinnya mu ggulu okubeera ne Katonda: mu kigambo, Katonda ajja okubeera n'omuntu. Mu kusaba, omuntu yeewaayo eri Katonda: mu kigambo, Katonda yeewaayo eri omuntu. Mu kusaba ne mu kigambo, byonna biteekwa okuba bya Katonda. Omutima gwo guboneke gwonna eri Katonda. Ekintu ekimu ky'oyaayaanira kibeere kwe kusaba n'ekigambo. Olwo onooba n'enkolagana ey'omukisa ne Katonda, okuwaanyisiganya endowooza, okwagala, n'obulamu: okubeera mu Katonda ne Katonda mu ffe.

Noonya Katonda obeere mulamu.

fields.title: Musa, Omusajja ow'Okusaba
fields.body_html:
Nga Musa tannabaawo, waaliwo omulembe gwa bajjajja, ogw'obulamu obw'omu maka, n'obuyinza bakitaawe bwe baalina, era ng'agwawula, Musa ye musajja asooka okulondebwa okuba omuyigiriza n'omukulembeze w'abantu. Mu ye, tulaba ebyokulabirako eby'ekitalo eby'ekifo n'amaanyi g'okwegayirira mu muweereza wa Katonda.

Okusaba kwa Musa Okuva ku kuyitibwa kwe okusooka mu Misiri, Musa yasaba. Yabuuza Katonda ky'anaagamba abantu (Okuva 3:11-13). Yamutegeeza obunafu bwe bwonna n'amwegayirira amuggyeko omulimu gwe (4:1-13). Abantu bwe baamunenya nti emigugu gyabwe gyeyongedde, yagenda n'ategeeza Katonda, olunyiriri 22, era n'amumanyisa entiisa ze zonna (6:12). Kuno kwe kwali okutendekebwa kwe okusooka. Okuva mu kino kwe kwazaalibwa amaanyi ge mu kusaba, Falaawo bwe yaddiŋŋananga okumusaba amwegayiririre eri Mukama, n'obununuzi ne bujja ku kusaba kwa Musa (8:8, 9, 12, 28, 29, 30, 31; 9:28-29, 9:33; 10:17-18). Yiga ebitundu bino okutuusa lw'onootegeera ddala engeri okusaba gye kwali ekintu eky'amazima mu mulimu gwa Musa ne mu kununula kwa Katonda.

Ku Nnyanja Emyufu, Musa yakaabirira Katonda awamu n'abantu, n'okuddamu ne kujja (14:15).

Abantu bwe baalumwa ennyonta mu ddungu, era Amaleki bwe yabalumba, era kwali kusaba okwaleeta obununuzi (17:4, 11).

Ku Sinaayi, Isirayiri bwe baali bamaze okukola Ennyana eya Zaabu, kwali kusaba okwaziyiza amangu okuzikirira okwali kubasembeddeko (32:11, 32:14). Kwali kusaba okwaddiŋŋanyizibwa okwabakomyawo (32:31). Kwali kusaba okwongerezebwa okwakakasa okubeerawo kwa Katonda okugenda nabo (33:17), era nate kwali kusaba okwaleeta okubikkulirwa okw'ekitiibwa kya Katonda (33:19). Era ekyo bwe kyamala okuweebwa, kwali kusaba okuggya okwafuna okuddaabiriza endagaano (34:9-10). Mu Ekyamateeka, tulina obufunze obw'ekitalo obwa bino byonna (9:18-20, 19:26); tulaba n'amaanyi ge yasabira, n'engeri, mu mbeera emu, gye yamala ennaku amakumi ana emisana n'ekiro nga yeevuunise wansi mu maaso ga Mukama (9:25, 10:10).

Mu Kubala, tusoma ku kusaba kwa Musa okuzikiza omuliro gwa Mukama, 11:2, n'okufuna ennyama; 10:2, 11, ku kusaba okuwonya Miriamu, 12:13; n'okuwonya eggwanga bwe baali bagaanye okwambuka mu nsi, 14:17-20. Okusaba kwaleeta omusango ku Koola, 16:15, era Katonda bwe yali agenda okuzikiriza ekibiina kyonna, okusaba ne kutangirira, 46. Okusaba kwaggya amazzi mu lwazi, 20:6, era ng'okuddamu okw'okusaba, omusota ogw'ekikomo ne guweebwa, 21:7. Olw'okusaba, Katonda ky'ayagala ne kimanyisibwa mu mbeera enzibu, 27:5, era Yoswa n'aweebwa okusikira Musa, 16.

Yiga bino byonna okutuusa omutima gwo gwonna lwe gulijjula endowooza ku mugabo okusaba gwe kuteekwa okukola, kwe kuyinza okukola, mu bulamu bw'omusajja ayagala okuba omuweereza wa Katonda eri banne.

Bwe tunaayiga, ebitundu binaagatta ne bifuuka ekintu ekimu ekiramu, era Musa anaabeera gye tuli ekyokulabirako ekiramu eky'obulamu bwaffe obw'okusaba. Tunaayiga ekyetaagisa okuba omwegayirizi. Ebyokuyiga ebinaatujjira binaaba nga bino; Ndaba Musa yali musajja eyeewaayo eri Katonda, omunyiikivu, weewaawo, eyakwatirwa obuggya olwa Katonda, olw'ekitiibwa kye n'okwagala kwe.

Ate era omusajja eyeewaayo ddala eri abantu be, eyali yeeteefuteefu okwewaayo, singa bandirokolebbwa.

Omusajja eyategeera okuyitibwa okw'obwakatonda okukola ng'omutabaganya, okuba akayungo, oluguudo olw'empuliziganya n'olw'omukisa, wakati wa Katonda ali mu ggulu n'abantu abali ku nsi. Obulamu obwali bujjuddemu ddala okumanya kuno okw'obutabaganya, ne kiba nti tewali kintu kyangu era kya butonde okusinga okusuubira nti Katonda anaawulira.

Ndaba wano Katonda, ng'addamu okusaba kw'omusajja omu, ng'alokola era ng'awa omukisa abo be yamukwasa, era ng'akola ekyo ky'atandikola awatali kwo. Ndaba engeri obufuzi bwonna obwa Katonda gye bwatwaliramu okusaba mu nteekateeka yaabwo ng'ekimu ku bitundu byabwo.

Ndaba engeri eggulu gye lijjuddemu obulamu n'amaanyi n'omukisa ensi bye yeetaaga, n'engeri okusaba okw'ensi gye kuli amaanyi agaleeta omukisa ogwo wansi.

Okusinga byonna, ndaba engeri okusaba gye kuli akabonero k'obulamu obw'omwoyo, n'engeri amaanyi gaakwo gye gasinziira ku nkolagana yange ne Katonda, n'okumanya nti ndi mukiise we. Ampa omulimu gwe, era nga bwe neewaayo obulungi era mu bujjuvu eri ebibye, bwe kityo n'obukakafu nti anaŋŋwulira bwe bweyongera okuba obwa butonde era obw'amazima.

Lowooza ku kifo Katonda kye yalina mu bulamu bwa Musa, nga Katonda eyamutuma, Katonda gwe yeewaayo gy'ali mu bujjuvu, Katonda eyasuubiza okubeera naye, eyandimuyambye era eyamuyambanga bulijjo bwe yasabanga era nga bwe yasabanga.

Kaakano ku by'okukolebwa: Tuyinza tutya okuyiga okusaba nga Musa? Ekisa kino tetuyinza kukifuna lwa kuwaŋŋaana kwokka. Ekyokuyiga kyaffe ekisooka kiteekwa okuba okumanya obunafu bwaffe. Olwo ekisa kinaakikola mu ffe, mpola naye mu bukakafu, bwe twewaayo mu kutendekebwa kwakyo. Naye newankubadde ng'okutendekebwa kunaaba kwa mpolampola, waliwo ekintu ekimu ekiyinza okukolebwa amangu ago, tuyinza okusalawo amangu okwewaayo eri obulamu buno n'okutuula mu mbeera entuufu. Kola kino kaakano, sala ekyokusalawo, okubeeranga mu bujjuvu oluguudo olw'omukisa gwa Katonda okuyita mu ggwe okutuuka eri ensi. Tambula ekigere.

Bwe kyeetaagisa, twala eddakiika kkumi olw'okulowooza n'obwegendereza. Kkiriza okulondebwa okw'obwakatonda, era twala ekintu ekimu eky'okwegayiririra. Twala ebbanga, ng'oggeko wiiki emu, era nyweza amazima amasingira awo ekyokulabirako kya Musa bye kiyigiriza. Ng'omuyigiriza w'ennyimba bw'akakata ku kwegezaamu amaloboozi — okwegezaamu kwokka kwe kutuukiriza — weeteeketeeke okuyiga bulungi n'okukozesa ebyokuyiga ebisooka ebyetaagisa.

fields.title: Musa, Omusajja wa Katonda
fields.body_html:
Guno gwe mukisa Musa omusajja wa Katonda gwe yasabira abantu ba Isirayiri nga tannafa — Ekyamateeka 33:1. Omusajja wa Katonda! Erinnya lino nga litegeeza bingi! Omusajja ava eri Katonda, eyalondebwa era eyatumibwa. Omusajja atambula ne Katonda, abeera mu nkolagana ye, era atwala akabonero k'okubeerawo kwe. Omusajja abeerera Katonda n'okwagala kwe; obuntu bwe bwonna nga bujjuddemu era nga bufugibwa ekitiibwa kya Katonda; atari mu kigendererwa era awatakoowa aleeta abantu okulowooza ku Katonda. Omusajja Katonda gw'atutte mu mutima gwe ne mu bulamu bwe ekifo ekituufu ng'Ekintu Kyonna mu Byonna, era alina okwagala kumu kwokka, nti Katonda abeere n'ekifo ekyo mu nsi yonna.

Abasajja ba Katonda ng'abo be beetaagibwa ensi; be beebo Katonda b'anoonya, alyoke abajjuze yekka, era abatume mu nsi okuyamba abalala okumumanya. Musa yali wa njawulo nnyo abantu ne bamwogerako mu ngeri ya butonde nti — Musa, omusajja wa Katonda! Omusajja ng'oyo buli muweereza wa Katonda gwe yandigenderedde okuba — omujulizi omulamu era obukakafu bwa Katonda ky'ali gy'ali mu ggulu, era ky'ali gy'ali ku nsi, era ky'ayagala okuba mu byonna.

Mu ssuula eyakulembera, twayogera ku bumu ne Katonda ng'ekyo omuntu kye yatondebwa, ng'enkizo ey'obulamu obwa buli lunaku, ng'ekyo ekyandibadde ekifaananyi kyaffe ekisooka ku ssaawa ey'oku makya. Ekyo ekyaliwo kyakwatanga okusingira ddala ku byetaago byaffe ffekka, n'amaanyi g'obulamu obutukuvu era obw'essanyu okukwata abalala. Erinnya, Musa omusajja wa Katonda, n'endowooza ey'omuntu okuba nga ayungiddwa ku Katonda mu ngeri ey'oku lusegere era eyeeyoleka nga n'abantu mu butonde bagiwa ng'ekiwenyi kye ekikulu — omusajja wa Katonda, kitutwala mu maaso.

Kitutwala mu bulamu obw'olukale, kireeta endowooza ey'engeri gye tukwatamu abantu, n'amaanyi ge tuyinza okuba nago ag'okwetikka akabonero k'okubeerawo kwa Katonda okutukuvu, nti abantu bwe batulaba oba bwe batulowoozaako, erinnya lyennyini liyimuke amangu — OMUSAJJA WA KATONDA! Bano be basajja ensi ne Katonda be beetaaga mu ngeri y'emu. Era lwaki? Kubanga ensi, olw'ekibi, yagwa n'eva ku Katonda. Kubanga mu Kristo ensi yanunulibwa okuba eya Katonda. Era kubanga Katonda talina kkubo lya kulaga bantu kye basaanidde okuba, oku babuutikira n'okubayita n'okubayamba, wabula okuyita mu basajja ba Katonda, mwe mukolera obulamu bwe, Omwoyo we, n'amaanyi ge.

Omuntu yatondebwa ku lwa Katonda, Katonda alyoke abeere, atuule, akole, era ayoleke ekitiibwa kye mu ye era ng'ayita mu ye. Katonda yali ateekwa okuba byonna mu byonna gy'ali. Okutuula kwa Katonda munda kwali kuteekwa okuba okwa butonde era okusanyusa nga bwe kuli okw'amazima, okw'ekyewuunyo, era okutasoboka kutegeera. Okununula kwa Kristo bwe kwatuukirira mu kuserengeta kwa Katonda — Omwoyo Omutukuvu — mu mitima gy'abantu, okutuula kuno ne kuzzibwawo, era Katonda n'addamu okuba nannyini nnyumba ye.

Wano we wali omuntu weewaayo mu bujjuvu eri okubeerawo kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, si nga maanyi agakolera mu ye kyokka, wabula nga Katonda abeera mu ye. (Yokaana 14:16, 14:20, 14:23; 1 Yokaana 4) Ayinza okufuuka, mu makulu amasingira ddala obuziba ag'ekigambo, OMUSAJJA WA KATONDA! Pawulo atugamba nti kiyita mu maanyi g'Ebyawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, “omusajja wa Katonda alyoke atuukirire.”

“Ebyawandiikibwa byonna byaluŋŋamizibwa Katonda, era bigasa mu kuyigiriza, mu kunenya, mu kutereeza, ne mu kutendeka mu butuukirivu; omusajja wa Katonda alyoke atuukirire, ng'atendekeddwa okukola buli mulimu omulungi.” Kino kituleeta ku magoba g'essaawa ey'oku makya ng'ekiseera ekisinga obukulu eky'okwesomera Baibuli. Bwe tuwaayo omutima n'obulamu eri Ekigambo, Katonda ng'ayita mu kuyigiriza kwakyo, mu kunenya kwakyo, mu kutereeza kwakyo, mu kubuulirira kwakyo, okukebera n'okubumba obulamu bwaffe bwonna, ne tujja bwe tutyo wansi w'omulimu gwa Katonda ogutereevu, ne mu bumu obujjuvu naye, omusajja wa Katonda mw'anaatuukiririra — ng'atendekeddwa eri buli mulimu omulungi.

Ayi! Singa tufuna ekisa okuba omusajja wa Katonda ddala! Omusajja amanyi era akakasa ebintu bino ebisatu; Katonda ye byonna; Katonda asaba byonna; Katonda akola byonna. Omusajja alabye ekifo Katonda ky'alina mu bitonde bye ne mu bantu — Ye Kyonna mu Byonna! Omusajja ategedde nti Katonda asaba era ateekwa okuba na byonna, era abeerera kuwa Katonda kye kimusaanira n'ekitiibwa kye! Omusajja avumbudde ekyama ekikulu nti Katonda akola byonna, era anoonya, nga Omwana wa Katonda, okubeera mu kwesigama okw'omukisa okutakoowa nti Kitaawe ali mu ye ye ayogera ebigambo era ye akola omulimu.

Owooluganda! Noonya okuba omusajja wa Katonda! Katonda ku ssaawa ey'oku makya abeere byonna gy'oli. Katonda mu budde bw'emisana abeere byonna gy'oli. Era obulamu bwo bwewaayo eri ekintu kimu, okuleeta abantu eri Katonda, ne Katonda eri abantu, mu Kkanisa ye, ne mu nsi, Katonda alyoke abeere n'ekifo ekimusaanira.

“Obanga ndi musajja wa Katonda, omuliro guve mu ggulu.” Bw'atyo Eriya bwe yaddamu omukulu w'eggye bwe yamuyita okuserengeta. Katonda ow'amazima ye Katonda addamu n'omuliro, era omusajja wa Katonda ow'amazima ye oyo amanyi okukoowoola omuliro guserengete, kubanga alina amaanyi ne Katonda ow'eggulu. Oba omuliro gwaba ogw'omusango oba ogw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, omulimu gw'omusajja wa Katonda kwe kuleeta omuliro wansi ku nsi. Ensi ky'eyeetaaga y'omusajja wa Katonda amanyi amaanyi ga Katonda, n'amaanyi ge ne Katonda.

Kkiriza nti mu mpisa ey'okusaba mu kyama eya buli lunaku mwe tuyigira okumanya Katonda waffe, n'omuliro gwe, n'amaanyi gaffe ne ye. Ayi! Okumanya kye kitegeeza okuba omusajja wa Katonda, era n'ekyo kye kizingiramu.

Mu Eriya nga bwe kiri mu Musa, tulaba engeri kino gye kitegeeza kwawukana ku buli kintu ekirala kye twegomba, n'okwegatta okujjuvu eri ekitiibwa kya Katonda, nga tokyali musajja wa nsi, wabula omusajja wa Katonda. Waliwo okuwulira okw'ekyama nti bino byonna bireeta okuzitoowererwa n'okwewaayo, obuzibu n'akabi okusinga bwe tuli abeetegefu. Kino kya mazima kyokka ng'ekyo tunnaba kulaba engeri Katonda gy'asaba mu bujjuvu, n'engeri ey'omukisa etayogerekeka gye kiri okukikkiriza, n'engeri ey'obukakafu nti Katonda yennyini y'anaakikola mu ffe.

Kyuka kaakano otunuulire Musa; omusajja ow'okusaba, Musa omusajja eyeenyigira mu by'ensi, olabe engeri okuva mu bino gye kwakulira — Musa, omusajja wa Katonda. Laba eky'ekimu mu bulamu bwa Eriya — obumu wakati w'okuwulira kwaffe ekigambo kya Katonda n'okuwulira kwe okwaffe, n'engeri gye kifuuka eky'obwakatonda okusoboka okubeera n'okubeerera — OMUSAJJA WA KATONDA. N'oluvannyuma yiga okukozesa.

fields.title: Amaanyi g'Ekigambo kya Katonda
fields.body_html:
"Naffe kyetuva twebaza Katonda obutayosa, kubanga bwe mwawulira ekigambo ekiva gye tuli, temwakiwulira ng'ekiva eri abantu wabula ng'ekiva eri Katonda, nga ky'ekigambo kya Katonda kyennyini, ekikolera ne mu mmwe, abakkiriza." — 1 Basessaloniika 2:13.

Omuwendo gw'ebigambo by'omuntu gusinziira ku kutegeera kwange oyo abyogera. Nga waliwo enjawulo nnene ng'omuntu ampa ekisuubizo nti, "Nzija kukuwa ekitundu ky'ebintu byonna bye nnina," oyogera oba mwavu alina sirinji emu, oba mugagga ayagala okugabana nange obugagga bwe! Ekimu ku bisooka ebyetaagisa okusoma Baibuli okuvaamu ebibala kwe kumanya Katonda ng'Oyo Ayinza byonna, n'okumanya amaanyi g'ekigambo kye. Amaanyi g'ekigambo kya Katonda tegakoma. "Mukama yayogera kigambo, eggulu ne likolebwa; yayogera bwogezi n'etondebwa, n'alagira n'eyimirira nga nywevu" Zabbuli 33:9. Mu kigambo kya Katonda, obuyinza bwe obutakoma bwe bukolera: kirina amaanyi ag'okutonda era kiyita ekintu kyennyini kye kyogerako okubaawo.

Ekigambo kya Katonda omulamu kigambo kiramu ekiwa obulamu. Tekikoma ku kuyita ebintu okubaawo, wabula kizzaamu obulamu ekyafa.

Amaanyi gaakyo agazza obulamu gasobola okuzuukiza emibiri emifu, era gawa obulamu obutaggwaawo emyoyo emifu. Obulamu bwonna obw'omwoyo buva mu kyo, kubanga tuzaalibwa nsigo etavunda olw'ekigambo kya Katonda ekiramu era ekibeerera emirembe gyonna. Wano we waliwo, nga kikwekeddwa bangi, ekimu ku byama ebisinga obuziba eby'omukisa gw'ekigambo kya Katonda—okukkiriza mu maanyi gaakyo ag'okutonda n'okuzza obulamu. Ekigambo kirikolera mu nze empisa oba ekisa kyennyini kye kiragira oba kye kisuubiza. "Kikolera n'amaanyi mu abo abakkiriza." Tewali kisobola kuziyiza maanyi gaakyo bwe kifunibwa mu mutima ng'ekiyita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. "Kikolera n'amaanyi mu abo abakkiriza." "Eddoboozi lya Mukama liriko amaanyi."

Buli kimu kisinziira ku kuyiga obukugu obw'okwaniriza ekigambo ekyo mu mutima. Era mu kuyiga obukugu buno, omutendera ogusooka gwe—okukkiriza mu bulamu bwakyo, mu buyinza bwakyo obutakoma, ne mu maanyi gaakyo ag'okutonda. Olw'ekigambo kye, "nga bwe kyawandiikibwa nti, 'Nkufudde jjajja w'amawanga amangi'—mu maaso g'oyo gwe yakkiriza, Katonda azuukiza abafu, era alaba ebitaliiwo ng'ebiriwo" Abaruumi 4:17. Nga bwe kiri amazima ku bikolwa byonna ebya Katonda eby'amaanyi okuva ku kutonda okutuuka ku kuzuukira kw'abafu, bwe kityo bwe kiri amazima ku buli kigambo kye atwogeza mu kitabo kye ekitukuvu. Ebintu bibiri bye bituziyiza okukkiriza kino nga bwe tusaanira.

Ekimu kwe kwerabira okw'entiisa mu buli ludda, era oboolyawo ne mu ffe ffennyini, ekigambo nga kifuulibwa eky'obwereere olw'amagezi g'abantu oba obutakkiriza oba omwoyo ogw'ensi. Ekirala kwe kunyooma okuyigiriza kw'ekyawandiikibwa nti ekigambo nsigo.

Ensigo ntono, ensigo eyinza okumala ebbanga eddene nga yeebase, ensigo zeetaaga okukwekebwa, era bwe zimera zikula mpola. Kubanga enkola y'ekigambo kya Katonda ekwekeddwa era etalabika, nga ya mpolampola, era ng'efaanana ng'enafu, tetukkiriza buyinza bwakyo obutakoma. Ka tukifuule ekimu ku bisomo byaffe ebisooka. Ekigambo kye nsoma ge maanyi ga Katonda agaleeta obulokozi: kirikolera mu nze byonna bye njetaaga, byonna Kitaffe by'asaba.

Nga essuubi eringi okukkiriza kuno kwe kwandiggulyewo ku bulamu bwaffe obw'omwoyo! Twandirabye eby'obugagga byonna n'emikisa gyonna egy'ekisa kya Katonda nga biri mu buyinza bwaffe okubituukako. Ekigambo kirina amaanyi ag'okumulisa ekizikiza kyaffe: mu mitima gyaffe kirireeta omusana gwa Katonda, okuwulira okwagala kwe, n'okumanya by'ayagala. Ekigambo kiyinza okutujjuza amaanyi n'obuvumu okuwangula buli mulabe, n'okukola kyonna Katonda ky'atulagira okukola.

Ekigambo kyandinaazizza, ne kitukuza, ne kikolera mu ffe okukkiriza n'obuwulize, ne kifuuka mu ffe ensigo ya buli mpisa efaanana nga Mukama waffe. Okuyita mu kigambo, Omwoyo yanditutwadde mu mazima gonna, kwe kugamba, okufuula byonna ebiri mu kigambo amazima mu ffe, bw'atyo n'ateekateeka omutima gwaffe okuba ekifo Kitaffe n'Omwana mwe babeera.

Nga enkyukakyuka eringi yandijjidde ku nkolagana yaffe n'ekigambo kya Katonda ne ku kusaba okw'oku makya singa twakkiriza ddala amazima gano amangu! Ka tutandike okutendekebwa olw'obuweereza obw'ekigambo obwo buli mukkiriza bw'ateekwa okukola, nga tukakasa amaanyi gaakyo mu bulamu bwaffe ffennyini. Ka tutandike okunoonya kino, nga mu bukkakkamu twetegeka okuyiga essomo ery'okukkiriza eddene, amaanyi ag'ekigambo kya Katonda amangi.

Tewali kirala kitegeezebwa okugamba nti: ekigambo kya Katonda kya mazima! Kubanga Katonda yennyini y'alikifuula amazima mu ffe. Tulina bingi eby'okuyiga ku ebyo ebiziyiza amaanyi ago, bingi eby'okuwangula, okusumululwa ku bizibu bino, era bingi eby'okuwaayo tulyoke tufune omulimu ogwo. Naye byonna birituukirira singa tunaatandika okusoma Baibuli nga tumaliridde okukkiriza nti ekigambo kya Katonda kirina amaanyi agatakoma mu mutima okukolera buli mukisa kye kyogerako. fields.title: Ensigo ye Kigambo
fields.body_html:
Ndowooza kiyinza okwogerwa awatali kubuusabuusa nti mu bitonde byonna tewali kifaananyi kirala kya kigambo kya Katonda ekituufu, era ekijjudde amakulu, ng'eky'ensigo. Okugifuniramu okutegeera okw'omwoyo okujjuvu ye ngeri ey'ekitalo ey'okufuna ekisa. Ensonga ez'okufaanana zyoogerwa mangu. Waliwo ensigo nga bw'efaanana ng'ekitali kya makulu—akantu akatono bwe kageraageranyizibwa n'omuti ogugivaamu. Waliwo obulamu, obusibiddwa era obwebase munda mu kikuta. Waliwo obwetaavu bw'ettaka eddungi, awatali lyo okukula tekusoboka. Waliwo okukula okwa mpolampola n'obuwanvu bw'ebiseera obwetaagisa okugumiikiriza okuwanvu okw'omulimi. Era waliwo ekibala, ensigo mwe yeezaalira era ne yeeyongera obungi. Mu nsonga zino zonna, ensigo etuyigiriza ebisomo eby'omuwendo ennyo ku ngeri gye tukozesaamu ekigambo kya Katonda.

Waliwo okusooka essomo ery'okukkiriza. Okukkiriza tekutunuulira ndabika.

Nga bwe tuyinza okulaba, kifaanana ng'ekitasoboka nti ekigambo kya Katonda kandiwadde obulamu mu mwoyo, ne kikolera mu ffe ekisa kyennyini kye kyogerako, ne kikyusa empisa zaffe zonna, ne kitujjuza amaanyi. Naye bwe kiri bwe kityo. Bwe tumala okuyiga okukkiriza nti ekigambo kisobola okukolera n'amaanyi amazima gennyini kye kiraga; tuba tuzudde ekimu ku byama ebikulu eby'okusoma kwaffe Baibuli. Olwo tulyaniriza buli kigambo ng'omusingo n'amaanyi ag'omulimu ogw'Obwakatonda.

Era waliwo essomo ery'okukola. Ensigo yeetaaga okukuŋŋaanyizibwa, okutereka, n'okuteekebwa mu ttaka eritegekeddwa. Bwe kityo n'obwongo bulina okukuŋŋaanya okuva mu byawandiikibwa n'okutegeera n'okuyisa eri omutima, ttaka lyokka ensigo eno ey'omu ggulu mwe eyinza okukulira, ebigambo ebimalako obwetaavu bwaffe. Tetusobola kuwa bulamu wadde okukula. So tetukyetaaga: buli wo. Naye kye tusobola okukola kwe kukweka ekigambo mu mutima gwaffe, ne tukikuumira eyo, nga tulindirira omusana oguva waggulu.

Era ensigo eyigiriza essomo ery'okugumiikiriza. Ekibala ky'ekigambo ku mutima emirundi mingi tekiba mangwago. Kyetaaga ekiseera okusimba emirandira, n'okukula: ebigambo bya Kristo biteekwa okubeera mu ffe. Tetuteekwa kwongera buli lunaku ku kumanya kwaffe okwa Baibuli kwokka—kino kiringa kukuŋŋaanya ŋŋaano mu tterekero—wabula okulabirira ebigambo ebyo eby'ekiragiro oba eby'ekisuubizo bye twetwalidde, ne tubiwa ekifo mu mutima gwaffe okwanjaala emirandira n'amatabi. Twetaaga okumanya ensigo ki gye tussaamu, n'okulima okusuubira okw'okwekaliriza naye okugumiikiriza. Mu kiseera kyakyo tulikungula, bwe tutaggwaamu maanyi (Abaggalatiya 6:9).

Era eky'enkomerero kijja essomo ery'okubala ebibala. Newaakubadde ng'akasigo ako akatono ak'ekigambo kya Katonda kalabika ng'akatali ka makulu, newaakubadde ng'obulamu bwako bufaanana ng'obunafu, newaakubadde ng'ekirowoozo kyennyini kye koogerako kikwekeddwa nnyo, era newaakubadde ng'obwa mpolampola obw'okukula kwako bugezesa okugumiikiriza kwaffe—kakasa nti ekibala kirijja. Amazima gennyini n'obulamu n'amaanyi ga Katonda, ekigambo bye kyalimu ekirowoozo, birikula ne byengera munda mu ggwe. Era nga ensigo bw'ebala ekibala, nga mulimu ensigo y'emu ey'okwezaalira obuggya, bwe kityo ekigambo tekirikuleetera kibala kyokka kye kyasuubiza, wabula ekibala ekyo buli mulundi kirifuuka ensigo gy'otwalira abalala okubawa obulamu n'omukisa.

Si kigambo kyokka, wabula "Obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu bufaanana ng'akaweke ka kaladaali" Matayo 13:31. Era ekisa kyabwo kyonna tekijja mu ngeri ndala okuggyako ng'ensigo ekwekeddwa mu mutima gw'oyo eyazaalibwa obuggya. Kristo nsigo. Omwoyo Omutukuvu nsigo. Okwagala kwa Katonda okufukibwa mu mutima nsigo. Obukulu obusukkiridde obw'amaanyi agakolera mu ffe nsigo. Obulamu obukwekeddwa buli mu mutima, naye tebuwulikika mangu wadde bulijjo mu maanyi gaabwo. Ekitiibwa eky'Obwakatonda kiri wo, naye emirundi mingi awatali kifaananyi wadde obulungi, okumanyibwa okukkiriza kwokka, okubalibwa n'okukolerwako ne bwe kitawulikika, okulindirirwa mu kuvaayo kwakyo n'okukula kwakyo.

Amazima gano amakulu, buli mulundi bwe ganywezebwa era ne gakwatibwa ng'etteeka ery'obulamu bwonna obw'omu ggulu ku nsi, okusoma ekigambo kya Katonda kufuuka ekikolwa eky'okukkiriza n'okwewaayo n'okwesigama ku Katonda omulamu. Nkkiriza mu bwetoowaze, kumpi nga nkankana, mu nsigo ey'Obwakatonda eri mu kigambo, ne mu maanyi g'Omwoyo gwa Katonda okugifuula amazima mu bulamu bwange ne mu bye mpitamu. Mpaayo omutima gwange n'enjala era kigumba okwaniriza ensigo eno ey'Obwakatonda. Era nnindirira Katonda mu kwesigama okutuufu n'obwesige okuwa okweyongera mu maanyi okusukka bye tuyinza okusaba oba okulowooza.

fields.title: Okukola n'Okumanya
fields.body_html:
Naye Yesu yagamba nti, "Balina omukisa abo bonna abawulira ekigambo kya Katonda ne bakigondera!" Lukka 11:28.

"Buli ayagala okukola Katonda by'ayagala, ategeera obanga bye njigiriza byange ku bwange oba bya Katonda." Yokaana 7:17.

Edda ntono, nnafuna ebbaluwa okuva eri omuntu eyali kirabika nga Mukristaayo omunyiikivu, ng'ansaba obulagirizi okumuyamba mu kusoma Baibuli. Ekirowoozo kyange ekisooka kyali okuddamu nti waliwo emboozi n'obutabo bungi nnyo ku nsonga eno, era nti byonna bye nnandyogedde yandibisanze nga bimaze okwogerwa obulungi. Oluvannyuma lw'akaseera, ebintu ebimu ebyabaawo mu kitundu kyange kyennyini byantuusa okuwulira obwetaavu bw'okuyigirizibwa ku nsonga eno enkulu ennyo, era nnasanga waliwo ensonga ezaali zeetaaga okussibwako essira ery'enjawulo. Nkwata ekkalaamu yange n'okusaba n'essuubi ery'amaanyi nti bye mpandiika bive eri Katonda, ensulo ya Musana n'Obulamu, okuyamba abaana be abato okulaba engeri gye bayinza okuggya mu Kigambo kye eky'omuwendo obuyigirize bwonna obw'Obwakatonda n'endiisa, essanyu lyonna eringi n'amaanyi bye yabaterekera.

Neeteeka nga njogera eri Omukristaayo omuto eyaŋŋamba nti: "Nnyamba okusoma Baibuli yange. Mpa amateeka agannuŋŋamya ku ngeri y'okutandikiramu, n'engeri y'okweyongeramu, ndyoke manye Baibuli yange obulungi." Ekintu ekisooka kye nnina okumugamba, ekintu ekikulembera byonna, kye kino: Mu kusoma kwo Baibuli, buli kimu kirisinziira ku mwoyo gw'ojja nagwo, ku Kigendererwa oba ku Nkomerero gy'oteekera wekka. Mu bintu eby'ensi, omuntu afugibwa era asindikibwa Enkomerero oba Ekigendererwa ky'eteekera mu maaso. Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne ku Baibuli. Ekigendererwa kyo bwe kiba kwakumanya Baibuli obulungi kyokka, olyekamikwa. Bw'olowooza nti okumanya Baibuli okujjuvu tekulemwa kubeera mukisa, oli mu nsobi.

Eri abamu kikolimo. Eri abalala tekiriimu maanyi, tekibafuula batukuvu wadde ab'essanyu. Eri abamu mugugu, kibaddaaza mu kifo ky'okubazza obulamu oba okubawanika. Kale Ekigendererwa oba Enkomerero kirina kubeera ki, empisa entuufu ey'asoma Baibuli? Ekigambo kya Katonda mmere, mugaati oguva mu ggulu; ekyetaagisa ekisooka mu kusoma Baibuli kye kino:—ENJALA ENNENE EY'OBUTUUKIRIVU, okwegomba okunene okukola byonna Katonda by'ayagala. Baibuli musana: ekisooka ekyetaagisa okugyeyagalira mutima ogwegomba okutambulira mu makubo ga Katonda. Kino si kye biyigiriza ebyawandiikibwa bye ntadde waggulu?

"Balina omukisa abo abawulira ekigambo kya Katonda ne bakigondera." Tewali mukisa mu kuwulira oba mu kumanya ekigambo kya Katonda awatali kukikwata. Ekigambo si kintu bwe kitakwatibwa, wadde okugonderwa, oba okukolebwa. "Buli ayagala okukola Katonda by'ayagala, ategeera." Yokaana 7:17. Okusinziira ku kigambo kino ekya Mukama waffe, okumanya kwonna okutuufu okw'ekigambo kya Katonda kusooka kusinziira ku kwagala okukikola.

Kino si sye ssomo lyennyini lye tunyweza? Katonda aligaana okusumulula amakulu gennyini n'omukisa ogw'ekigambo kye eri buli muntu okuggyako abo abalina okwagala okunywevu okukukola. Nteekwa okusoma Baibuli yange n'ekigendererwa kimu—"Buli ky'anaabagamba mukikole."

Lwaki kino kirina okuba bwe kityo, kizuulibwa mangu bwe tulowooza ku kigendererwa ky'ebigambo. Biyimirira wakati w'okwagala n'ekikolwa. Omuntu ayagala okukukolera ekintu; nga tannaakikola, ayolesa ekirowoozo oba ekigendererwa kye mu bigambo; oluvannyuma atuukiriza ebigambo ng'akola kye yasuubiza. Bwe kityo ne ku Katonda. Ebigambo bye biriko omuwendo olw'ekyo ky'akola. Mu kutonda, ekigambo kye kyaliko amaanyi: yayogera bwogezi ne kikolebwa. Mu kisa, akola ky'ayogera. Dawudi asaba (2 Samwiri 7:25) nti, "Otuukirize ekyo kye wasuubiza." Sulemaani ayogera ku kutukuza yeekaalu nti—"atuukiriza n'omukono gwe ekyo kye yasuubiza n'akamwa ke"; "Mukama atuukirizza kye yasuubiza"; "wasuubiza n'akamwa ko, era okituukirizza n'omukono gwo leero"; "ekigambo kyo kye wasuubiza kituukirire" (2 Ebyomumirembe 6:4, 10, 15, 16, 17.) Eri bannabbi, Katonda agamba nti, "Nze Mukama nkyogedde; ndikikola." Nabo bagamba nti, "Kye wayogera, kikoleddwa."

Amazima n'omuwendo gw'ekyo Katonda ky'asuubiza guli mu kino, nti akikola. Ekigambo kye eky'ekisuubizo kiteekwa okutuukirizibwa. Kino si kya mazima matono ku kigambo kye eky'ekiragiro, ku bintu by'atwagaliza okukola. Bwe tutabikola, bwe tunoonya okubimanya, bwe twewuunya obulungi bwabyo ne tutendereza amagezi gaabyo, naye ne tutabikola, tweerimba ffekka. Byateekebwawo okukolebwa; olwo lwokka bwe tubikola, amakulu gaabyo gennyini n'omukisa lwe biyinza okubikkulwa gye tuli.

Olwo lwokka bwe tubikola lwe tuyinza okukula ddala mu bulamu obw'Obwakatonda. "Mutambulenga nga musaanira Mukama, mu byonna nga mumusanyusa, nga mubala ebibala mu buli mulimu omulungi, era nga mweyongera okumanya Katonda." Olwo lwokka bwe tusemberera ebigambo bya Katonda n'ekigendererwa kye kimu Katonda kye yalina mu maaso, nti biteekwa okukolebwa, lwe tuyinza okuba n'essuubi lyonna ery'omukisa.

Kino si kye tulaba mu buli ludda mu kunoonya okumanya, oba mu kika kyonna eky'obusuubuzi? Omuyizi oba omwana ayigirizibwa asuubirwa okuteeka mu nkola ebisomo by'afuna; olwo lwokka lw'aba yetegese okuyigirizibwa okusingawo. Bwe kityo ne mu bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo, okusoma Baibuli kuba kwa kuteesa kwokka, omuzannyo ogusanyusa ogw'obwongo n'okulowooza, ogutaliimu mugaso wadde ku bulamu obw'obutukuvu obwennyini oba obufaananyi bwa Kristo, okutuusa omusomi lw'aba yeeteefuteefu obutabikkula wadde okubikka Baibuli ye awatali kufuula ekigendererwa kya Katonda ekikye yekka, n'okuwuliriza bw'agamba nti: "Kola byonna bye njogera." Kino kye kyali akabonero k'abatukuvu ab'edda. "Bw'atyo Ibulayimu n'agenda nga Mukama bwe yamugamba." "Bw'atyo Musa n'akola; nga byonna Mukama bye yamulagira, bw'atyo bwe yakola." Kuno kwe kunnyonnyola omuntu eyali ng'omuddu omwesigwa mu nnyumba ye yonna. Ne ku Dawudi, tusoma nti: "Nzudde Dawudi omwana wa Yese, omusajja asiimibwa omutima gwange. Alikola byonna bye njagala akole."

Mu Zabbuli 119 tumuwulira ng'ayogera ne Katonda ku kigambo kye, ng'asaba omusana n'okuyigirizibwa okw'Obwakatonda, naye bulijjo nga biwerekerwako obweeyamo obw'obuwulize, oba ekimu ekirala ekiraga okwagala n'essanyu. Kwe kukola Katonda by'ayagala okuli, ne ku Mwana wa Katonda yennyini, kye kyama kimu eky'okuyingira mu kuganja ne mu birowoozo bya Katonda.

Nnaakamala okusoma ekitabo kya Mukama Moody ekipya, "Essanyu n'Amagoba mu Kusoma Baibuli." Sibuusabuusa nti bangi baligeraaga ku magezi ge kirimu. Balirowooza obulungi nti ekyayamba omuntu nga Moody, kiyinza okunnyamba nange. Naye era bayinza okwekamikwa. Bateekwa okwekamikwa, okuggyako nga baleeta eri Baibuli Mukama Moody kye yaleeta: okwegomba okw'amazima okukola kyonna kye yalaba nga Katonda ky'ayagala akole. Ggwe Omukristaayo omuto! Nkwegayirira olw'okusaasira kwa Katonda, bw'osaba Katonda okukutwala mu byobugagga eby'ekigambo kye, mu lubiri Kristo mw'abeera, kikole ng'oyo eyeewaayo nga ssaddaaka ennamu, ng'oli mwetegefu okukola kyonna Katonda ky'anaayogera.

Tolowooza nti kino kya bumanguki. Kirina omugaso omungi okusinga bw'omanyi. Kino kibula mu kusoma Baibuli emirundi mingi okusinga bw'olowooza. Kinoonye n'obwetoowaze obungi. Ekisooka ekyetaagisa okusanyukira emmere yo kwe njala. Ekisooka ekyetaagisa mu kusoma Baibuli kwe kwegomba okwangu, okunywevu, okuzuula Katonda ky'ayagala okole, n'okumalirira okw'amazima ennyo okukikola. "Buli ayagala okukola Katonda by'ayagala, ategeera obanga bye njigiriza biva eri Katonda oba mba njogera byange ku bwange." eri oyo ekigambo kya Katonda kirimubikkulirwa.

fields.title: Emikisa gy'Oyo Akola
fields.body_html:
Mubeerenga bakozi ba kigambo, so si abakiwulira ne batakikola, nga mwerimbarimba. Kubanga omuntu awuliriza ekigambo naye n'atakigondera, afaanana ng'omuntu eyeeraba mu ndabirwamu; bw'ava mu ndabirwamu, amangwago ne yeerabira nga bw'afaananye. Naye oyo atunula enkaliriza mu tteeka ettuufu erituukiridde erireetera abantu eddembe, n'alinyikiririramu tajja kukoma ku kulijjukiranga kyokka, naye ajjanga kukola bye ligamba, era anaaweebwanga omukisa mu buli ky'akola.” Yakobo 1:22-25. Nga kya bulimba eky'entiisa, omuntu okumatira ku kuwulira kigambo, n'asanyukira okukiwulira, kyokka n'atakikola! Era nga kya bulijjo nnyo ekyennyamivu, okulaba ebibinja by'Abakristaayo abawuliriza ekigambo kya Katonda buli lunaku n'obunyiikivu bungi, kyokka nga tebakikola. Singa omuweereza waabwe ye yakola bw'atyo, ng'awulira naye nga takola, omusango gwandibadde gutya? Kyokka olw'obulimba obwo okuba nga bujjuvu bwe butyo, tebamanya ddala nga tebatambulira mu bulamu bulungi obw'Ekikristaayo. Kiki ekiyinza okutulimbalimba bwe kityo? Waliwo ekisinga ekimu. Ekimu kye kino: abantu bawubya essanyu lye bafuna mu kuwulira ne baliteeka mu kifo ky'eddiini n'okusinza. Omutima gusanyukira okuteekebwa amazima mu maaso gaagwo mu bulungi; okulowooza kusiimibwa olw'ebifaananyi byakwo; n'enneewulira zikwatibwako olw'okukozesebwa kwago.

Eri omutima omunyiikivu, okumanya kuleeta essanyu. Omuntu ayinza okusoma ekitundu eky'okunoonyereza —ng'eby'amasannyalaze— olw'essanyu ery'okumanya kw'akuleeta, nga talina na katono ku kigendererwa eky'okukukozesa mu bulamu. Bwe kityo n'abantu bagenda mu kkanisa ne basanyukira okubuulira, kyokka ne batakola Katonda ky'abasaba. Omuntu atakyusibwa n'oyo eyakyusibwa bonna baamatira okweyongera okukola n'okwatula, ate nga bakola ebintu bye batasaanira kukola. Ensonga endala ey'obulimba buno kwe kukyamya okw'entiisa okw'enjigiriza ey'obunafu bwaffe eri ekirungi. Ekisa kya Kristo eky'okutusobozesa okugonda, okututangira okwonoona, n'okututukuza ddala, kikkirizibwa katono nnyo, ne kiba nti abantu balowooza nga bwe kiri nti kibagwanira okwonoona. Katonda tayinza kubasuubira kugonda kutuufu, kubanga amanyi nga tebasobola kukukola. Ensobi eno etema omulandira gwennyini ogw'ekigendererwa ekinywevu eky'okukola byonna Katonda by'ayogedde. Eziba omutima eri okwegomba kwonna okw'amaanyi okukkiriza n'okulaba byonna ekisa kya Katonda bye kiyinza okukola mu ffe, era ereka abantu nga beematira mu kibi. Okuwulira naye nga tokola —nga bwe kya bulimba eky'entiisa eky'okwerimba.

Waliwo ensonga ey'okusatu, eyeekuusa nnyo ku kusoma Baibuli mu kyama. Okuwulira oba okusoma kutwalibwa ng'obuvunaanyizibwa, n'okusoma kwennyini kutwalibwa ng'obuvunaanyizibwa, era okukukola kubalibwa ng'okuweereza okw'eddiini. Tumaze eddakiika ttaano oba kkumi mu makya nga tusoma; tusomye n'okulowooza n'obwegendereza; tugezezzaako okutegeera ekyo kye tusomye: obuvunaanyizibwa obutuukiriziddwa n'obwesigwa buwummuza omuntu munda, ne buleeta okumatira.

Ate nga tewali kutegeera na katono ku butaliimu, era n'ekisingawo ku ekyo, ku maanyi ag'okukakanyaza ag'obuvunaanyizibwa obukoleddwa oba ag'okumanya okufuniddwa, okuggyako nga tuvaayo n'omutima gwaffe gwonna nga tumaliridde ddala okukola era okuba nga ekigambo kya Katonda bwe kigamba nti Ye ky'ayagala tubeere era ky'asobola okutufuula. Obulimba obw'entiisa! “Mubeerenga bakozi ba kigambo, so si abakiwulira ne batakikola, nga mwerimbarimba.” Yakobo 1:22.

Mu kisenge eky'omunda, mu kukuuma kwa makya, obulimba buno mwe busaanira okulwanyisibwa n'okuwangulwa. Tuyinza okulaba nga bujja kutabula okusoma kwaffe Baibuli okwa bulijjo, ne butuleetera okusigala emabega mu bitundu byaffe. Tekyetaagisa kukola bwe kityo. Naye kisingako obulungi bwe kyandikoze bwe kityo, okusinga ensonga eno okusigala nga ya kubuusabuusa era nga tennasalibwawo. Buli kimu kyesigamye ku kino. Mukama waffe Yesu yagamba nti: “Omuntu yenna bw'aba ayagala okukola Katonda by'ayagala, alimanya obanga okuyigiriza kuva eri Katonda.” Mutima gwokka ogusanyukira etteeka lya Katonda era ogumaliridde ddala mu kukola lyo, gwe guyinza okufuna omusana ogw'obwakatonda, ogutegeera mu mwoyo okuyigiriza kwa Kristo mu nsibuko yaakwo ey'obwakatonda n'amaanyi gaakwo. Awatali kwagala kuno okukola, okumanya kwaffe tekugenda kutugasa: kuba kumanya kwa mutwe kwokka.

Mu bulamu, mu by'okunoonyereza ne mu by'obukugu, ne mu by'obusuubuzi, ekkubo lyokka ery'okumanya ddala, kwe kukola. Ekyo omuntu ky'atasobola kukola takimanyidde ddala. Ekkubo lyokka ery'okumanya Katonda, okukomba ku bulungi bwe, kwe kukola by'ayagala. Ekyo kye kikakasa obanga Katonda gwe njatula ye Katonda ow'enneewulira zange n'ebirowoozo byange, oba ye Katonda ow'amazima era omulamu afuga era akola byonna. Mu kukola by'ayagala mwokka mwe nkakasa nti mbyagala era mbikkiriza, ne neefuula omu nabyo. Ku ekyo, tewali kkubo n'erimu wansi w'eggulu ery'okugattibwa ku Katonda okuggyako okugattibwa ku by'ayagala mu kubikola.

Mu kusiriikirira kw'ekisenge eky'omunda, mu mwoyo gwe nsomamu Baibuli yange mu kyama, mu kumalirira kwe nsomamu Baibuli yange mu kyama, mu kumalirira kwe noonyeza ensonga eno okusalibwawo ddala era n'okugoberera enkomerero, nti nja kukola kyonna Katonda ky'agamba, omwo mwe obulimba obw'entiisa obw'okuwulira naye nga tokola bwe businga okuwangulwa. Kiyinza okutuyamba bwe tunaddira ekitundu ekimu eky'ekigambo kya Katonda ne tulaba nga bwe tusaanidde okukikwatamu.

Ka twogere nti kye Kubuulira okw'oku Lusozi. Ntandika n'Omukisa ogusooka: “Balina omukisa abaavu mu mwoyo.” Neebuuza nti— Kino kitegeeza ki? Ŋŋondera ekiragiro kino? Wadde katono, ndi munyiikivu ddala mu kunoonya buli lunaku okukuuma endowooza eno?

Bwe mpulira nga obuzaale bwange obw'amalala era obwesiga bwokka bwe buli ewala nnyo okuva ku kino, nneetegese okulinda, okwegayirira Kristo, n'okukkiriza nti asobola okukikola mu nze? Nja kukikola kino— okuba omwavu mu mwoyo? Oba nzija kuddamu okuba omuwulizi so si omukozi? Bwe ntyo nsobola okuyita mu Mikisa gyonna, ne mu kubuulira kwonna, n'okuyigiriza kwakwo ku buwombeefu n'okusaasira, ku kwagala n'obutuukirivu, ku kukola buli kimu ng'eri Kitaffe, ne mu buli kimu okumwesiga, ku kukola by'ayagala n'ebigambo bya Kristo, ne neebuuza nti— Mmanyi kino kye kitegeeza? Mbitambuliramu? Mbikola? Ndi ekyo ky'ayogera?

Era nga bulijjo, eky'okuddamu bwe kijja— Ntidde nti nedda, silaba ngeri yonna ey'okutambula bwe ntyo na kukola ky'agamba— nnaakulemberwa okuwulira obwetaavu obw'okwekebejja ddala okuggya byombi, enzikiriza yange n'empisa zange.

Era nnaabuuza obanga obweyamo, nti kyonna ky'agamba nja kukikola, bwe bwali bumaze okutwala ekifo, oba mu kusoma kwange Baibuli oba mu bulamu bwange, kye yeetaaga okubeera nakyo. Mmanyi nti okwebuuza okufaanana bwe kityo kuyinza okutandika okukola mu nze ne kunkulembera mu kutegeera okuggya ddala obwetaavu bwange obwa Kristo anaafuuwa mu nze obulamu bwe, n'akola mu nze byonna by'ayogera. Nnaafuna obuvumu mu kukkiriza okugamba nti: Ebintu byonna nsobola okubikola mu oyo ampa amaanyi: kyonna ky'ayogera mu Kigambo kye, nnaakikola.

fields.title: Okukuuma Ebiragiro bya Kristo
fields.body_html:
“Bwe mumanya ebintu bino muba n'omukisa bwe mubikola.” — Yokaana 13:17.

Omukisa n'essanyu ery'Ekigambo kya Katonda bimanyibwa bwokka olw'okukikola. Ensonga eno nkulu nnyo mu bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo, era n'olwekyo mu kusoma kwaffe Baibuli, ne kimpaliriza okukusaba tuddeeyo gye buli omulundi omulala. Era ku mulundi guno ka tuddire ekigambo kimu kyokka, okukuuma ekigambo, oba okukuuma ebiragiro. Ka tukisookere mu kwogera okw'okusiibula. Oyinza okuba ng'omanyidde ebitundu bino, naye kijja kutugasa okubyekebejja awamu.

“Kale obanga munjagala mugonderenga ebiragiro byange. Nange ndisaba Kitange n'abawa Omubeezi omulala” (Yokaana 14:15, 16).

“Buli anjagala anaagonderanga ebiragiro byange; era kubanga anjagala, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga. Era nange nnaamwagalanga, era nnaamulabikiranga.” (olunyiriri 21) “Omuntu yenna anjagala anaagonderanga ekigambo kyange, ne Kitange anaamwagalanga, era Nze ne Kitange tunajjanga ne tubeera mu ye era tunaatuulanga mu ye.” (olunyiriri 23) “Bwe munaabeera mu Nze, n'ebigambo byange ne bibeera mu mmwe, musabe kyonna kye mwagala, era kinaabakolerwa.” (15:7) “Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange, munaabeeranga mu kwagala kwange, nga nange bwe ngondera ebiragiro bya Kitange era ne mbeera mu kwagala kwe.” (15:10) “Muli mikwano gyange bwe munaakolanga bye mbalagira.” (15:14).

Yiga era ogeraageranye ebitundu bino, okutuusa ebigambo lwe biriyingira mu mutima ne bikola okukakasa okw'ekitundu nti okukuuma ebiragiro bya Kristo y'embeera etayinza kubulako mu buli mukisa gwa mwoyo ogw'amazima. Olw'okujja kwa Katonda Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n'okubeera kwe ddala munda, olw'okusanyukira okwagala kwa Kitaffe, okulabika kwa Kristo munda, okutuula kwa Kitaffe n'Omwana mu mutima, amaanyi g'okusaba, okubeera mu kwagala kwa Kristo, n'okusanyukira omukwano gwe, okukuuma ebiragiro kye kimu ekyetaagibwa.

Era olw'amaanyi ag'okusaba n'okusanyukira emikisa gino mu kukkiriza buli lunaku, okutegeera okufaanana ng'okw'omwana nti tugikuuma nakwo tekuyinza kubulako. Era ekitasingako kwetaagibwa, olw'okusoma Baibuli okubala ebibala, kwe kukakasa okusirifu okugumira okusuubira omusana n'amaanyi eby'obwakatonda ku buli kigambo kya Katonda, kubanga amanyi nga tuli beetegefu okugonda okutuusa ku nkomerero ddala.

Mu kwagala kwa Katonda, okusanyukirwamu, era okukolebwa, mwe muli ekkubo lyaffe lyokka eridda ku mutima gwa Kitaffe, era n'ekkubo lye lyokka eridda ku mutima gwaffe.

Kuuma ebiragiro: lino lye kkubo eridda ku buli mukisa. Laba engeri kino gye kikakasibwamu mu ngeri ey'ekitalo ebyo bye tusanga mu bbaluwa ya Yokaana ey'olubereberye.

“Bwe tugondera ebiragiro bye, kye kikakasa nti tumutegeera. Kyokka oyo agamba nti amutegeera n'atakuuma biragiro bye, aba mulimba, era si wa mazima. Naye buli agondera ekigambo kye, ddala ng'okwagala kwa Katonda kutuukiridde mu muntu oyo.” (1 Yokaana 2:3-5). Obukakafu bwokka obw'okumanya Katonda okw'amazima, okulamu era okulokola; obukakafu bwokka nti tetulimbalimbye mu ddiini yaffe; nti okwagala kwa Katonda si kwa kulowooza kwokka wabula kwa butonde, kwe kukuuma ekigambo kye.

“Emitima gyaffe bwe gitatusaliza musango, tuba n'obuvumu mu maaso ga Katonda; era kyonna kye tusaba tukifuna okuva gy'ali, kubanga tugondera ebiragiro bye era tukola ebimusanyusa. Buli akuuma ebiragiro bye abeera mu Katonda” (3:21, 22, ne 24). Okukuuma ebiragiro kye kyama eky'obuvumu eri Katonda, n'omukwano ogw'amazima ogw'oku lusegere naye.

“Kubanga kuno kwe kwagala kwa Katonda, nti tukuume ebiragiro bye. Kubanga buli eyazaalibwa Katonda awangula ensi.” (olunyiriri 3, 4).

Okwatula kwaffe okw'okwagala tekuliimu nsa, okuggyako nga kukakasibwa okuba okw'amazima olw'okukuuma ebiragiro bye mu maanyi ag'obulamu obuzaalibwa Katonda. Okumanya Katonda, okuba n'okwagala kwa Katonda okutuukiridde mu ffe, okuba n'obuvumu eri Katonda, okubeera mu ye, okuzaalibwa gy'ali, n'okumwagala— byonna byesigamye ku kimu kyokka— OKUKUUMA EBIRAGIRO.

Nga bwe tutegeera obukulu Kristo n'ebyawandiikibwa bwe biwa amazima gano, olwo lwe tuliyiga okugawa obukulu bwe bumu mu bulamu bwaffe. Kijja kutufuukira ekimu ku bisumuluzo eby'okusoma Baibuli okw'amazima. Omuntu asoma Baibuli ye n'okwegomba n'ekigendererwa ekinywevu okunoonya n'okugondera buli kiragiro kya Katonda ne kya Kristo, aba ali mu kkubo ettuufu ery'okufuna omukisa gwonna ekigambo gwe kyagenderera okuleeta. Ajja kuyiga ebintu bibiri ebisingira ddala. Engeri gy'ayetaagira okulinda okuyigiriza kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okumukulembera mu kwagala kwa Katonda kwonna, n'omukisa oguli mu kukola obuvunaanyizibwa obwa buli lunaku, si lwa kubanga butuufu, oba abusanyukira, wabula kubanga kwe kwagala kwa Katonda. Ajja kulaba engeri obulamu bwonna obwa buli lunaku bwe bugulumizibwa, bw'agamba nga Kristo bwe yagamba nti: “Ekiragiro kino nakiweebwa Kitange.” Ekigambo kijja kufuuka omusana n'omukulembeze amakubo ge gonna mwe gategekebwa.

Obulamu bwe bujja kufuuka essomero ery'okutendekebwa amaanyi g'Ekigambo agatukuza mwe gakakasibwa, era n'okuzzibwamu amaanyi. Bwe kityo okukuuma ebiragiro kujja kuba ekisumuluzo eky'obuli mukisa gwa mwoyo.

Fuba n'obumalirivu okutegeera obulamu buno obw'okugonda okutuukiridde bye butegeeza. Ddira ebimu ku biragiro bya Kristo ebisingira ddala okutegeerekeka:— Mwagalanenga nga nze bwe mbaagala; musaana okunaazagananga ebigere; era nammwe mukolenga nga Nze bwe mbakoze: era kkiriza okwagala n'obwetoowaze obufaanana obwa Kristo ng'etteeka ery'obulamu obw'ekitalo bw'ogenda okutambulira. Awatali kuleka enneewulira ey'okugwa oba ey'obunafu okukutwala mu kuggwaamu essuubi, oba okuwummulira mu ekyo ky'olowooza nti kisoboka, kikuzzeemu bwokka amaanyi okuteeka essuubi lyo lyonna ku Ye, anaakola mu ggwe ng'ayita mu Mwoyo we okwagala n'okukola.

Nate, ekigendererwa kyaffe kimu kiteekwa okuba enteekateeka entuufu wakati w'omwoyo omulamuzi n'empisa. Buli kukakasa kuteekwa okutuukirizibwa mu bikolwa. Ebiragiro bya Kristo byagenderera okugonderwa. Bino bwe bitakolebwa, okukuŋŋaanya okumanya kw'Ebyawandiikibwa kuleeta kizikiza kwokka era kukakanyaza, ne kukola okumatira n'essanyu okumanya kwe kuleeta, ekitutafuula abasaanira okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo.

Nsaba muleme okukoowa olw'okuddiŋŋana kwange emirundi mingi obubaka obw'omukisa era obw'ekitiibwa. Mu kisenge kyo eky'omunda, ekibuuzo mwe kiteekwa okusalibwawo obanga oliyita mu lunaku ng'okuuma ebiragiro bya Kristo. Era eyo mwe kiriramulwa obanga mu bulamu obw'omu maaso oliba n'empisa ez'omuntu eyeewaayo ddala okumanya n'okukola Katonda by'ayagala.

fields.title: Obulamu n'Okumanya
fields.body_html:
“Mukama Katonda n'ameza mu ttaka buli muti ogusanyusa amaaso era omulungi okulya. Omuti ogw'obulamu gwali wakati mu nnimiro, n'omuti ogw'okumanya ekirungi n'ekibi.” — Olubereberye 2:9.

Waliwo engeri bbiri ez'okumanya ebintu. Emu eri mu kutegeera olw'ennukuta oba endowooza; mmanyi ebifa ku kintu. Endala eri mu bulamu; mmanya olw'okulaba okw'omunda. Omuzibe w'amaaso, omugezi, ayinza okumanya byonna eby'okunoonyereza bye biyigiriza ku musana, olw'okusomerwa ebitabo. Naye omwana, oba omuntu ow'omu nsiko, ataali yalowoozako ku musana kye kiri, amanyi obulungi okusinga ennyo omuyivu omuzibe w'amaaso. Ono amanyi byonna ebigufaako olw'okulowooza; oli agumanya mu butuufu olw'okugulaba n'okugusanyukira.

Bwe kityo bwe kiri ne mu ddiini. Omutima gusobola okukola ebirowoozo ku Katonda okuva mu Baibuli, ne gumanya enjigiriza zonna ez'obulokozi, so ng'obulamu obw'omunda tebumanyi maanyi ga Katonda ag'okulokola. Kyetuva tusoma nti “Buli atayagala tamanyi Katonda, kubanga Katonda kwagala.” Ayinza okwogera ebirowoozo ebirungi ku ekyo; naye bw'atayagala, tamanyi Katonda. Kwagala kwokka kwe kusobola okumanya Katonda. Okumanya Katonda bwe bulamu obutaggwaawo.

Ekigambo kya Katonda kye kigambo eky'obulamu. Mu mutima mwe muva ensulo z'obulamu. Obulamu buyinza okuba obw'amaanyi, ne mu kifo okumanya mu mutima we kunafuwa. N'okumanya kuyinza okuba ekigendererwa eky'okunoonya okunyiikivu ennyo n'essanyu eddene, so ng'obulamu tebukwatibwako kwo.

Ekyokulabirako kiyinza okukitegeeza bulungi. Ka twogere nti tusobola okuwa omuti gw'ffaayo okutegeera, n'amaaso ag'okulaba n'okukola, kino kiyinza okusobozesa omuti gw'ffaayo okwekolera gwokka ekyo omulimi ky'akola kaakano, okukuŋŋaanya obusa oba okuleeta obunnyogovu. Naye obulamu obw'omunda obw'omuti gw'ffaayo bwandisigadde bwe bumu, nga bwa njawulo ddala n'okutegeera okwali kwongeddwako. Bwe kityo n'obulamu obw'omunda obw'obwakatonda mu muntu kintu kya njawulo ddala n'amagezi g'amanyisa ebigufaako. Amagezi ago getaagibwa nnyo ddala, okuwa omutima Ekigambo kya Katonda Omwoyo Omutukuvu ky'asobola okuzuukusa. Kyokka nga tegalina maanyi n'akatono, wadde okuwa oba okuzuukusa obulamu obw'amazima. Muweereza bwereza atwala emmere: mutima gwe guteekwa okulya, ne guliisibwa ne gubeera omulamu.

Emiti ebiri egyali mu Lusuku lwa Katonda kwe kubikkulirwa kwa Katonda okw'amazima gagwo gamu. Singa Adamu yalidde ku muti ogw'obulamu, yandifunye era n'amanya obulungi bwonna Katonda bwe yali amuteekeddeteekedde mu maanyi amalamu ng'ekyabaawo. Yandimanyi ekibi olw'okuba nga taliiko kye kimukwatako n'akatono. Naye Kaawa yabuzibwa okwegomba okumanya— “ekibala kyali kyegombebwa okumugeziwaza,” omuntu n'afuna okumanya ekirungi nga takirina, ng'akimanyira mu kibi kyokka ekyali ekyawukanako nakyo. Okuva ku lunaku olwo, omuntu anoonyezza ddiini ye mu kumanya okusinga mu bulamu.

Bulamu bwokka, okulaba, n'okuba ne Katonda, n'obulungi bwe, kwe kuwa okumanya okw'amazima. Okumanya okw'amagezi tekuyinza kuzuukusa. “Ne bwe mba n'ekirabo eky'okwogera eby'obunnabbi, ne ntegeera ebyama byonna, era ne mmanya ebintu byonna, era ne bwe mba n'okukkiriza okungi ne kunsobozesa n'okusiguukulula ensozi, naye nga sirina kwagala, mba siri kintu.” 1 Abakkolinso 13:2. Mu kusoma kwaffe Baibuli okwa buli lunaku mwe tusisinkana akabi kano; era eyo mwe kasaanira okusisinkanwa n'okuwangulwa. Twetaaga amagezi okuwulira n'okutegeera ekigambo kya Katonda mu makulu gaakyo ag'ekimuntu. Naye twetaaga okumanya nti okuba n'amazima olw'amagezi tekuyinza kugasa okuggyako ng'Omwoyo Omutukuvu bwe gakifuula obulamu n'amazima mu mutima. Twetaaga okuwaayo emitima gyaffe ne tulindirira Katonda n'okugonda okusirifu n'okukkiriza akole mu ffe ng'ayita mu Mwoyo oyo. Kino nga kifuuka akalombolombo akatukuvu, tuliyiga obukugu obw'amagezi n'omutima nga bikola mu nteekateeka entuufu, nga buli kutambula kw'amagezi kugenderako okutambula kw'omutima okukwenkanankana, nga lulindirira era nga luwuliriza okuyigiriza kw'Omwoyo.

fields.title: Omutima N'Amagezi
fields.body_html:
"Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka." Engero 3:5 Ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’ekitabo ky’Engero kwe kuyigiriza okumanya n’okwawula ekirungi n’ekibi, n’okuluŋŋamya mu kkubo ery’amagezi n’okutegeera. Okutegeera obutuukirivu, okutegeera okutya Mukama, n’okufuna okutegeera okulungi — kye kigendererwa Engero mwe zaagala okutuluŋŋamya. Naye zituwa okulabula nti mu kunoonya kuno, twawule wakati w’okwesiga amagezi gaffe n’obwongo bwaffe, n’okunoonya okutegeera okw’omwoyo, okwo Katonda kw’awa, ye mutima ogutegeera, so teweesigama ku magezi go gokka.

Mu kunoonya kwaffe kwonna okumanya n’amagezi, mu kuteekateeka kwaffe kwonna obulamu bwaffe, oba mu kwekenneenya Ekigambo, tulina amaanyi abiri gano — okutegeera oba obwongo, obumanya ebintu okuva ebweru, mu buzaale n’endowooza ze tukola, n’omutima, ogubimanyira mu bumanyirivu nga gubitwala mu kusalawo n’okwegomba.

Nkakasa nnyo nti emu ku nsonga enkulu lwaki okuyigiriza kwa Baibuli okungi n’okumanya kwa Baibuli tebibala nnyingi, emu ku nsonga enkulu ez’obutaba na butukuvu, n’obutewaayo, n’obutaba na maanyi mu Kkanisa, eri wano — kwe kwesiga amagezi gaffe gokka mu by’eddiini. Neegayirira abasomi bange bampulirize n’obugumiikiriza wano.

Bangi bawakana nti: Naye mazima Katonda ye yatuwa obwongo bwaffe, era awatali bwo tewali ngeri ya kumanya kigambo kya Katonda. Kya mazima nnyo; naye wuliriza. Olw’okugwa kw’omuntu, obuntu bwaffe bwonna bwayonooneka. Okusalawo kwafuuka omuddu, okwegomba kwakyamizibwa, n’okutegeera ne kufuuka ekizikiza. Bonna bakkiriza okuzikirira kw’okugwa mu bibiri ebisooka, naye mu ngeri ey’amazima bakigaana mu eky’oluvannyuma. Bakkiriza nti ne wano omukkiriza talina mu ye yekka amaanyi ag’okusalawo okutukuvu, era yeetaaga okuzzibwa obuggya buli lunaku olw’ekisa kya Yesu Kristo.

Bakkiriza nti talina amaanyi ag’okwagala okutukuvu, okwagala Katonda ne muliraanwa we, okuggyako nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw’akiwandiika mu ye obutakoowa. Naye tebategeera nti n’obwongo nabwo mu by’omwoyo bwayonooneka era tebulina maanyi, so tebusobola kutegeera mazima ga mwoyo.

Kyali kwegomba kumanya, mu ngeri ne mu kiseera Katonda kye yali agaanye, okwo kwe kwabuza Kaawa, ng’ekyava mu kukemebwa. Okulowooza nti tuyinza okwenoonyeza ffe bennyini okumanya amazima ga Katonda okuva mu kigambo kye nga bwe twagala, kikyali akabi kaffe akasingira ddala obunene.

Tuulina okukakasa okw’amaanyi nti amagezi gaffe tegasobola kumanya mazima ddala, era nti waliwo akabi akatiisa ak’okwesiga ffekka n’okwerimba mu kukola bwe kityo, tulyoke tulabe obwetaavu bw’ekigambo kino nti, "Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka." Engero 3:5 Omuntu akkiriza n’omutima. Twagala okunoonya, okuweereza, n’okwagala Katonda n’omutima gwaffe gwonna. Omuntu akkiriza n’omutima gwokka. Twagala okunoonya, okuweereza, n’okwagala Katonda n’emitima gyaffe gyonna. Tuyinza okumanya Katonda, oba okusinza Katonda, mu mwoyo ne mu mazima, n’omutima gwokka. Noolwekyo, mu mutima Ekigambo kya Katonda mwe kikolera omulimu. Mu mutima gwaffe Katonda mw’atumidde Omwoyo ogw’Omwana we. Gwe mutima, obulamu obw’omunda obw’okwegomba n’okwagala n’okusalawo n’okweweerayo, Omwoyo Omutukuvu gw’aluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna.

Mu kwekenneenya Baibuli, "Weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna, so teweesigamanga ku magezi go gokka." Toweesiga, weesigemu ddala amagezi go gokka. Gasobola kukuwa ndowooza n’okuteebereza ku by’obwakatonda awatali mazima. Ganaakulimba n’endowooza nti amazima, bwe gayingira mu bwongo, mu ngeri emu ganaayingira mu mutima. Bwe gatyo ganaakuziba amaaso oleme okulaba ekintu ekibaawo eri buli muntu, nti abantu basoma buli lunaku, era buli Ssande ne basanyukira okuwulira Ekigambo kya Katonda, naye ne kitabafuula beetoowaze, wadde batukuvu, wadde ab’endowooza ey’omu ggulu.

Mu kifo ky’okwesiga amagezi, jjira ku Baibuli n’omutima.

Mu kifo ky’okwesiga amagezi, weesige Mukama n’omutima gwo gwonna. Bw’oyingira mu kisenge kyo eky’omunda, si magezi, wabula omutima gwonna oguteeze eri Katonda omulamu ng’Omusomesa, gwe gube ekintu ekikulu. Kale onoofuna okutegeera okulungi. Katonda anaakuwa omutima ogutegeera, okutegeera okw’omwoyo.

Oyinza okumbuuza, nga bwe mbadde mbuuzibwa emirundi mingi, nti, "Naye nkole ntya? Nnyige ntya Baibuli yange? Sirabaayo ngeri ya kukikola, wabula okukozesa amagezi." Kituufu ddala. Naye togakozesa mu ekyo bye gatasobola kukola. Jjukira ebintu bibiri. Ekimu kiri nti gasobola kukuwa kifaananyi oba ndowooza ku by’omwoyo. Amangu ddala nga gamaze okukikola, genda n’omutima gwo eri Mukama afuule Ekigambo kye obulamu n’amazima mu ggwe. Ekyokubiri, jjukira nti amalala g’obwongo, n’akabi ak’okwesigama ku magezi go gokka, tekulekera, era nti tewali kintu, wadde ekigendererwa ekinywevu ennyo, kiyinza okukununula ku kino, wabula okwesigama kw’omutima okutakoma ku kuyigiriza kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Omwoyo Omutukuvu asobola okuluŋŋamya obwongo bwokka ng’aleeta ekigambo obulamu mu mutima, mu mpisa n’okwegomba. "Abawombeefu abaluŋŋamya mu kkubo ettuufu n’abayigiriza ekkubo lye." Zabbuli 25:9 "Mu kutya Mukama" — empisa — "amagezi mwe gasookera." Engero 9:10 Ku buli ndowooza obwongo bwe bukwata okuva mu kigambo, vuunama mu maaso ga Katonda ng’weesiga era ng’oyeekwasa ye. Kkiriza n’omutima gwo gwonna nti Katonda asobola era ajja kukifuula kya mazima. Saba Omwoyo Omutukuvu akifuule ekikolera mu mutima. Bwe kityo ekigambo kifuuka amaanyi ag’obulamu bwaffe.

Nyiikira mu kino, n’ekiseera kirituuka Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ng’abeera mu mutima ne mu bulamu, lw’aliteeka amagezi mu buwulize, n’aleka omusana gwe omutukuvu ne guyakira mu go.

fields.title: Ebirowoozo bya Katonda N'Ebirowoozo Byaffe
fields.body_html:
"Ng’eggulu bwe liri waggulu okukira n’ensi, bwe gatyo amakubo gange bwe gali ewala ennyo n’amakubo gammwe, n’ebirowoozo byange bwe biri eri ebirowoozo byammwe." Isaaya 55:9 Ku nsi, ebigambo by’omuntu ow’amagezi emirundi mingi bitegeeza ekintu eky’enjawulo ku ekyo awuliriza ky’ategeera. Kale nga kya bwerere nti ebigambo bya Katonda, nga ye bw’abitegeera, bitegeeza ekintu ekisingira ddala waggulu okusinga ffe bwe tukibategeera amangu.

Waliwo obwetaavu bunene nnyo obw’okujjukira kino. Okukikola kunaatuggya bulijjo ku kumatira mu kumanya kwaffe n’endowooza zaffe ku kigambo, ne kutuleeta ku kwewuunya n’okulindirira omukisa gwakyo ogujjuvu nga Katonda bwe yakigenderera. Kunaawa okusaba kwaffe okw’okuyigiriza kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu ekigendererwa ekiggya n’obwangu obungi, ne kutulaga ekyo ekitannayingira mu mutima gwaffe kutegeera. Kunaawa obwesige eri essuubi nti waliwo eri ffe, ne mu bulamu buno, okutuukirira okusinga ebirowoozo byaffe ebisingira ddala waggulu.

Bw’atyo ekigambo kya Katonda kirina amakulu abiri. Akamu ke kalina mu birowoozo bya Katonda, ne kafuula ebigambo by’abantu okuba ababeezi b’ekitiibwa kyonna eky’amagezi, n’amaanyi, n’okwagala kwa Katonda. Akalala kwe kutegeera kwaffe okunafu, okw’ekitundu, era okuliko obulema. Ne ng’ekisa n’obumanyirivu bimaze okufuula ebigambo ng’okwagala kwa Katonda, ekisa kya Katonda, amaanyi ga Katonda, oba kimu ku bisuubizo ebingi ebikwatagana n’ebyo, okuba amazima era eby’ennyini gye tuli, wakyaliwo obujjuvu obutaggwaawo mu kigambo bwe tutannamanya. Nga kino kyayogerwa mu ngeri ey’amaanyi mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe okuva mu Isaaya!

"Ng’eggulu bwe liri waggulu okukira n’ensi." Okukkiriza kwaffe mu kintu kino kwangu era kya lwatu nnyo, ne watabaawo n’omu ayinza kulowooza kugezaako n’omukono gwe omutono okutuuka ku njuba oba ku mmunyeenye. Okulinnya olusozi olusinga obugulumivu tekyandigasa. Tukikkiriza n’omutima gwaffe gwonna. Ne kaakano Katonda agamba nti, era bwe kityo, "ebirowoozo byange biri waggulu okukira ebirowoozo byammwe." Ne ng’ekigambo kimaze okwatula ebirowoozo bya Katonda, n’ebirowoozo byaffe ne bigezaako okubitegeera, bikyasigala waggulu w’ebirowoozo byaffe nga bwe ggulu bwe liri waggulu okukira ensi. Obutaggwaawo bwonna obwa Katonda n’ensi ey’emirembe gyonna bibeera mu kigambo ng’ensigo y’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Era ng’omuti omunene ogukuze bwe gusinga mu ngeri ey’ekyama akasigo mwe gwava, bwe gatyo ebigambo bya Katonda nga nsigo, ebyamagero bya Katonda eby’amaanyi eby’ekisa n’amaanyi mwe biyinza okumeruka.

Okukkiriza mu kigambo kino kusaanidde okutuyigiriza ebintu bibiri, ekimu eky’obutamanya, ekirala eky’okusuubira. Tusaanidde okuyiga okujja ku kigambo ng’abaana abato.

Yesu yagamba nti, "Nkwebaza, Kitange, Mukama w’eggulu n’ensi, kubanga wakwese ebintu bino ab’amagezi n’abategeevu, n’obibikkulira abaana abato." Ab’amagezi n’abategeevu si bwe kiri bulijjo bannanfuusi oba balabe. Waliwo bangi ku baana ba Katonda be yeyagala, abaakisibwa amazima olw’obutanyiikira kukuza mwoyo gwa mwana, ne beesigama nga tebamanyiridde ku bya kyawandiikibwa eby’enzikiriza yaabwe, oba obwesigwa bw’okwekenneenya kwabwe okw’omwoyo, ne batafuuka bantu ba mwoyo. "Kubanga ani amanyi ebirowoozo by’omuntu okuggyako omwoyo gw’omuntu oyo oguli mu ye? Bwe kityo ne bwe kiri, tewali amanyi birowoozo bya Katonda okuggyako Omwoyo gwa Katonda. Kaakano twafuna, si mwoyo gwa nsi, wabula Omwoyo ava eri Katonda, tulyoke tutegeere ebintu Katonda bye yatuwa obuwa." Ka okutegeera okw’amaanyi okw’obutamanya bwaffe, n’obutesiga bwaffe obungi ku maanyi gaffe ag’okutegeera n’ebintu bya Katonda, kubeere akabonero ku kwekenneenya kwaffe Baibuli.

Gye tukoma okuggwaamu essuubi ery’okuyingira bulungi mu birowoozo bya Katonda, gye kuyinza okweyongera obwesige obw’okusuubira. Katonda ayagala okufuula ekigambo kye amazima mu ffe. "Abaana bo bonna baliyigirizibwa Mukama." Omwoyo Omutukuvu ali dda mu ffe okubikkula ebintu bya Katonda. Nga Katonda addamu okusaba kwaffe okw’obwetoowaze n’okukkiriza, ajja, okuyita mu ye, okutuwa okutegeera okugenda kweyongera ku kyama kya Katonda — obumu bwaffe obw’ekitalo n’okufaanana Kristo, okubeera kwe mu ffe, n’okuba kwaffe nga ye bwe yali mu nsi eno.

Weewaawo, n’okusingawo — emitima gyaffe bwe girumwa ennyonta era ne gikirindirira, ekiseera kiyinza okutuuka, mu kutuweereza kw’Omwoyo gwe okw’enjawulo, okwegomba kwaffe kwonna lwe kunaakkusibwa, ne Kristo n’atwala omutima bw’atyo, ekyo ekyali okukkiriza ebbanga eddene ne kifuuka obumanyirivu, nti ng’eggulu bwe liri waggulu okukira n’ensi, ebirowoozo bye biri waggulu okukira ebirowoozo byaffe.

fields.title: Okufumiitiriza
fields.body_html:
"Alina omukisa omuntu atatambulira mu kuteesa kw’ababi, era atayimirira mu kibiina ky’ababi, newaakubadde okutuula n’abo abanyooma ebya Katonda; naye asanyukira okugondera amateeka ga Mukama, era mu mateeka ago mw’alowooleza emisana n’ekiro." Zabbuli 1:1-2.
