Yoswa 1:8. Zabbuli 119:15, 23, 48, 78, 97, 99 ne 148. 1 Timoseewo 5:15.) "Nsaba ebigambo by’omu kamwa kange, n’okulowooza okw’omu mutima gwange, bisiimibwe mu maaso go, Ayi Mukama." Zabbuli 19:14 ne 49:3.

Ekigendererwa ekituufu eky’okusomesa, okwekenneenya, n’okusoma tekiri mu ekyo ekiyingizibwa mu kukozesa, wabula mu ekyo ekiggibwa mu ffe bennyini, olw’okuzuukusa amaanyi gaffe ag’omunda ne gakola. Kino kya mazima ku kwekenneenya Baibuli, nga bwe kiri ku kwekenneenya okulala kwonna. Ekigambo kya Katonda kikola omukisa gwakyo ogutuufu ng’amazima ge kituleetera gamaze okusiikuula obulamu obw’omunda ne geezaala mu kumalirira, mu kwesiga, mu kwagala, oba mu kusinza. Omutima bwe gumaze okufuna ekigambo nga kuyita mu bwongo, n’amaanyi gaakyo ag’omwoyo ne gakoowoolwa ne gakolebwako, ekigambo tekikyali kya bwerere, wabula kikoze ekyo buli Katonda gy’akitumye. Kifuuse kitundu ku bulamu bwaffe, ne kituwa amaanyi olw’ekigendererwa ekiggya n’okufuba.

Mu kufumiitiriza omutima mwe gukwatira ne gwefunira Ekigambo. Nga bwe kiri mu kulowooza obwongo bwe bukwata amakulu gonna n’ebikwatagana n’amazima, bwe kityo mu kufumiitiriza, omutima gugafuula ogwaffe ne gugafuula ekitundu ky’obulamu bwagwo. Twetaaga okujjukizibwanga bulijjo nti omutima gutegeeza okusalawo n’okwegomba. Okufumiitiriza kw’omutima kutegeeza okwegomba, okukkiriza, okweweerayo, n’okwagala. Mu mutima mwe muva ebiva mu bulamu; ekyo omutima kye gukkiririza ddala, kye gwaniriza n’okwagala n’essanyu, era kye guleka kufuga n’okuvunaanya obulamu. Obwongo bukuŋŋaanya ne butegeka emmere gye tunaalya. Mu kufumiitiriza, omutima guyingiza emmere eyo ne gugiryako.

Obukugu obw’okufumiitiriza bwetaaga okukuzibwa. Ng’omuntu bw’ayeetaaga okutendekebwa okusseeko obwongo bwe okusobola okulowooza mu ngeri ennyonvu era entuufu, bw’atyo Omukristaayo yeetaaga okulowoozanga n’obwegendereza n’okufumiitiriza, okutuusa empisa entukuvu bw’etonze ey’okuzimba omutima gwonna ku buli kigambo kya Katonda.

Ekibuuzo oluusi kibuuzibwa, ku ngeri amaanyi gano ag’okufumiitiriza gye gayinza okukuzibwamu. Ekintu ekisookera ddala kwe kweyanjula mu maaso ga Katonda. Kye kigambo kye; Ekigambo ekyo tekirina maanyi ga mukisa awatali ye. Ekigambo kyateekebwa okutuleeta mu kubeerawo kwe n’obumu naye. Manyiira okubeerawo kwe, era twala ekigambo nga kiva gy’ali n’obwesige nti anaakikola ne kikola bulungi mu mutima. Mu Zabbuli 119, olabamu ekigambo emirundi musanvu, naye buli mulundi nga kitundu ku kusaba okwolekezebwa Katonda. "Nnaafumiitirizanga ku biragiro byo." "Amateeka go nga ngagala nnyo!

Ngafumiitirizaako olunaku lwonna." Okufumiitiriza kwe kukyusa omutima ne gudda eri Katonda n’ekigambo kye ye, nga gunoonya okukitwala mu kwegomba ne mu kusalawo, mu bulamu bwagwo bwennyini.

Ekintu ekirala eky’okufumiitiriza okutuufu kwe kuwummula okusirifu. Mu kwekenneenya kwaffe ebyawandiikibwa, mu kufuba kwaffe okukwata empaka, oba okuwangula ekizibu, obwongo bwaffe emirundi mingi bwetaaga okuteekawo amaanyi gaabwo agasingira ddala. Empisa y’emmeeme eyeetaagibwa mu kufumiitiriza ya njawulo. Wano, tudda n’amazima ge tuzudde, oba ekyama mwe tulindirira okuyigirizibwa okuva eri Katonda, ne twekweka ekigambo kye tukoola mu buziba bw’omutima, ne tukkiriza nti, olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, amakulu gaakyo n’amaanyi gaakyo binaabikkulwa mu bulamu bwaffe obw’omunda.

"Laba, wenyumiririza mu mazima g’omunda, era onjigiriza amagezi mu bwama bw’omutima gwange." Mu kunnyonnyola nnyina wa Mukama waffe tugambibwa nti: "Maliyamu yakuuma ebigambo bino byonna, ng’abifumiitirizaako mu mutima gwe." Mu nnyina okukuuma ebigambo bino byonna mu mutima gwe, tufunamu ekifaananyi ky’emmeeme etandise okumanya Kristo, era eri mu kkubo ettereevu okumumanya obulungi. Tekyetaagisa nnyo kwongera kwogera nti mu kufumiitiriza, okukozesa ekigambo mu bulamu bw’omuntu ye kennyini kufuna ekifo ekikulu.

Kino tekiba wamu bimala mu kwekenneenya kwaffe Baibuli okw’obwongo. Ekigendererwa kyako kwe kumanya n’okutegeera. Mu kufumiitiriza, ekigendererwa ekikulu kwe kwefunira n’okumanyira mu bumanyirivu. Okuba obwetegefu okukkiriza buli kisuubizo awatali kubuusabuusa, okugondera buli kiragiro awatali kusookerwako, "okuyimirira nga tuutuukiridde era tuujjuvu mu kwagala kwa Katonda kwonna," gwe mwoyo gwokka ogutuufu ogw’okwekenneenya Baibuli.

Mu kufumiitiriza okusirifu okukkiriza kuno mwe kukolebwa, obugondevu buno mwe buweebwa, okweweerayo okujjuvu eri Katonda by’ayagala byonna mwe kukolerwa, n’obwesige obw’ekisa okutuukiriza obweyamo bwaffe mwe bufunirwa.

Ate era okufumiitiriza kuteekwa okutuusa ku kusaba. Kuwa ensonga ez’okusaba. Kuteekwa okutuusa ku kusaba, okusaba n’okufuna ddala ekyo kwe kulabye mu kigambo oba kwe kukkirizza mu kigambo. Omugaso gwakwo kwe kuba nti kwe kuteekateeka okw’okusaba, okwegayirira okugenderere era okw’omutima gwonna olw’ekyo omutima kye guwuliddemu ekigambo kye kibikkudde nga kyetaagibwa oba nga kisoboka. Ekyo kitegeeza nti okuwummula okw’okukkiriza kutunula waggulu n’obwesige nti ekigambo kinaggukamu ne kiraga amaanyi gaakyo, mu mmeeme eyeewaayo gye n’obwetoowaze n’obugumiikiriza.

Empeera ey’okuwummulako akaseera ku kufuba kw’obwongo, n’okukuza empisa ey’okufumiitiriza okutukuvu, eriba nti mu kiseera, ebibiri binaaleetebwa mu kukwatagana, era okwekenneenya kwaffe kwonna kunaddamu obulamu olw’omwoyo ogw’okulindirira Katonda mu kusirika, n’okuwaayo omutima n’obulamu eri ekigambo.

Obumu bwaffe ne Katonda bwateekebwa olw’olunaku lwonna. Omukisa ogw’okunyweza empisa ey’okufumiitiriza okutuufu mu kiseera eky’enkya guliba nti tunaasembezebwa okumpi n’omukisa gw’omuntu ali mu Zabbuli esooka; "asanyukira okugondera amateeka ga Mukama, era mu mateeka ago mw’alowooleza emisana n’ekiro."

Abakozi n’abakulembeze b’abantu ba Katonda bonna bajjukire nti bano bakyetaaga okusinga abalala bwe baba baagala okubayigiriza kino, n’okukuuma okuyita kwabwe bo bennyini nga tekukutuse n’ensibuko yokka ey’amaanyi n’omukisa. Katonda agamba nti, "Nnaabeeranga naawe. Siirikuleka wadde okukwabulira." "Beeranga wa maanyi era ne guma nnyo omwoyo, ng’ossaayo omwoyo okukola ng’amateeka gonna bwe gali... olyoke owangule buli gy’onaagenda. Ekitabo kino eky’amateeka tekivanga mu kamwa ko, naye onookifumiitirizangako emisana n’ekiro… olyoke owangule… Ba wa maanyi era guma omwoyo."

"Nsaba ebigambo by’omu kamwa kange, n’okulowooza okw’omu mutima gwange, bisiimibwe mu maaso go, Ayi Mukama, Olwazi lwange, era Omununuzi wange." Ekitali kya wansi w’ekyo kireme kubeera kigendererwa kyo — nti okufumiitiriza kwo kusiimibwe mu maaso ge — nga kitundu ku ssaddaaka ey’omwoyo gy’owaayo. Ekitali kya wansi w’ekyo kireme kubeera kusaba kwo n’okusuubira kwo, nti okufumiitiriza kwo kube okusinza okutuufu, okweweerayo okulamu okw’omutima eri Ekigambo kya Katonda mu maaso ge.

fields.title: Okubikkulirwa Abaana Abato
fields.body_html:
Nkwebaza, Kitange, Mukama w’eggulu n’ensi, kubanga ebintu bino wabikisa ab’amagezi n’abategeevu, naye n’obibikkulira abaana abato." Matayo 11:25, Lukka 10:21.

Ab’amagezi n’abategeevu be bantu abamanyi era abeesiga amaanyi g’ebirowoozo byabwe n’okutegeera kwabwe okubayamba mu kunoonya Okumanya kwa Katonda. Abaana be abo, abakola ekikulu si birowoozo n’amaanyi gaabyo, wabula omutima n’embeera yaagwo. Obutamanya, obunafu, okwesiga Katonda, obuwombeefu, okuyigirizika, okwesiga n’okwagala — zino ze mbeera Katonda z’anoonya mu abo b’ayigiriza. (Zabbuli 25:9, 12, 14, 17, 20.)

Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga obukulu mu kusaba kwaffe kwe kuyiga ekigambo kya Katonda. Kikulu nnyo nti bulijjo tusaana okusembeza ekigambo n’omwoyo ogulindirira Kitaffe okubikkula amazima gaakyo mu ffe. Era kikulu nnyo nti tusaana okuba n’embeera ey’obwana, weewaawo, embeera ey’obwana, Kitaffe gy’ayagala okubikkuliramu ebyama by’okwagala kwe. Eri ab’amagezi n’abategeevu, okumanya okw’omu mutwe kwe kusooka; okwo Katonda abakisa amakulu ag’omwoyo ag’ekintu kyennyini kye balowooza nti bakitegeera.

Eri abaana, si mutwe na kumanya kwagwo, wabula omutima n’okuwulira, embeera ey’obwetoowaze, okwagala n’okwesiga, kye kisooka, era eri abo Katonda abibikkula, mu bulamu bwabwe obw’omunda ne mu kumanyiira kwabwe, ekintu kyennyini kye bamanyi nti tebasobola kutegeera.

Okusomesa kutugamba nti waliwo engeri bbiri ez’okuyigiriza. Omusomesa owa bulijjo afuula okuwa okumanya ekigendererwa kye ekikulu, era alima amaanyi g’omwana okutuusa lwe gamuyamba okutuukiriza ekigendererwa kye. Omusomesa ow’amazima obungi bw’okumanya abutwala ng’ekintu eky’okubiri.

Ekigendererwa kye ekisooka kwe kukuza amaanyi g’ebirowoozo n’ag’omwoyo, n’okuyamba omuyizi, mu birowoozo ne mu mpisa, okukozesa amaanyi ge obulungi, mu kunoonya n’okukozesa okumanya. Bwe kityo bwe kiri, waliwo ebibinja bibiri eby’ababuulizi. Abamu bafuka okuyigiriza n’empaka n’okwegayirira awatali kukoowa, ne baleka abawuliriza okukozesa obulungi bye baleeteddwa nga bwe basobola.

Omubuulizi ow’amazima amanyi nga bingi bwe biri ebisinziira ku mbeera y’omutima, era anoonya, nga Mukama waffe Yesu bwe yakola, okuteeka okuyigiriza amazima oba enjigiriza wansi w’okulima embeera ezo, kubanga awatali zo okuyigiriza kugasa katono. Ebyokubuulira ekikumi, ebiyivu era eby’obunyiikivu, eri ab’amagezi n’abategeevu, eri Abakristaayo abawuliriza nga balowooza nti basobola okutegeera era nti bye bawulira bijja kubagasa mu ngeri emu, biriteeka omukisa ogw’amazima omutono, okusinga ekyokubuulira kimu eri abawuliriza omubuulizi mw’azuukusizza okutegeera obutamanya okw’omwoyo, omwoyo ogw’obwana ogugonda ogulindirira era ogwesiga, ogwaniriza mu mazima era ne gugondera, okuyigiriza kwa Kitaffe.

Mu kifo eky’ekyama buli muntu ye, ng’oggyeeyo obuyambi bw’abantu, ye musomesa era mubuulizi we ku bwe. Asaana okwetendeka mu mpisa ennungi ey’obwangu bw’obwana n’okuyigirizika.

Ng’ajjukira nti tekyali kyetaagisa kyokka nti Amazima ga Katonda gabikkulibwe mu nsi, wabula nti waateekwa okubaawo okubikkulirwa okw’obuntu eri buli omu, olw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ekisooka ky’afaako kwe kulindirira Kitaffe okumubikkulira, era munda ye, ekyama ekyakwekebwa mu maanyi gaakyo mu bulamu obw’omunda. Mu mbeera eno, akozesa omwoyo ogw’obwana, era ayaniriza Obwakabaka ng’omwana omuto. Abakristaayo bonna ab’Enjiri bakkiriza okuzaalibwa obuggya.

Batono nnyo abakkiriza nti omuntu bw’azaalibwa Katonda, okwesiga Katonda ng’omwana olw’okuyigiriza kwonna n’amaanyi, kwe kusaanira okuba akabonero ke akasinga obukulu. Kino kye kimu Mukama waffe Yesu kye yanyweza okusinga byonna. Bwe yayogera nti abaavu mu mwoyo, abawombeefu, abalumwa enjala, “balina omukisa,” bwe yayita abantu okuyiga ku ye nti yali muwombeefu era muteefu mu mutima, bwe yayogeranga emirundi mingi ku kwetoowaza kwaffe n’okufuuka ng’abaana abato, kyali kubanga akabonero akasooka era akasinga obukulu ak’okuba omwana wa Katonda, ak’okuba nga Yesu Kristo, kwe kwesiga Katonda okutaliimu buseeko olwa buli mukisa, na naddala olw’okumanya okw’amazima okw’ebintu eby’omwoyo. Buli omu yeebuuze: Nnabalidde omwoyo ogw’obwana ng’ekintu ekisooka mu kuyiga kwange Ebyawandiikibwa? Kuyiga Ebyawandiikibwa kugasa ki awatali mwoyo ogw’obwana? Gwe kisumuluzo eky’amazima era ekyokka eky’essomero lya Katonda.

Tekyandibadde kirungi okuteeka wa bbali buli kintu okufuna kino? Olwo lwokka Katonda lw’alibikkula amagezi ge agaakwekebwa.

Okuzaalibwa okuggya, okuzaalibwa Katonda, kwe tufuukira abaana ba Katonda, kwateekebwawo okutufuula abaana abato. Kujja kutuwa omwoyo ogw’omwana awamu n’okuyigiriza okw’omwana. Tekusobola kukola ekyokubiri awatali kyokusooka. Katukkirize era twewaayo eri obulamu obuggya obuli mu ffe, eri okukulemberwa kw’Omwoyo; ajja kutufuuwamu omwoyo ogw’abaana abato. Ekigendererwa ekisooka eky’okuyiga Ebyawandiikibwa kwe kuyiga amagezi ga Katonda agaakwekebwa. Ekisookerwako mu kufuna okumanya kuno kwe kukkiriza amazima nti Katonda yennyini y’agatubikkulira. Ekisookerwako mu kufuna okumanya kuno, kwe kukkiriza amazima nti Katonda yennyini y’agatubikkulira.

Embeera esooka eyeetaagisa okusembeza okubikkulirwa okwo gwe mwoyo ogw’obwana. Ffenna tumanyi nga ekisooka omukozi ow’amagezi ky’akola kwe kulaba nga alina ebikozesebwa ebituufu, era nga biri mu mutindo omulungi. Tabala budde bwe okufiirwa okuyimiriza omulimu gwe n’awagala ebikozesebwa. Si budde bwa kufiirwa okuleka okuyiga Ebyawandiikibwa kulinda, okutuusa lw’olaba oba oli mu kifo ekituufu — ng’olindirira okubikkulirwa kwa Kitaffe mu mwoyo omuwombeefu era ogw’obwana.

Bw’owulira nti tosomanga Baibuli yo mu mwoyo guno, atula era leka mangu ago omwoyo ogw’okwesiga wekka ogw’ab’amagezi n’abategeevu. Tosaba mwoyo ogw’obwana gwokka, wabula ogukkirize. Guli mu ggwe, wadde nga gwerabiddwa era nga gwanyigirizibwa; osobola okutandika mangu ng’omwana wa Katonda okugumanyiira.

Tonoonya kuleeta mwoyo guno ogw’obwana mu mutima gwo ng’oyita mu kulowooza oba empaka. Kolera munda ng’ofuluma ebweru.

Guli mu ggwe, ng’ensigo, mu bulamu obuggya, obuzaalibwa Omwoyo. Guteekwa okuvaayo n’okukula mu ggwe ng’okuzaalibwa kw’Omwoyo abeera mu ggwe. Mu kukkiriza kuno, tosaana kusaba kwokka, wabula saba na njawulo olw’ekisa kino eky’Omwoyo, era ogukozese. Beera ng’omwana omuwere mu maaso ga Katonda. Ng’omwana akyazaalibwa bw’ayaayaanira amata ag’Ekigambo. Era wewale okugezaako okufuna embeera eno ey’omwoyo obwokka bw’oba oyagala okuyiga Ebyawandiikibwa. Kiteekwa okuba empisa ey’olubeerera ey’ebirowoozo byo, embeera y’omutima gwo. Olwo lwokka lw’osobola okusanyukira okukulemberwa okutasalako okw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

fields.title: Okuyiga ku Kristo
fields.body_html:
Musitule ekikoligo kyange, muyigire ku nze, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima, n’emyoyo gyammwe girifuna ekiwummulo." Matayo 11:29.

Okuyiga Ebyawandiikibwa kwonna kwe kuyiga. Okuyiga Ebyawandiikibwa kwonna okwala ebibala kusaana kubeera kuyiga ku Kristo. Baibuli ye kitabo eky’essomero, Kristo ye Musomesa. Ye asumulula okutegeera, era n’asumulula omutima, era n’akutula obubonero obw’envumbo. (Lukka 24:45, Ebikolwa 16:14, Okubikkulirwa 5:9.)

Kristo ye Kigambo ekiramu eky’olubeerera, era ebigambo ebyawandiikibwa bye njogera yaakyo ey’obuntu. Okubeerawo kwa Kristo n’okuyigiriza kwe bye byama by’okuyiga Ebyawandiikibwa kwonna okw’amazima. Ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa tekirina maanyi, okuggyako ng’ekituyamba okutuuka ku Kigambo Ekiramu. Tewali n’omu eyali alowoozezza okuvunaana Mukama waffe olw’obutassa kitiibwa mu Ndagaano Enkadde. Mu bulamu bwe ye, yakakasa nti yagirwa ng’eva mu kamwa ka Katonda. Bulijjo yalaganga Abayudaaya gye ng’okubikkulirwa kwa Katonda n’obujulirwa obumwogerako. Naye eri abayigirizwa kya kitalo nga bwe yayogeranga emirundi mingi ku kuyigiriza kwe ng’ekyo kye baali beetaaga ennyo, era kye baali bateekwa okugondera.

Kyali luvannyuma lwa kuzuukira kwe kwokka, ng’okwegatta naye kumaze okutuukirira, era nga bamaze okufuna okusooka okufuuwa kw’Omwoyo, lwe tumusanga ng’annyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa.

Abayudaaya baalina okunnyonnyola kwabwe kwennyini okw’Ekigambo: baakufuula ekiziyiza ekisinga obunene wakati waabwe n’Oyo kye kyayogerako. Emirundi mingi bwe kityo bwe kiri ne mu Bakristaayo; okutegeera kwaffe okw’obuntu okw’Ebyawandiikibwa, ne bwe kuba kunywezebwa obuyinza bw’Ekkanisa, oba ekibiina kyaffe ffe, kufuuka ekiziyiza ekisinga obunene mu kkubo ery’okuyigiriza kwa Kristo. Kristo Ekigambo Ekiramu, asooka kunoonya kifo kye mu mutima gwaffe ne mu bulamu bwaffe, okuba Omusomesa waffe yekka: bwe tutyo lwe tuliyiga okuva gy’ali okussa ekitiibwa n’okutegeera Ebyawandiikibwa. “Muyigire ku Nze kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima.” Mukama waffe wano abikkula ekyama ekisingira ddala munda eky’obulamu bwe obw’omunda. Ekyo kye yatuleetera okuva mu ggulu: ekyo ekimusaanyiza okuba Omusomesa n’Omulokozi; ekyo kye yatuwa, era ky’ayagala tuyige okuva gy’ali: obifuna byonna mu bigambo bino, “Ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima” — bwe butuukirivu obumu obumufuula Omwana gw’Endiga ogwa Katonda, Omununuzi waffe abonaabona, Omusomesa waffe ow’omu ggulu era Omukulembeze. Y’embeera emu gy’atusaba nga tujja okuyiga okuva gy’ali: okuva mu eno, ebirala byonna birijja.

Olw’okuyiga kwaffe Ebyawandiikibwa n’obulamu bwaffe bwonna obw’Ekikristaayo, wano olina ekisookerwako ekimu eky’okuyiga mu mazima ku Kristo. Ye, Omusomesa, omuwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima, ayagala okukufuula nga ye bw’ali, kubanga obwo bwe bulokozi.

Ng’omuyizi, oteekwa okujja okuyiga n’okumukkiriza, Oyo omuwombeefu era omuteefu, era onoonye okuyiga okuva gy’ali engeri y’okubeera omuwombeefu era omuteefu nga naawe. Kale lwaki kino kye kisooka era ekisinga obukulu?

Kubanga kye kikolo eky’enkolagana ey’amazima wakati w’ekitonde ne Katonda. Katonda yekka y’alina obulamu n’obulungi n’essanyu.

Nga Katonda ow’okwagala, asanyukira okuwa n’okukola buli kimu mu ffe.

Kristo yafuuka Omwana w’Omuntu okulaga mu kwesiga Katonda okw’omukisa okutakoma omuntu mw’asaanira okubeera: kino kye makulu ag’okuba kwe omuteefu mu mutima. Mu mwoyo guno bamalayika mwe babikkira amaaso gaabwe ne bakasuka engule zaabwe mu maaso ga Katonda. Katonda ye buli kimu gye bali, era basanyukira okufuna byonna n’okuwaayo byonna. Kino kye kikolo eky’obulamu obw’amazima obw’Ekikristaayo: okuba ekitaliimu mu maaso ga Katonda n’abantu: okulindirira Katonda yekka: okusanyukira, okukoppa, okuyiga ku Kristo, omuwombeefu era omuteefu. Kino kye kisumuluzo eky’okumanya Ebyawandiikibwa. Mu ngeri eno yokka mw’osobola okuyiga okuva gy’ali. Nga katono, mu Kkanisa Ey’Ekikristaayo, obwetoowaze, omutima omuwombeefu era omuteefu, bwe bubadde n’ekifo bwe bulina mu bulamu bwa Kristo ne mu kuyigiriza kw’ekigambo kya Katonda.

Nkakasa nnyo nti obwetaavu buno kye kikolo eky’ekitundu ekinene ennyo eky’obunafu n’obutaala bibala bye tuwulirako. Bwe tuba abawombeefu era abateefu mu mutima kyokka, Kristo lw’asobola okutuyigiriza olw’Omwoyo we ekyo Katonda ky’atuterekedde, era nga Katonda ajja kukolera mu ffe. Buli omu ku ffe atandikire ku ye yennyini era abale kino ng’ekisookerwako eky’obuyigirizwa, era ng’essomo erisooka Omukama ly’alituyigiriza awatali kubuusabuusa. Katufuule okuyiga kwaffe Ebyawandiikibwa kwonna okuyiga ku Kristo, okumwesiga, oyo omuwombeefu era omukkakkamu era omukwatampola, nga tumulindirira, akole omwoyo gwe n’ekifaananyi kye mu ffe.

Mu kiseera ekituufu, okusaba kwaffe okw’oku makya kulifuuka ekifo eky’enkolagana eya buli lunaku n’omukisa ogwa buli lunaku.

Mmanyi ebizibu bye nsaanidde okulwanyisa mu kwegayirira bwe ntyo nti omutima omuwombeefu era omuteefu gufuulibwe ekisooka okulowoozebwako mu kuyiga Ebyawandiikibwa. Kizibu okuleetera abantu okutegeera nti, mu bumu ne Katonda, embeera n’empisa bye buli kimu. Kizibu okusinga okubalaga nti mu mbeera n’empisa zonna ez’Ekikristaayo, omutima omuwombeefu era omuteefu gwe nsigo ddaladdala era ekikolo. Kizibu okubakkiriza nti awatali gwo okugasibwa okw’okuyiga Ebyawandiikibwa kutono nnyo. Naye ekisinga byonna okuba ekizibu kwe kubakulembera okutegeera n’okukkiriza nti omutima omuwombeefu era omuteefu gusoboka okufunibwa, kubanga kye kintu kyennyini Kristo ky’awa, ng’atuyigiriza engeri y’okukifuna n’okukikkiriza mu ye.

Wadde nga waliwo ebizibu bino byonna, kyokka nkubiriza abayizi ba Baibuli bonna, mu kufumiitiriza ne mu kusaba, okwebuuza oba ekibuuzo ekisooka ddala ekiteekwa okumalibwawo mu kisenge eky’omunda si kino: Omutima gwange guli mu mbeera Omusomesa wange gy’ayagala okubeera? Era bwe guba nga tekiri bwe kityo, omulimu gwange ogusooka si kwe kwewaayo gy’ali akole omutima gwange mu nze?

fields.title: Okuyigirizika
fields.body_html:
Musitule ekikoligo kyange, muyigire ku nze, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima, n’emyoyo gyammwe girifuna ekiwummulo." — Matayo 11:29.

Obulungi obusooka obw’omuyizi kwe kugonda n’okwagala okuyigirizibwa. Kino kitegeeza ki? Okutegeera obutamanya bwe ye, okwetegeka okuleka engeri ye ey’okulowooza oba ey’okukola, n’okutunuulira ebintu okuva mu ndaba y’omusomesa, obwesige obuteefu nti omukama amanyi era ajja kumulaga engeri y’okuyiga okumanya naye. Omwoyo omuwombeefu era omuteefu guwuliriza n’obwegendereza okumanya Omusomesa ky’ayagala, era amangwago yanguwa okukituukiriza. Bwe guba nga guno gwe mwoyo oguli mu muyizi, kiba nsobi ya musomesa singa atayiga.

Kale biva ku ki nti, nga Kristo ye musomesa waffe, waliwo okulemererwa okungi n’okukula okutono okw’amazima mu kumanya okw’omwoyo? Okuwulira n’okusoma Baibuli okungi bwe kutyo, okwatula okukkiriza mu yo okungi ng’etteeka lyaffe lyokka ery’obulamu, ate ng’omwoyo gwayo n’amaanyi gaayo tebirabika? Emirundi mingi okufuba okw’amazima n’obunyiikivu mu kisenge n’omu kibiina ky’okusoma Baibuli, ate ng’essanyu n’amaanyi Ekigambo kya Katonda bye kisobola okuwa biri bitono?

Ekibuuzo kino kya mugaso munene nnyo. Wateekwa okubaawo ensonga lwaki waliwo abayigirizwa ba Yesu bangi abalowooza nti mu bwesimbu baagala okumanya n’okukola by’ayagala, ate nga, okusinziira ku kwatula kwabwe bo n’obujulizi bw’abo ababeetoolodde, tebanyweza kigambo ky’obulamu ng’ettabaaza mu nsi. Singa eky’okuddamu ekibuuzo kifuniddwa, obulamu bwabwe bwandikyusiddwa.

Ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe kituwa eky’okuddamu: “Musitule ekikoligo kyange, muyigire ku nze, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima, n’emyoyo gyammwe girifuna ekiwummulo.” Bangi baatwala Kristo ng’Omulokozi naye si ng’Omusomesa. Baateeka obwesige bwabwe mu ye ng’Omusumba Omulungi eyawaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga; naye bamanyi katono ku mazima ag’okuliisa kwe endiga ze buli lunaku, ng’ayita buli emu erinnya lyayo, oba ku kuwulira eddoboozi lye ne bamugoberera ye yekka. Bamanyi katono ku kya kugoberera Omwana gw’Endiga; okusooka byonna okufuna okuva gy’ali obuzaale obw’omwana gw’endiga, n’okunoonya nga ye okuba abawombeefu era abateefu mu mutima. Kyali lwa myaka esatu abayigirizwa ba Kristo gye baamala ku ssomero lye, lwe baateekebwateekebwa olw’okubatizibwa kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, n’okutuukirira kw’ebisuubizo byonna eby’ekitalo bye yali abawadde.

Kiri wansi w’okuyigiriza kwa Mukama waffe Yesu yennyini era nga tuyita mu kugonda okwo okw’omutima omuwombeefu era omuteefu, oguli lunaku olulindirira ne gwaniriza ne gugoberera okuyigiriza okwo, mwe tusobola okufuna mu mazima ekiwummulo mu myoyo gyaffe. Okukoowa kwonna n’omugugu ogw’okutegana n’okulemererwa n’okumalibwa essuubi olwo bigabira ekifo emirembe egyo egya Katonda egimanyi nti byonna birabirirwa Kristo yennyini.

Okusitula okwo ekikoligo kya Kristo n’okuyiga okuva gy’ali obuwombeefu bwe n’obuteefu bw’omutima gwe, era awamu n’ekyo, okuyigirizika okugaana okumanya oba okukola ekintu kyonna mu magezi gaakwo, kwe kusaanira okuba omwoyo gw’obulamu bwaffe bwonna, buli lunaku era olunaku lwonna. Naye naddala mu ssaawa ey’oku makya kino mwe kisaana okulimibwa, n’okununulibwa okunoonyezebwa okuva mu kwefaako n’amaanyi gaakwo gonna. Eyo, nga tumaliddwamu ebigambo bya Katonda n’ebya Kristo n’eby’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, mwe tusaana buli lunaku okutegeera nti bino bigasa bwe bituusa, era bwe bibikkulwa, ku kuyigiriza kwa Kristo yennyini.

Eyo mwe tusaana buli lunaku okumanyiira nti Mukama omulamu Yesu yekka — “mu ye mw’abeera obujjuvu bwonna obw’obwa Katonda,” oyo obulamu bwaffe bwonna n’obulokozi mwe bikuŋŋaanyizibwa — ye yennyini bw’asembera n’atulabirira, okuyigiriza kwe lwe kusobola okwanirizibwa. Era eyo mwe tuteekwa okusaba ddala n’okulima okuyigirizika okusitula ekikoligo kye ne kuyiga okuva gy’ali. Nate nate, okuyigirizika kwe buli kimu. Obanga kya mazima ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe, Omwoyo gwa Kristo Yesu, nti “alibayigiriza byonna,” era obanga obulamu bwe bwonna n’omulimu gwe mu ffe kwe kuyigiriza kwa Katonda, era kya mazima nti obulamu bwaffe bwonna buteekwa okuba okuyigirizika kwa Katonda. Bwe kityo kyokka, obumu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku n’ekigambo kya Katonda, n’obulamu bwaffe obwa buli lunaku, lwe busobola okuba nga Mukama waffe Yesu bw’asobola okubufuula.

Okwerabiza bye twayiga emirundi mingi kwe kitundu ekisinga obukulu eky’okuyiga: endowooza enkyamu, obukyayi n’ebiteeso ebikulembera bye biziyiza ebitawangulika mu kkubo ery’okuyiga. Okutuusa lwe bino biba biggyibbwawo, omusomesa akola bwereere.

Okumanya kw’awa kukwata ku ngulu yokka: wansi ennyo mu buziba omuyizi akulemberwa ekyo ekimufuukidde ng’obuzaale obw’okubiri. Omulimu gw’omusomesa ogusooka kwe kuzuula, n’okuleetera omuyizi okulaba n’okuggyawo, ebiziyiza bino.

Tewayinza kubaawo kuyiga kwa mazima era okw’ebibala okuyiga ku Kristo we tutaali beetegefu kwerabiza bye twayiga. Olw’obuzaale, olw’okusomesebwa, olw’obulombolombo, tulina endowooza zaffe ku ddiini n’Ekigambo kya Katonda, emirundi mingi eziba ziziyiza ennyo okusinziira ku bwesige bwe tulina nti ddala ge mazima. Okuyiga ku Kristo kwetaagisa okwagala okuteeka buli mazima ge tunywezezza wansi w’okukebera kwe okunenya n’okutereeza. Obwetoowaze bwe butuukirivu obw’ekikolo eky’obulamu obw’Ekikristaayo. Etteeka teriwaanyisibwa mu Bwakabaka bwa Katonda: “Buli eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa.” Okumalibwa kwaffe essuubi mu kufuba okutuuka ku madaala amasingako ag’ekisa, okukkiriza, okumanya okw’omwoyo, okwagala emyoyo n’amaanyi ag’okuwa omukisa, kwonna kuva ku kino. Tetukkirizza bwetoowaze bwa Kristo ng’entandikwa n’obutuukirivu obw’obulokozi bwe. “Awa abeetoowaze ekisa” kirina amakulu agagazi era agakwata ku bintu bingi okusinga bwe tulowooza.

Okugonda ngeri emu ey’obwetoowaze. Mu ssaawa ey’oku makya, tweteeka ng’abayizi ku ssomero lya Kristo; okugonda, obwetoowaze bibeere akabonero akawuula omuyizi, era, bwe tuwulira nga katono ke tulina, katuwulirize eddoboozi eryogera nti, “Musitule ekikoligo kyange,” era, olwa buli kino kye kitegeeza: “muyigire ku nze, kubanga ndi muwombeefu era omuteefu mu mutima, n’emyoyo gyammwe girifuna ekiwummulo.”

fields.title: Obulamu N'Ekitangaala
fields.body_html:
“Ku lubereberye Kigambo yaliwo, era Kigambo yali ne Katonda, era Kigambo yali Katonda. Mu ye mwe mwali obulamu; era obulamu buno ne buba ekitangaala eri abantu.” Yokaana 1:1, 4.

“Awo Yesu n’ayongera okwogera nabo, ng’agamba nti, ‘Nze Musana gw’ensi. Angoberera taatambulirenga mu kizikiza, wabula anaabeeranga n’omusana ogw’obulamu.’ ” Yokaana 8:12.

Olwokubanga Kristo yali Katonda, kyeyava asobola okuba Kigambo kya Katonda. Olwokubanga yalina Obulamu bwa Katonda mu ye yekka, kyeyava asobola okubikkula Obulamu obwo. Bw’atyo ng’Ekigambo Ekiramu, ye Kigambo ekiwa obulamu. Ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa kiyinza okufuuka ekyereere ekitaliimu maanyi awo amagezi g’omuntu we gakozesebwa okukitegeera. Kiba kigambo eky’obulamu gye tuli, bwe kikkirizibwa okuba ensigo omwo obulamu bw’Ekigambo Ekiramu mwe bukwekeddwa, obwa buggya Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Obumu bwaffe n’ekigambo kya Katonda ekyawandiikibwa buteekwa okulundibwa n’okufugibwa okukkiriza kw’Ekigambo Eky’emirembe n’emirembe, ekyali Katonda.

Amazima ago gennyini gafulumira mu bigambo ebiddirira: Obulamu bwe kitangaala. Bwe tulaba ekitangaala nga kyaka, tumanya nti waliwo omuliro ogwaka mu ngeri emu oba endala. Bwe kityo ne mu by’omwoyo.

Wateekwa kubaawo obulamu awo ekitangaala we kiyinza okubaawo. Waliwo ekitangaala ekyefaananyirizibwa okuva ku kintu ekifudde oba ekiddugavu. Waliwo ekitangaala ekyeyazikibwa ekitaliimu bulamu. Naye obulamu obw’amazima bwokka bwe busobola okulaga ekitangaala eky’amazima. Agoberera Kristo aliba n’ekitangaala eky’obulamu.

Ebigambo bino ebibiri eby’amazima amakulu agamu, biraga bulungi bye twayiga ku Mwoyo wa Katonda. Nga ye bw’amanya ebintu bya Katonda kubanga ye bulamu bwa Katonda, bw’atyo Kristo ye Kigambo kubanga ye Katonda, era alina obulamu bwa Katonda; era ekitangaala kya Katonda kyaka wamu awali obulamu bwa Katonda. Ebirowoozo ebyo byonna byonsatule bituzza nate ku kwesoma kwaffe Bayibuli n’essomo eryo limu eririmu omukisa, naye eryetaagisa ennyo, nti okwesoma Ebyawandiikibwa kwaffe kuyinza okutuweera omukisa awo ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa lwe kituleetera obulamu bw’Ekigambo Eky’emirembe n’emirembe, awo ekitangaala kyakyo mu mutima lwe kiba okwaka kw’obulamu obukolera omwo, awo Omwoyo Omutukuvu amanya ebintu bya Katonda kubanga ye bulamu bwa Katonda, lw’abifuula obulamu n’amazima munda mu ffe.

Bwe tutyo tukomawo ku ssomo lyennyini Omwoyo ly’anoonya okunyweza ku bikwata ku Kigambo kya Katonda — nti tumanya ddala Ebyawandiikibwa awo byokka lwe biva mu bulamu bwa Katonda ne biyingira mu bulamu bwaffe.

Kiba nsigo eriimu munda yaayo obulamu obw’ekiKatonda: bw’ekkirizibwa mu ttaka eddungi ery’omutima ogulumwa enjala olw’obulamu obwo, erimera ne libala ebibala, nga buli nsigo, “ng’ekika kyayo bwe kiri.”

Erizaala nate mu bulamu bwaffe obulamu bwennyini bwa Katonda, mwe lwava, ekifaananyi n’engeri ya Kitaffe n’Omwana ye ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Twagala okubikozesa mu ngeri ey’amakulu, n’okubiteeka butereevu ku kwesoma kwaffe Bayibuli mu kyama.

Oyagala okumanya engeri gy’otandika. Amateeka mangu nnyo.

Ery’olubereberye: “Musiriikirire, mumanye nga nze Katonda.” Weewe ekiseera okusirika n’okutegeera Katonda. “Sirika mu maaso ga Mukama Katonda!” “Musiriikirire mu maaso ga Mukama, mmwe mwenna abalina omubiri.” “Naye Mukama ali mu Yeekaalu ye entukuvu; ensi yonna esirike mu maaso ge.” Musinze era mumulindirire alyoke ayogere gy’oli. Eddirira: Jjukira nti ekigambo kiva mu bulamu, mu mutima gwa Katonda nga kisitula obulamu bwe okububbuulira mu bwo. Si kintu kirala wabula bulamu bwa Katonda: era si maanyi galala wabula amaanyi ga Katonda gasobola okugafuula obulamu munda yo. Eddirira: kkiriza Kristo Ekigambo Ekiramu. “Mu ye mwe mwali obulamu; era obulamu buno ne buba ekitangaala eri abantu.” “Angoberera taatambulirenga mu kizikiza, wabula anaabeeranga n’omusana ogw’obulamu.” Goberera Yesu mu kwagala n’okwegomba, mu buwulize n’obuweereza, bw’atyo obulamu bwe bulikolera munda yo, era obulamu buliba ekitangaala ky’emmeeme yo.

Awo, saba Kitaawe akuwe Omwoyo Omutukuvu, ye yekka amanya ebintu bya Katonda, alyoke afuule ekigambo mu mutima gwo eky’obulamu era ekikola. Lumwe enjala olw’okwagala kwa Katonda ng’emmere yo eya buli lunaku; luma ennyonta olw’enzizi ey’obulamu ey’Omwoyo munda yo; kkiriza ekigambo mu kwagala kwo, mu bulamu bwo, mu ssanyu lyo — obulamu bwe kileeta buliwa ekitangaala ekyaka nakyo. Ensonga lwaki ndaddiridde emirundi mingi okulaga amazima agalanjiddwa mu bitundu ebisembayo nnyangu nnyo.

Okwesomako kwange kunjigirizza kunywera nga bwe kitwala ekiseera ekiwanvu nga tetunnaba kutegeera bulungi nti ekigambo kya Katonda kiteekwa okukkirizibwa mu bulamu so si mu magezi gokka, era bwe kitwala nate, ne bwe tumala okukitegeera, nga tetunnaba kukikkiriza ddala n’okukikola. “Okubawandiikira ebintu bye bimu tekindeetera buzibu era kibaweesa obukuumo.”

Yiga essomo okutuusa lw’oliba oteredde. Ekigambo kiva mu bulamu bwa Katonda, kisitula obulamu obwo mu kyo kyennyini, kinoonya okuyingira mu bulamu bwange n’okubujjuza obulamu bwa Katonda. Obulamu buno bwe kitangaala eri abantu, era buwa ekitangaala eky’okumanya ekitiibwa kya Katonda. Oyinza okulaba nti essomo lino litwala ekiseera okusinga bwe kyali olowooza, nti likuziyiza okusinga bwe likuyamba mu masomo go aga Bayibuli, era nti liyongera okuba ekizibu gy’osinga okuliyiga. Totya wadde okuggwaamu obugumiikiriza; wabula kakasa nti bw’oliyiga obulungi, olitendereza Katonda olw’okuba nti lifuuse ekisumuluzo ky’otaakabanga nakyo, eky’eby’obugagga eby’ekigambo ebyakwekebwa, nga kikuwa amagezi ag’amazima mu kifo eky’ekyama.

Bwe ntyo nziramu okwogera nate ebigambo ebyangu naye ebijjudde omukisa era eby’amazima obutamalika. Nga Omwoyo abeera mu Katonda ye yekka amanya ebintu bya Katonda, ye Mwoyo abeera munda yange yekka asobola okuntegeeza ebintu bya Katonda ng’abibuulira obulamu bwange.

Nga Kristo yali Ekigambo kubanga yali Katonda, era yalina obulamu bwa Katonda, ekigambo ekyawandiikibwa kisobola okumpa omukisa awo ng’Ekigambo Ekiramu, nga kiyita mu kyo, kimuleetera obulamu bwa Katonda gye ndi. Nga obulamu bwali mu Kristo, era nga Obulamu bwe Kitangaala eri abantu, bwe kityo awo bwe nnina obulamu bwa Kristo nga buyita mu kigambo we nnyinira ekitangaala eky’okumanya Katonda.

fields.title: Omuyizi wa Bayibuli
fields.body_html:
“Naye asanyukira okugondera amateeka ga Mukama, era mu mateeka ago mw’alowooleza emisana n’ekiro.” Zabbuli 1:2. Waliwo okukoowoola okw’amaanyi mu buli ludda olw’okwesoma Bayibuli okusingawo era okw’amazima okusingawo. Ababuulizi ng’omusajja Moody n’abalala bangi, bakakasizza amaanyi agali mu kubuulira okuggibwa butereevu mu kigambo kya Katonda, era okusitulwa okukkiriza amaanyi gaakyo. Abakristaayo abanyiikivu babadde babuuza nti: “Lwaki abaweereza baffe tebayinza kwogera mu ngeri y’emu, nga bawa ekigambo kya Katonda kyennyini ekifo ekisingako?” Omuweereza omuvubuka mangi avudde mu Ssomero ery’Eby’ekiKatonda, ng’ayatula nti yayigirizibwa buli kimu okuggyako okumanya engeri y’okwesomamu Ekigambo yekka, n’oluvannyuma okusitula n’okuyamba abalala okukyesoma.

Mu Kkanisa zaffe ezimu, waliwo okwegomba okwalagibwa okuliisa obwetaavu buno mu kutendeka abaweereza. Kiyinza okulabika ng’ekintu ekyangu nnyo okulaba abasajja abalungi okukola omulimu guno; kyokka kizibu okulaba abasajja abaayigirizibwa eby’ekiKatonda okukyukira mu bwangu n’obwesimbu obw’okukoowoola Ekigambo kya Katonda, obwetaagisa okulaga abavubuka ekkubo ery’okufuula Ebyawandiikibwa ensibuko emu ey’okumanya kwabwe n’okuyigiriza kwabwe. Mu Kibiina ky’Abayizi eky’ennaku zaffe, Katonda atenderezebwe.

Okwesoma Bayibuli kuweereddwa ekifo eky’oku mwanjo. Waliwo omukisa ogw’ekitalo, era nga bwe waliwo obwetaavu obunene ennyo, obw’okuluŋŋamya kutyo kuleetere obulamu bw’omuntu kinnoomu omukisa ogujjuvu, nga kiwa ekigambo kya Katonda ekifo kyakyo eky’amazima mu mulimu ogw’okukolerwa Ye. Katutunuulire emisingi egiri wansi w’okwetaaga okwesoma Bayibuli okusingawo, era mu bwesigwa gy’emu gwokka kwe kuyinza okutuukirizibwa mu mazima. 1. Ekigambo kya Katonda Kye Kukwekulwa Okw’amazima Kokka Okw’okwagala kwa Katonda. Ebigambo byonna eby’abantu ku mazima ag’ekiKatonda, ne bwe biba bituufu, birina obulema era bisitula ekigero ky’obuyinza bw’omuntu. Mu kigambo, eddoboozi lya Katonda lyogera gye tuli butereevu. Buli mwana wa Katonda ayitibwa okuba omu ne Kitaawe butereevu, ng’ayita mu Kigambo. Nga Katonda bw’abikkula omutima gwe gwonna n’ekisa kye mu kyo, omwana we asobola, bw’akikkiriza okuva eri Katonda, okufuna obulamu n’amaanyi gonna agali mu kigambo mu mutima gwe n’obubaawo bwe. Tumanyi obutono nnyo obwa lipoota ez’oku mukono ogw’okubiri ez’obubaka oba emirimu bwe zisobola okwesigibwa mu bujjuvu. Abasajja abatono nnyo baba n’obutuufu bwe bawa ku bye bawulira. Buli mukkiriza alina eddembe era n’okuyitibwa okuyimirira mu nkolagana etereevu ne Katonda. Kiri mu kigambo Katonda mw’abikkulira, kiri mu kigambo mw’akyabikkulira, Yye yekka eri buli muntu kinnoomu.

2. Ekigambo kya Katonda kino kigambo ekiramu. Kisitula amaanyi ag’ekiKatonda agabuggya munda yaakyo. Ebigambo by’abantu eby’amazima emirundi mingi biba ndowooza obwereere oba ekifaananyi eky’amazima, ekikoowoola amagezi naye nga kirimu amaanyi matono oba nga tekiriimu. Okukkiriza nti kigambo kya Katonda kyennyini era nti mukirimu obubaawo n’amaanyi, kwe kukifuula eky’amaanyi. Obulamu bwonna oba omwoyo gwennyini gulyekolera ekifaananyi mwe guryolekebwa.

Ebigambo Katonda mwe yalonda okwambaza ebirowoozo bye eby’ekiKatonda, gassa Katonda omukka, era obulamu bwa Katonda mubibeeramu. Katonda si Katonda w’abafu wabula ow’abalamu. Ekigambo tekyassibwamu mukka bukka we kyasooka okuweebwa: Omwoyo wa Katonda akyakissamu omukka. Katonda akyali mu kigambo kye era ali wamu nakyo. Abakristaayo n’abayigiriza beetaaga okukkiriza kino. Kiribaleetera okuwa ekigambo kya Katonda ekyangu obwesige obutayinza kubaawo mu kuyigiriza kw’abantu.

3. Katonda yekka asobola, era mu bwesimbu obungi alikola, okuba Omutaputa w’ekigambo kye ye. Amazima ag’ekiKatonda geetaaga Omuyigiriza ow’ekiKatonda. Okutegeera okw’omwoyo eby’omwoyo kuyinza kuva eri Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka. Nga bwe tunywerera mu ndowooza nti ekigambo kya njawulo, nga kya njawulo ddala okuva ku, era nga kigulumizibwa emirundi egitabalika okusinga, okutegeera kwonna okw’obuntu obuntu, gye tulyeyongera okuwulira obwetaavu obw’okuyigirizibwa okusukkulumu obw’ekiKatonda butereevu. Era gye tulisinga okukolebwa omukisa ogwo ekigambo gwe kigenderera. Emmeeme erireetebwa okunoonya Katonda yennyini, era eriluŋŋamibwa okumusanga mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu mutima. Nga Omwoyo oyo, Katonda mw’ayingidde mu ngeri ey’ekitalo mu bulamu bwaffe ne yeegatta nabwo, bw’alindirirwa era bwe yeesigibwa, alitufuula okumanya amagezi mu kifo eky’ekyama, mu mutima n’engeri. Ekigambo ekisomebwa mu kusaba era ekilabirirwa mu mutima mu kukkiriza kuno, ng’ayita mu Mwoyo, kiriba ekitangaala era n’obulamu munda yaffe.

4. Awo ekigambo kituleeta mu bumu obusinga okuli okumpi era obw’omunda ennyo ne Katonda — obumu obw’okwagala n’obulamu. Mu kigambo Katonda abikkudde omutima gwe gwonna n’okwagala kwe kwonna: mu mateeka ge n’ebiragiro bye ky’ayagala tukole: mu kununula kwe n’ebisuubizo bye ky’ayagala okutukolera. Nga bwe tukkiriza okwagala okwo mu kigambo nga kuva eri Katonda yennyini, ne twewaayo eri okukola kwakwo, tuyiga okumanya Katonda mu kwagala kwe, mu maanyi mw’akolera munda yaffe, era n’okwagala kwe okw’obwetoowaze mwe kutegeererwa. Era ekigambo kituukiriza ekigendererwa kyakyo ekigagga ennyo nga kitujjuza ekitiibwa n’okwesigama okuva mu bubaawo n’okumpi bwa Katonda. Si kirala wabula kino kye kiteekwa okuba ekiruubirirwa kyaffe, era kye kiyinza okuba obumanyirivu bwaffe, mu kwesoma kwaffe kwonna Bayibuli.

Katutwale nate ebirowoozo bino ebina era tubiteeke mu nkola. Mu Byawandiikibwa Ebitukuvu, tulina ebigambo byennyini Katonda Omutukuvu mwe yayogerera era mwe yatwogerera. Ebigambo bino, leero, bijjudde obulamu bwa Katonda. Katonda ali mu byo, era alaga obubaawo n’amaanyi ge eri abo abamunoonya mu byo. Eri abo abasaba ne balindirira okuyigirizibwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera munda yaffe, Omwoyo alibikkula amakulu n’amaanyi ag’omwoyo ag’ekigambo. Bw’atyo ekigambo kigenderere okuba buli lunaku ekkubo ery’okubikkula Katonda yennyini eri emmeeme n’okukolagana naye. Tuyize okukozesa amazima gano? Tutegeera nti ekigambo bulijjo kigamba nti “Noonya Katonda”? Wuliriza Katonda. Lindirira Katonda. Katonda ajja kwogera gy’oli. Leka Katonda akuyigirize?

Byonna bye tuwulira ku kuyigiriza Bayibuli okusingawo n’okwesoma Bayibuli byonna biteekwa okutuweereza ku kintu kino kimu. Tuteekwa okuba abasajja, era tuteekwa okuyamba okutendeka abalala okuba abasajja, ekigambo abo gye kitawukanira na Katonda omulamu yennyini, era ababeera ng’abasajja Katonda ali mu ggulu gw’ayogeza buli lunaku era olunaku lwonna.

fields.title: Ggwe Ani?
fields.body_html:
“Mulowoozenga ku ebyo ebiri mu ggulu, so si ebiri ku nsi, kubanga mwafa era n’obulamu bwammwe bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda.” — Abakkolosaayi 3:2, 3.

Okuyingira mu maaso ga Katonda mu ssaawa ez’enkya kusinziira nnyo ku Mukristaayo okutegeera si Katonda gw’ali yekka, wabula naye gw’ali ye kennyini, n’enkolagana gy’ayimiridde nayo eri Katonda. Ku kibuuzo nti “Ggwe ani?” ekibuuzibwa, si mu bigambo wabula mu mwoyo, eri buli omu asaba eddembe ery’okuyingira n’okuwulirwa Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo, wateekwa okubaawo eky’okuddamu ekiteeketeeke munda ye ennyo; okumanya okwo kuteekwa okuba si kirala wabula okuwulira okuramu okw’ekifo ky’alina mu Kristo mu maaso ga Katonda. Engeri gye kyogerwamu eyinza okwawukana mu biseera eby’enjawulo, mu makulu gaakyo bulijjo galiba gamu.

Nze ani? Weewaawo, ka ndowooze era njogere, nze ani okusaba nti Katonda ansisinkane wano, amale nange olunaku luno lwonna? Nze omu amanyi, olw’ekigambo n’Omwoyo wa Katonda, nti ndi mu Kristo, era nti obulamu bwange bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda. Mu Kristo, nnafa eri ekibi n’ensi. Kaakano nziggiddwamu, njaawuddwa nabyo era nnununuddwa okuva mu maanyi gaabyo. Nzuukiziddwa awamu ne Kristo era mu ye mba mulamu eri Katonda.

Obulamu bwange bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda, era nzija eri Katonda okusaba n’okufuna obulamu bwonna obw’ekiKatonda obukwekeddwa munda ye olw’obwetaavu n’okuweebwa okwa leero.

Weewaawo, ono ye nze bwe ndi, nkigamba Katonda mu bwetoowaze, mu kussaamu ekitiibwa okutukuvu, ng’eky’okwewolereza kwange. Nkigamba nze kennyini okugumya abalala, awamu nange, obutanoonya wadde okusuubira ekitono okusinga — ekisa okulamu, wano ku nsi, obulamu obukwekeddwa obw’omu ggulu. Nze omu ayagala okwogera, era ayogera, nti Kristo bwe bulamu bwange. Okwegomba kw’emmeeme yange kwe kwegomba Kristo, abikkulwa Kitaffe yennyini munda mu mutima. Si kirala kiyinza kunnematuza. Obulamu bwange bukwekeddwa mu Kristo. Tayinza kuba bulamu bwange mu ngeri endala okuggyako ng’ali mu mutima gwange. Weewaawo! Sisobola kumatira kirala okuggyako Kristo mu mutima.

Kristo Mulokozi ava mu kibi. Kristo kye kirabo era ye aleeta okwagala kwa Katonda. Kristo ng’Omukwano gw’omunda era Mukama abeera munda. Woowe! Katonda wange! Bw’obuuza nti, “Ggwe ani?” wuliriza okwogera kwange okw’akamwa: mbeera mu Kristo, ne Kristo mu nze. Ggwe wekka oyinza okumfuula okumanya n’okuba byonna bye kitegeeza. Waliwo n’ebirala, bye nnaayogera, ng’eky’okwewolereza kwange olw’ekisa ky’obubaawo n’amaanyi ga Katonda olunaku lwonna. Nzija ng’omu ayagala, anoonya, okuteekebwateekebwa okulamu okuva mu bulamu bwa Kristo leero ku nsi, okuvvuunula ekitiibwa kye eky’omu ggulu ekyakwekebwa mu lulimi olw’obulamu obwa buli lunaku, n’engeri zaabwo n’obuvunaanyizibwa bwabwo.

Nga Kristo ku nsi bwe yalamira okukola okwagala kwa Katonda kwokka, kwe kwegomba kwange okunene okuyimirira nga ntuukiridde era nga njjuvu mu kwagala kwe kwonna.

Obutamanya bwange okwagala okwo, mu okukozesebwa kwakwo kwonna okw’omwoyo ku bumu n’ensi n’abantu, buli bungi nnyo. Obwetaavu bwange busingako obunene. Naye kyokka nzija eri Katonda ng’omu atasaanidde kuwaayo kitono wadde okunoonya endagaano etaliimu maanyi, ng’omu mu bwesimbu bwonna akkiriza okuyitibwa okw’ekitiibwa okw’okulamu mu bujjuvu okwagala kwa Katonda mu bintu byonna.

Kino kye kinjjiza mu kisenge eky’omunda. Nga ndowooza ku kulemererwa kwange kwonna okutuukiriza okwagala kwa Katonda, nga ntunuulira mu maaso okukemebwa n’akabi konna akandindirira, nga mpulira obutamala bwange bwonna naye kyokka nga ngamba Katonda — nzija okusaba obulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo, ndyoke ndamire obulamu obwa Kristo; mpulira nga nsindikibwa era ng’ensikibwa obutamatira nga sirina kukakasa okusirifu nti Katonda aligenda nange era alimpa omukisa.

Nze ani okusaba ebintu bino ebikulu era eby’ekitalo eri Katonda? Nsobola ddala okusuubira okulamu obulamu obukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda, ne mbulaga mu mubiri gwange ogufa? Nsobola; kubanga Katonda yennyini y’alibukolera munda yange ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu abeera munda yange. Katonda oyo yennyini eyazuukiza Kristo okuva mu bafu, n’oluvannyuma n’amuteeka ku mukono gwe ogwa ddyo, y’anzuukizza awamu naye n’ampa Omwoyo ogw’ekitiibwa eky’Omwana we mu mutima gwange.

Obulamu mu Kristo, obuweereddwayo okumanya n’okukola okwagala kwa Katonda kwonna, bwe bulamu Katonda yennyini bw’alikola era bw’alinyweza nga bugenda bweyongera munda yange ng’ayita mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Era bwe nzija enkya ne neeyanjula mu maaso ge okutwala obuggya obulamu bw’ankwekedde munda ye, Omwana we w’akwekeddwa, n’okubulamira mu mubiri, nsobola okulindirira n’obwesige era mu bukkakkamu, ng’omu Omwoyo mw’abeera, okulindirira Kitaffe okuwa okusiigibwa okuggya okuyigiriza ebintu byonna, era Ye yennyini okuvunaanyizibwa olunaku olupya lw’ampadde.

Muganda wange, nkakasa nti owulira obukulu obutabalika bwe kiba, obanga ssaawa ey’enkya eneeteekwa okunyweza obubaawo bwa Katonda olw’olunaku, nti oyimirira ku musingi omunywevu ogutali kirala wabula ogw’okununulibwa okujjuvu.

Kkiriza Katonda by’akugamba. Kkiriza Katonda by’akuwadde mu Kristo. Beera n’okumanya era mu lwatu ekyo Katonda ky’akufudde okuba. Weewe ekiseera mu maaso ga Katonda okukimanya n’okukyogera. Mu lutalo ebintu bimeka bwe bisinziira ku kifo ekitawangulwa. Kwata ekifo kyo Katonda we yakuteeka.

Okugezaako kwennyini okukola kino, kuyinza oluusi okutaataaganya okwesoma kwo okwa bulijjo Bayibuli, oba okusaba. Tekiriba kufiirwa. Kirisasulwa mu bujjuvu oluvannyuma. Obulamu bwo bwonna businziira ku kumanya Katonda wo gw’ali, era ggwe gw’oli ng’omuntu we omununule mu Kristo. Obulamu obwa buli lunaku businziira ku kyo; bw’omala okuyiga ekyama, kiriba, ne bw’oteekiroowoozako, amaanyi g’omutima gwo, mu kuyingira eri Katonda n’okufuluma naye okugenda mu nsi.

fields.title: By'ayagala Katonda
fields.body_html:
"Obwakabaka bwo bujje. By'oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu." — Matayo 6:10.

1. By'ayagala Katonda ge maanyi amalamu ensi lwe yatondebwa era lwe ebaawo. Olw'okwagala okwo, era ng'okwagala okwo bwe kuli, ensi bw'eri bw'etyo. Y'engeri okwagala kwa Katonda mwe kweraga, mwe kubonekera, mu magezi gaakwo, mu maanyi n'obulungi bwakwo. Obulungi n'ekitiibwa ky'erina byonna biva ku Katonda okuba nga yakyagala. Nga bwe kwagigyusa, bwe kityo kugiwanirira buli lunaku. Bwe kityo ebitonde bikola ekyo kye byatonderwa, biraga ekitiibwa kya Katonda. "Ebitonde ebiramu biwa oyo atudde ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka, abeera omulamu emirembe n'emirembe, ekitiibwa n'ettendo n'okwebaza, kubanga ggwe watonda ebintu byonna, era olw'okwagala kwo byabaawo ne bitondebwa."

2. Kino kya mazima ku bitonde ebitaliimu bulamu. Naye kisingira ddala okuba amazima ku bitonde ebirina amagezi. Okwagala kwa Katonda kwatonda ekitonde mu kifaananyi kyakwo era nga kikwesimbye, nga kirina obuyinza obulamu okumanya, n'okukkiriza, n'okukolagana n'okwagala okwo ekitonde lwe kwatondebwa. Omukisa gwa bamalayika abatagwa guli mu kubala nti kye kitiibwa kyabwe ekisingayo n'essanyu okuyinza okwagala n'okukola mu bujjuvu ebyo Katonda by'ayagala n'ebyo by'akola. Ekitiibwa ky'omu ggulu kiri nti eyo by'ayagala Katonda bikolebwa.

Ekibi n'ennaku bya bamalayika abaagwa n'abantu biri mu kimu kyokka: okuba nga baakyuka ne bagaana okubeera mu ky'ayagala Katonda n'okukikola.

3. Okununulibwa si kirala wabula okuzza obuggya ky'ayagala Katonda mu kifo kyakyo mu nsi. Olw'ekigendererwa ekyo, Kristo yajja n'alaga mu bulamu bw'obuntu, engeri omuntu gy'alina ekintu kimu kyokka ky'asaanira okubeerera omulamu, okukola ky'ayagala Katonda. Yatulaga engeri emu ey'okuwangula okwagala kwaffe ffe fennyini — okufiira ku kwo, nga tugondera ky'ayagala Katonda okutuusiza ddala ku kufa. Bw'atyo yatangirira olw'okwagala kwaffe ne yakuwangula ku lwaffe, era yatuggulirawo ekkubo, okuyita mu kufa n'okuzuukira, okutuusa mu bulamu obwegasse ddala n'okuweereddwayo ddala eri ky'ayagala Katonda.

4. Kaakano ky'ayagala Katonda okununula kisobola okukola mu muntu eyagwa ekyo ky'ayagala Katonda okutonda kye kyakola era kye kikola bulijjo mu bitonde, oba mu ebyo ebitaagwa. Mu Kristo ne mu kyokulabirako kye, Katonda alaze okwewaayo n'okusanyukira ky'ayagala kye, by'atusaba era by'atusuubira. Mu Kristo ne mu Mwoyo we, azza obuggya era yeetwalira okwagala kwaffe: akola mu kwo okwagala n'okukola, n'atufuula abasobola era abaagala okukola ky'ayagala kye kyonna. Ye yennyini akola ebintu byonna ng'okuteesa kw'okwagala kwe bwe kuli. "Abawe buli kirungi mulyoke mukole ky'ayagala, ng'akola mu ffe ekimusanyusa mu maaso ge." Kino nga Omwoyo Omutukuvu bw'akibikkula, ne tukikkiriza, ne tukiyaniriza mu mutima, tutandika okutegeera okusaba nti, "By'oyagala bikolebwe mu nsi, nga bwe bikolebwa mu ggulu," era okwegomba okw'amazima ku bulamu kwe kusuubiza kuzuukusibwa.

5. Nga kikulu nnyo eri omukkiriza okutegeera enkolagana ye ne ky'ayagala Katonda, n'ekyo ky'akimusaba. Abakkiriza bangi nnyo tebalina kutegeera kwonna ku ngeri okukkiriza kwabwe oba enneewulira yaabwe gye kusaanidde okubeera ku ky'ayagala Katonda. Batono nnyo aboogera nti: Endowooza yange yonna ku mukisa teri mu kintu kirala wabula mu kutabagana okujjuvu ne ky'ayagala Katonda. Nkiwulira nti ekintu kyange kimu kye nneetaaga, kwe kwewaayo okunywezebwa bulijjo, obutakola ekintu kyonna, ne mu kasembayo akatono, okuggyako ekyo Katonda ky'anjagaliza okukola. Olw'ekisa kya Katonda, buli ssaawa ey'obulamu bwange eyinza okuba obulamu mu ky'ayagala Katonda, nga nkikola nga bwe kikolebwa mu ggulu.

6. Okukkiriza okulamu mu ky'ayagala Katonda, nga kutuukiriza ebigendererwa byakwo mu ffe nga bwe kweyongera, nga kufuga omutima, ye ngeri yokka mwe tunaafunira obuvumu okukkiriza okuddibwamu okw'okusaba Mukama waffe kwe yatuyigiriza. Bwe tunaalaba nti okukola kuno okwa ky'ayagala Katonda mu ffe kutuukirizibwa mu Yesu Kristo, ye ngeri yokka mwe tunaategeerera nti okwegatta okw'oku lwe naye kwe kutuwa obwesige nti Katonda ajja kukolera byonna mu ffe. Era obwesige buno mu Katonda, mu Yesu Kristo, bwe bwokka bunaatukakasa nti naffe tusobola okukola omulimu gwaffe, era nti okwagala kwaffe okunafu ku nsi kuyinza ddala okutuukagana n'okukolagana ne ky'ayagala Katonda. Ka tukkirize omugabo gwaffe n'obuvunaanyizibwa bwaffe ng'ekintu kimu omutima gwaffe kye gwegomba, nti mu buli kintu ky'ayagala Katonda kikolebwe mu ffe era ku ffe, nga bwe kikolebwa mu ggulu; okukkiriza okwo kwe kunaawangula ensi.

7. Okwagala tekusaanira kwawukanyizibwa ku kwegatta okulamu ne Kitaffe wano, wadde ku kubeerawo okulamu okw'Omwana Omuweereddwa omukisa. Olw'obulagirizi obw'omu ggulu obuweebwa mu Mwoyo Omutukuvu bwokka, ky'ayagala Katonda mu bulungi bwakyo, mu kukikozesa mu bulamu obwa buli lunaku, mu kubikkulibwa kwakyo okugenda kweyongera, mwe kuyinza okumanyibwa ddala. Okuyigiriza kuno tekuliweebwa ab'amagezi n'abategeevu, wabula abaana abato, abantu abalina omwoyo ogw'obwana, abeetegefu okulinda n'okwesiga ekyo kye baweebwa. Obulagirizi obw'omu ggulu bunaakulembera mu kkubo lya ky'ayagala Katonda.

8. Obumu bwaffe obw'ekyama ne Katonda kye kifo mwe tuddiŋŋanira ne tuyigira amasomo amakulu… Katonda gwe nsinza ansaba okwegatta okujjuvu ne ky'ayagala kye… Okusinza kwange kutegeeza nti: "Nsanyukira okukola by'oyagala, Ayi Katonda wange." Essaawa ey'oku makya, ekisenge eky'omunda, obumu obw'ekyama ne Katonda — nga mu bino okumanya ky'ayagala Katonda, n'amaanyi ag'okukikola, n'okwewaayo okujjuvu era okw'essanyu okukola ky'ayagala Katonda kyonna, bwe binoonyezebwa ne bikuzibwa, okusoma kwaffe ekigambo kya Katonda n'okusaba kwaffe kunaaleeta omukisa gwakwo ogw'amazima era ogujjuvu.

fields.title: Okuliira ku Kigambo
fields.body_html:
"Ebigambo byo bwe byanzijira, ne mbirya, byali ssanyu era okujaguza kw'omutima gwange." — Yeremiya 15:16.

Wano olina ebintu bisatu. Okuzuula ekigambo kya Katonda. Kino kijjira abo bokka abakinoonya n'obunyiikivu. Oluvannyuma okulya. Kino kitegeeza okwetwalira mu buntu okuli ku bulamu bwaffe, okutwala mu buli bwaffe ebigambo bya Katonda. "Naye Yesu n'amuddamu nti, 'Kyawandiikibwa nti: "Omuntu tabeera mulamu na mmere yokka, wabula na buli kigambo ekiva mu kamwa ka Katonda."'" Matayo 4:4. Oluvannyuma okujaguza, "Obwakabaka obw'omu ggulu bufaanana n'ekyobugagga ekyakwekebwa mu nnimiro omuntu omu bwe yakigwikiriza. Olw'essanyu lye yafuna n'agenda n'atunda bye yalina byonna, n'agula ennimiro eyo." Matayo 13:44. Awo tulina okuzuula, n'okwetwalira, n'okujaguza. "Ebigambo byo bwe byanzijira, ne mbirya, byali ssanyu era okujaguza kw'omutima gwange."

Okulya wano kye kirowoozo ekikulu. Kukulemberwa okunoonya n'okuzuula: kuwerekerwako era kugoberezebwa okujaguza. Kwe kigendererwa kyokka era kye nkozesa y'ekimu; kye nsonga yokka era bwe bulamu bw'ekirala. Mu kyama eky'ekisenge eky'omunda nga bingi ebisinziira ku kino — Nabirya!

Okutegeera enjawulo eri wakati wa kino n'okuzuula ebigambo bya Katonda, geraageranya emmere ey'empeke omuntu gy'ayinza okuba ng'aterese mu tterekero lye, n'omugaati gw'alina ku mmeeza ye. Okutegana kwonna kw'akoze mu kusiga ne mu kukungula ne mu kuterekera empeke ze, empeera yonna eno engagga gy'afunye olw'obwegendereza bwe, tekiyinza kumugasa, okuggyako ng'alya ku mugabo ogwa buli lunaku ogw'omugaati omubiri gwe gwe gwetaaga. Mu kuzuula, mu kukungula ne mu kuterekera, obungi obusingako n'omulimu ogw'amangu — ebyo bye byali ebyokutunuulirwako. Mu kulya, waliwo ekyawukanako ddala — wano bwe bungi obutono, n'okugendera mu maaso okw'empolampola era okutakoma, kwe kuraga okwetwalira.

Olaba engeri kino gye kikwatagana n'okusoma kwo Ekyawandiikibwa mu kiseera eky'oku makya? Weetaaga okuzuula ebigambo bya Katonda, n'olowooza n'obwegendereza obibikkule, olyoke obibeere nabyo nga bitereke mu birowoozo ne mu kujjukira olw'okukozesa kwo, n'essanyu eringi, essanyu ery'amakungula oba ery'obuwanguzi; essanyu ery'obugagga obunywezebbwa, oba obuzibu obuwanguddwa: naye kyenkana wa tusaana okujjukira nti okuzuula kuno n'okuba n'ebigambo bya Katonda tekunnaba kubeera kwe kulya okwo kwokka okuleeta obulamu obw'omu ggulu n'amaanyi eri emmeeme.

Okuba nga weemalidde ku, era ng'olina, empeke ennungi ennamu, tekiriisa muntu. Okuba nga weeyagaza nnyo mu kumanya ekigambo kya Katonda, mu kyo kyokka tekuliisa mmeeme. "Ebigambo byo bwe byanzijira" ekyo kye kyasooka. "Ne mbirya" kwe kwaleeta essanyu n'okujaguza.

Kale okulya kuno kye ki? Empeke omulimi ze yakuza n'azisanyukira ng'eze ye ddala, tezaayinza kuliisa bulamu bwe okutuusa lwe yazitoola n'azirya, n'azigaya ddala, ne zifuuka kitundu kye yennyini, nga ziyingira mu musaayi gwe, nga zizimba amagumba ge n'omubiri gwe. Kino kirina okukolebwa mu bungi obutono ku mulundi gumu, emirundi ebiri oba esatu buli lunaku, buli lunaku olw'omwaka. Lino ly'etteeka ery'okulya. Si nkwatirwa oba obuwanguzi obw'okusoma kwange Baibuli; si kutegeera okweyongera oba okukwata okunene kwe mfuna kwe kunyweza obulamu n'okukula kw'obulamu obw'omwoyo. Nedda n'akatono. Bino byonna emirundi mingi bireka obuntu nga tebutukuzibbwa era nga tebulimu mwoyo, nga bulina ebitono nnyo ku butukuvu oba obwetoowaze bwa Kristo Yesu: waliwo ekirala ekyetaagibwa. Yesu yagamba nti: Emmere yange kwe kukola by'ayagala oyo eyantuma.

Okutoola omugabo omutono ogw'ekigambo kya Katonda, ekiragiro ekimu ekitegeerekeka oba obuvunaanyizibwa obw'obulamu obuggya, n'okikkiriza mu kasirise mu kwagala okw'omutima, n'owaayo obulamu bwo bwonna eri obufuzi bwakyo, n'olayira, mu maanyi ga Mukama Yesu, okukituukiriza: kino, n'oluvannyuma n'ogenda okukikola, kuno kwe kulya ekigambo, okukitwala mu buli bwaffe obw'omunda ennyo, ne kifuuka kitundu ekinywevu eky'obulamu bwaffe ddala. N'ekyo kye kimu ku mazima, oba ku kisuubizo; ekyo ky'olidde kaakano kifuuka kitundu kya ggwe, era okitwala naawe buli gy'ogenda ng'ekitundu ky'obulamu bw'obeera nabwo.

Olaba amangu engeri ensonga ebbiri ez'enjawulo eri wakati w'empeke eri mu tterekero n'omugaati oguli ku mmeeza, gye zibikka ku kusoma kwo Baibuli kwonna. Okukuŋŋaanya okumanya kw'Ebyawandiikibwa kye kimu. Okulya ekigambo kya Katonda, okukiyaniriza mu mutima gwo olw'amaanyi ag'Omwoyo aleeta obulamu, kye kintu ekyawukana nnyo.

Era olaba engeri amateeka gombi ag'okulya emmere, mu njawulo n'ago ag'okugizuula, bwe gasaana okugonderwa bulijjo. Osobola okukuŋŋaanya n'okuterekera empeke okumala emyaka. Toyinza kumira mugaati mungi okumala ennaku. Buli lunaku, era emirundi egisukka ogumu ku lunaku, otoola emmere yo ey'olunaku. Bwe kityo okulya ekigambo kya Katonda kusaanira okuba mu migabo mitono, nga bwe kityo emmeeme buli mulundi bw'esobola okuyaniriza n'okugaya. Era kino, buli lunaku, okuva ku ludda olumu olw'omwaka okutuuka ku lulala.

Kwe kuliira okwo ku kigambo kwe kunaansobozesa okugamba nti: "Ebigambo byo byali ssanyu era okujaguza kw'omutima gwange." George Muller agamba nti yayiga nti teyandekeddemu kusoma Kigambo okutuusa lw'awulira essanyu mu Katonda: olwo n'awulira nga asaanidde okufuluma okugenda ku mulimu gwe ogw'olunaku.

fields.title: Ennaku ez'Okuwummula
fields.body_html:
"Naye mutegeere kino: singa ssemaka amanya essaawa omubbi w'anaayingirira okumenya ennyumba ye, teyandiganyizza mubbi kumuyingirira." — Lukka 12:39.

Mu kwogera ku by'Enjigiriza, Edward Thring agamba nti: "Essaawa ez'okuwummula ez'amaanyi n'emirimu gyazo ze zisinga amaanyi… Ekibuuzo eky'amaanyi eky'essaawa ez'okuwummula kisaanira okuba ekibuuzo ekisingira ddala obukulu, kubanga kwe kukwata ennyo ku mpisa… Essaawa ez'okuwummula ze nfuluma enjigiriza ey'amazima kw'ekyusa." Omuyigiriza ono omukulu mu ssaayansi ey'enjigiriza yali alabye nti empisa ennungi, n'obumu obw'amazima, bye bisooka, n'oluvannyuma lw'ebyo, ng'eky'okubiri, okutendekebwa mu bukugu n'amaanyi. Yali alabye era nti wadde omuyigiriza asobola okukola bingi mu kigambo ne mu bikolwa, olw'okukkiriza okw'oku waggulu n'omulimu ogw'amazima, okuzzaamu amaanyi n'okuluŋŋamya, buli mulenzi kimugwanira okulwanirira empisa ze ye. Era kubanga kiri mu ssaawa ez'okuwummula, ng'ava mu kunyigirizibwa n'okwekaliriza, omulenzi mw'alagira ekyo ekisinga okuba waggulu munda mu ye, kyeyava ayogera ku ssaawa ez'okuwummula ng'ezisinga obukulu era ng'ez'amaanyi, enfuluma enjigiriza ey'amazima kw'ekyusa. Mu ddiini, kino kya mazima nnyo.

Abayizi enkumi n'enkumi bakiwuliddemu, nga tebamanyi ngeri ya kukyogera oba kukinnyonnyola.

Ku ttendekero oba ku ssomero, ekiseera kyabwe eky'oku makya kibadde n'ekifo kyakyo mu ntegeka yaabwe ey'ebiseera. Omutwe gwonna gunywezebwa okukola omulimu ogwa bulijjo era ogutegekeddwa, n'ekiseera eky'okusaba kikuumibwa mu ngeri y'emu ng'eky'omu kibiina oba eky'okwesomera.

Ekiseera eky'okuwummula bwe kituuka, ng'omuntu wa ddembe okukola nga bw'ayagala ddala, bangi bazuula nti ekiseera eky'oku makya n'obumu bwakyo ne Katonda tebwafuuka bwa mpisa nnyo, era bwetaavu bwenkana bw'obulamu obw'omwoyo, era ssanyu, ekyandireme okuziyiza okwesanyusa kwaffe okw'ennaku ez'okuwummula. Ennaku ez'okuwummula zifuuka ekigezo ky'empisa, obukakafu obw'engeri omuntu gy'ayinza okugamba ne Yobu nti, "Ebigambo eby'omu kamwa ke mbikuumye okusinga omugabo gwange ogw'emmere." Ekibuuzo eky'essaawa ez'okuwummula ddala kisinga obukulu. Mu zo nkyukira mu ddembe era mu buntu eri kye njagala okusingira ddala. Mu zo nkakasa era nneeyongera mu maanyi ag'okukwata ekyo kye nnina.

Omuyigiriza ow'oku ssomero eddene mu Amerika kigambibwa nti yagamba nti, "Ekizibu ekisinga obunene kye tulwanagana nakyo bye biwummulo eby'omu biseera eby'ekyeya. Nga bwe tumaze okuleeta omulenzi ku mutindo omulungi ogw'okwegendereza, era ng'agondera ebirungi ebisingayo, ne tumufiirwa, era bw'akomawo oluvannyuma, kitugwanira okutandika ne tukolonga byonna buggya."

Ekiwummulo eky'ekyeya kimunafuya bunafuyi. Ekigambo kino, nga kyogera ku kusoma n'obuvunaanyizibwa obwa bulijjo, kya maanyi: mu nsalo ezimu, tekisingako butakwatagana n'obulamu obw'eddiini.

Okuleka amangu empisa eza bulijjo, n'endowooza enkusike nti eddembe ery'okukola nga bw'oyagala litegeeza essanyu erituukiridde, bizzayo emabega omuyizi omuto mu bulamu bwe obw'Ekikristaayo.

Tewali kifo eky'obwetaavu obusingawo eri ab'ekibiina eky'Abayizi abakulu era ab'obumanyirivu okuyamba n'okukuuma bannaabwe abato okusinga kino. Ebyo ebituukiddwako mu myezi biyinza okubula olw'okulagajjala okw'ewiiki emu. Tetumanyi ssaawa omubbi ky'ajjira. Omwoyo ogw'ekiseera eky'oku makya gutegeeza okwekuuma okutakoma olunaku lwonna era buli lunaku.

Waliwo enkola ez'enjawulo akabi kano, n'obukuumi okuva mu ko, mwe biyinza okuteekebwa mu maaso g'omuyizi. Mu biwummulo tuweebwa eddembe okuva mu mateeka g'essomero ge tubeeramu mu kiseera kye tumalayo. Naye waliwo amateeka amalala: amateeka ag'empisa, n'amateeka ag'obulamu obulungi, ge tetuwummulamu. Omuyizi alabulwe nti okuyitibwa okw'obumu obwa buli lunaku ne Katonda si kwa kika ekyasooka wabula eky'oluvannyuma. Nga bw'ayetaaga buli lunaku mu biwummulo okulya n'okussa, bw'atyo yeetaaga Buli Lunaku Okulya Omugaati n'Okussa Empewo ey'omu Ggulu.

Kikakase nti ekiseera eky'oku makya si buvunaanyizibwa bwokka wabula mukisa ogutayogerekeka n'essanyu. Obumu ne Katonda, okubeera mu Kristo, okwagala Ekigambo, n'okukifumiitirizaako olunaku lwonna — eri obuntu obuggya bino bye bulamu n'amaanyi, obulamu obulungi n'essanyu.

Byetegereze mu ttabaaza eno; kkiriza amaanyi ag'obuntu obuggya obuli munda, era obukolereko; wadde nga tobuwulira, bujja kutuukirira. Kibale nga ssanyu, era kijja kufuuka ssanyu gy'oli.

Okusinga byonna, tegeera nti ensi ekwetaaga era yeesiga ggwe okuba ekitangaala kyayo. Kristo akulindirira ng'oli kitundu ky'omubiri gwe, buli lunaku, okukola omulimu gwe ogw'okulokola ng'ayita mu ggwe. Ye, wadde ensi, wadde ggwe, tewali asobola kufiirwa lunaku na lumu. Katonda yakutonda era n'akununula, alyoke, ng'ayita mu ggwe, aleke ekitangaala kye n'obulamu bwe n'okwagala kwe biryake ku bantu awatali kukoma, nga bw'amulisa ensi n'enjuba.

Weetaaga buli lunaku okubeera mu nkolagana n'ensulo y'ekitangaala kyonna. Toteekateeka kusaba kuwummulako obumu buno mu biseera eby'okuwummula. Newaakubadde okuddayo obutabufuna. Kwate ekiwummulo ng'eky'omuwendo olw'ekiseera eky'enjawulo kye kikuwa okwekenneenya ebyo ebibadde ebweru w'okusoma kwo Baibuli okwa bulijjo. Kwata ekiwummulo kyo ng'eky'omuwendo olw'omukisa ogw'enjawulo ogw'obumu obw'ekirala ne Kitaffe n'Omwana. Mu kifo ky'okuba omutego, mu kifo ky'amaanyi go gonna okumalibwawo mu kukuumibwa buku obutafiirwa kifo, kwata ekiwummulo ng'ekiseera eky'omukisa eky'ekisa n'obuwanguzi ku ggwe wennyini n'ensi, eky'okweyongera okunene okw'ekisa n'amaanyi, eky'okuweebwa omukisa n'okufuulibwa omukisa.

fields.title: Eby'omunda n'Eby'ebweru
fields.body_html:
Basirusiru mmwe! Eyakola ebweru si ye yakola ne munda? — Lukka 11:40.

Buli mwoyo gunoonya okwekolera ekifaananyi oba ekikula omuli obulamu bwagwo mwe buteekebwa. Eby'ebweru kye kiraga eri amaaso obulamu obw'omunda obukisibwe. Eby'ebweru bitera okumanyibwa nga eby'omunda tebinnamanyibwa; era mu byo, eby'omunda bikula ne bituukiriza obulungi bwabyo, ng'omutume bw'ayogera mu 1 Abakkolinso 15:46 nti, "Naye eky'omwoyo si kye kyasooka, wabula eky'omubiri obubiri kye kyasooka, n'oluvannyuma eky'omwoyo ne kijja." Okutegeera n'okukuuma enkolagana entuufu wakati w'eby'omunda n'eby'ebweru kwe kumu ku byama ebisinga obukulu mu bulamu bw'Ekikristaayo.

Singa Adamu mu lusuku lwa Katonda teyawuliriza akemi, okukemebwa kwe kwandivuddemu okutuukiriza kw'obulamu bwe obw'omunda. Ekibi kye n'okuzikirira kwe, n'ensibuko y'ennaku ye yonna, kwe kuba nti yeewaayo mu buyinza bw'ensi eno erabika ey'ebweru. Mu kifo ky'okunoonya essanyu lye mu bulamu obw'omunda obukisibwe obw'omutima omuli ekiragiro kya Katonda mwe kissibwamu ekitiibwa, mu mpisa ez'omunda ez'okwagala n'okukkiriza, ez'okugonda n'okwesiga Katonda, yassa okwegomba kwe ku nsi eyali ebweru we, ku ssanyu ne ku kumanya obulungi n'obubi kwe yandimuwadde.

Eddiini zonna ez'obulimba, okuva ku kusinza ebifaananyi okw'omuswaawo ennyo okutuuka ku kwonoona kw'Ekiyudaaya n'Obukristaayo, zisibuka mu kino nti ekiri ebweru, ekisanyusa eriiso, oba ekisikiriza ebirowoozo, oba ekiwoomera ku lulimi, kitwala ekifo ky'amazima agali munda, ag'amagezi agakwekeddwa mu mutima ne mu bulamu Katonda g'anoonya era g'awa.

Akabonero akasinga obukulu aka Endagaano Empya kwe kuba nti ye ndagaano ey'obulamu obw'omunda. Ekisuubizo eky'endagaano empya kye kino nti, "Nditeeka amateeka gange munda mu bo, era ndigawandiika ku mitima gyabwe." "Era ndibawa omutima omuggya, n'omwoyo omuggya ndiguteeka munda mu mmwe." Ekisuubizo kya Mukama waffe Yesu kye kino nti, "Ku lunaku olwo mulimanya nga Nze ndi mu Kitange, nammwe muli mu Nze, nange ndi mu mmwe." Eddiini eri mu mbeera y'omutima, mu mutima Katonda mw'atumye Omwoyo gw'Omwana we, omutima omuli okwagala kwa Katonda kwe kufukibwa, omwo mwe muzuulibwa obulokozi obw'amazima.

Ekisenge eky'omunda, n'obumu bwakyo obw'ekyama ne Kitaffe, alaba mu kyama, kye kabonero era n'essomero ery'okutendekwa okw'obulamu obw'omunda. Okukozesa okwa buli lunaku okw'amazima era okwesigwa okw'ekisenge eky'omunda kunaafuula obulamu obw'omunda obukisibwe okuba obw'amaanyi era obusanyufu.

Mu byaffe byonna eby'eddiini, akabi akasinga obunene kwe kuwa ebiseera n'omwoyo mungi eri eby'ebweru okusinga amazima ag'omunda. Si bunyiikivu bw'okusoma kwo Ebyawandiikibwa, so si kutera oba okunyiikira kw'okusaba kwo oba ebikolwa ebirungi, bye biraga awatali kubuusabuusa obulamu obw'omwoyo obw'amazima.

Nedda! Kye twetaaga kwe kutegeera nti, nga Katonda bw'ali Mwoyo, bwe kityo waliwo omwoyo munda mu ffe oguyinza okumumanya n'okumusembeza ne gufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi kye, era ne gwetaba mu mpisa ze zennyini ezimuleetera obulamu ng'ali Katonda mu bulungi bwe ne mu kwagala kwe.

Kinywereze mu birowoozo byo nti obulokozi bwaffe bwonna buli mu kubikkulibwa kw'obuntu, obulamu, n'omwoyo gwa Kristo Yesu mu muntu waffe omuggya ow'ebweru n'ow'omunda. Kino kyokka kye kizza obuggya ne kikomyawo obulamu bwa Katonda obwasooka mu mmeeme y'omuntu. Buli gy'olaga, buli ky'okola, ka obe eka oba ebweru mu nnimiro, kola byonna ng'oyagala okwegatta ne Kristo, ng'okoppa empisa ze n'ebyo by'ayagala, era teweegombanga kintu, era tewaayo mwoyo ku kintu kyonna okusinga ekyo ekyongera n'ekikuza omwoyo n'obulamu bwa Kristo mu mmeeme yo, n'okufuula byonna ebiri munda yo okuba mu mpisa ne mu mwoyo gwa Yesu omutukuvu.

Lowooza ku kyobugagga ky'olina munda mu ggwe, Omulokozi w'ensi, Ekigambo kya Katonda eky'emirembe n'emirembe, ekikwekeddwa mu mutima gwo ng'ensigo ey'Obuntu obw'Ekikatonda erimuwangula ekibi n'okufa munda mu ggwe, era eriddamu okuzaala obulamu obw'omu ggulu mu mmeeme yo. Kyuka odde eri omutima gwo, era omutima gwo gulizuula Omulokozi waagwo, Katonda waagwo, mu gwo gwennyini. Tolaba era towulira kintu kya Katonda, kubanga omunoonya ebweru, mu bitabo, mu kkanisa, mu mikolo egy'ebweru; naye eyo toomulabeeyo okutuusa ng'osoose okumusanga mu mutima gwo. Mumunoonyeze mu mutima gwo era tolimunoonya bwereere, kubanga omwo mw'abeera, omwo mwe muli entebe ey'ekitangaala kye n'Omwoyo Omutukuvu gwe.

fields.title: Okuddamu Obuggya okwa Buli Lunaku — Amaanyi Gaakwo
fields.body_html:
Noolwekyo tetuterebuka. Newaakubadde ng'omuntu waffe ow'ebweru afa, omuntu waffe ow'omunda adda buggya buli lunaku. 2 Abakkolinso 4:16.

"Yatulokola, si lwa bikolwa eby'omu butuukirivu bye twakola, wabula olw'okusaasira kwe, mu kunaazibwa okw'okuzaalibwa okw'omulundi ogwokubiri n'okufuulibwa abaggya olwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu." Tito 3:5.

Buli lunaku olw'akakya, obulamu obw'obutonde buddamu obuggya. Ng'enjuba bw'evaayo nate n'ekitangaala kyayo n'ebbugumu, ebimuli bigguka, ennyonyi ziyimba, era obulamu buzuukusibwa era bunywezebwa wonna. Nga bwe tuva mu kuwummula kw'otulo twaffe ne tulya emmere yaffe ey'oku makya, tuwulira nga tufunye amaanyi amaggya olw'emirimu egy'olunaku. Ekisenge eky'omunda kye kaweefube ak'olubeerera akalaga nti obulamu bwaffe obw'omunda nabwo bwetaaga okuddamu obuggya okwa buli lunaku. Olw'okuliisibwa okuggya okuva mu Kigambo kya Katonda, n'obumu obuggya ne Katonda yennyini mu kusaba, amaanyi g'obulamu obw'omwoyo mwe gasobola okukuumibwa ne gakula.

Newaakubadde ng'omuntu waffe ow'ebweru afa, newaakubadde ng'omugugu gw'obulwadde oba okubonaabona, n'okukooya kw'emirimu, n'okwennyamira biyinza okutumalamu amaanyi oba okutunafuya, omuntu ow'omunda ayinza okuddamu obuggya buli lunaku.

Ekiseera eky'akasirise n'ekifo, awamu n'Ekigambo n'okusaba, bye byuma ebireeta okuddamu obuggya. Naye kino kituukirira bwe biba nga eby'okukozesa bino bissibwamu obulamu amaanyi ag'ekikatonda agakolera mu byo. Amaanyi ago gwe Mwoyo Omutukuvu, amaanyi ga Katonda amangi agakolera mu ffe. Okwekenneenya kwaffe ku kisenge eky'omunda n'obulamu obw'omunda bwe kikiikirira kwandibadde kuweebuuka singa tetuwa kifo kyakwo eky'okuddamu obuggya okwa buli lunaku okw'omuntu ow'omunda, kwe kya Mwoyo Omuweereza omuweereza okukola bulijjo. Mu kyawandiikibwa ekya Tito, tuyigirizibwa nti, "Yatulokola, si lwa bikolwa eby'omu butuukirivu bye twakola, wabula olw'okusaasira kwe, mu kunaazibwa okw'okuzaalibwa okw'omulundi ogwokubiri n'okufuulibwa abaggya olwa Mwoyo Mutukuvu." Ebigambo ebyo ebibiri tebyategekebwa kuba kuddiŋŋana.

Okuzaalibwa omulundi ogwokubiri kikolwa kimu kinene, entandikwa y'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo; okuddamu obuggya okw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu mulimu ogugenda mu maaso obutakoma era ogutaliggwaawo. Mu Abaruumi 12:2, tusoma ku kukyusibwa okugenda mu maaso okw'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo, nti kubaawo olw' "okudda obuggya mu birowoozo." Mu Abaefeso 4:22, ekigambo "mwambulemu omuntu ow'edda" kiraga ekikolwa ekikolebwa omulundi gumu ne kimalirira, naye ekigambo "Mufuuke baggya olw'Omwoyo afuga ebirowoozo byammwe" kiraga omulimu ogugenda mu maaso. Bwe kityo ne mu Abakkolosaayi 3:10 tusoma nti, "Ne mwambazibwa omuntu omuggya, nga mufuulibwa abaggya mu kifaananyi ky'oyo eyamutonda, ate ne mu kweyongera okumutegeera." Omwoyo Omuweereza ye gwe tuteekwa okutunuulira, gwe tuyinza okwesiga, olw'okuddamu obuggya okwa buli lunaku okw'omuntu ow'omunda mu kisenge eky'omunda.

Buli kimu, mu kusaba kwaffe okw'ekyama, kyesigamye ku kukuuma kwaffe enkolagana entuufu n'Omuntu ow'okusatu ow'ekitiibwa mu Busatu Obutukuvu, gwe kyokka Kitaffe n'Omwana mwe bayinza okukolera omulimu gwabwe ogw'okwagala okulokola, gwe kyokka Omukristaayo mw'ayinza okukolera omulimu gwe. Enkolagana eyo eyinza okwogerwa mu bigambo bibiri ebyangu ennyo, okukkiriza n'okuweeyo. Okukkiriza. Ebyawandiikibwa bigamba nti, "Katonda yatuma Omwoyo gw'Omwana we mu mitima gyaffe, ng'akoowoola nti, 'Abba, Kitaffe!'"

Omwana wa Katonda, ne yoyo asinga obunafu, ayagala mu kusaba kwe okw'oku makya okuwaayo okusaba okunaasanyusa Kitaffe, era okunaaba omukisa gy'ali, ateekwa okujjukira nti yafuna Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng'omwoyo ogw'okusaba, era nti obuyambi bwe tebuggwaako okutusobozesa okusaba n'amaanyi. Bwe kityo ne ku Kigambo kya Katonda. Olwa Mwoyo Omutukuvu yekka amazima mu makulu gaago ag'ekikatonda ne mu maanyi gaago mwe gasobola okubikkulirwa gye tuli, ne gakola omulimu gwago mu mitima gyaffe. Okuddamu obuggya okwa buli lunaku okw'omuntu ow'omunda mu ssaawa ey'oku makya bwe kuba nga kwa kubaawo, twala ekiseera okufumiitiriza, okusinza, n'okukkiriza n'omutima gwo gwonna nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu waweebwa, nti ali munda mu ggwe, era nti okuyita mu ye Katonda alikola omukisa gw'awa okuyita mu kusaba ne mu Kigambo.

Okuweeyo. Toserebuka nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu ateekwa okuba n'obuyinza bwonna. "Kubanga bonna abaluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo wa Katonda, be baana ba Katonda."

Batambulira mu Mwoyo, so si mu mubiri. Okubeerawo kw'Omwoyo okutanakuwazibwa kwe kuyinza okuwa Ekigambo ekitangaala kyakyo n'amaanyi gaakyo, ne kutukuuma mu bulamu obwo obw'omukisa obw'obwesige ng'obw'omwana n'obugonvu ng'obw'omwana obusanyusa Katonda ennyo.

Katutendereze Katonda olw'ekirabo kino eky'ekitalo, Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu maanyi ge ag'okuddamu obuggya, era katutunuulire n'essanyu eppya n'essuubi ekisenge eky'omunda ng'ekifo omuntu ow'omunda mw'ayinza okuddamu obuggya ddala buli lunaku. Bwe kityo obulamu bunaakuumibwa nga buggya bulijjo; bwe kityo tunaava mu maanyi tugende mu maanyi, bwe kityo tunaabala ebibala bingi, Kitaffe alyoke agulumizibwe.

Obanga bino byonna bya mazima, nga twetaaga nnyo okumanya Omwoyo Omutukuvu obulungi. Nga Omuntu ow'okusatu, gwe mulimu gwe n'obuvunaanyizibwa bwe okutuleetera obulamu bwa Katonda, okwekweka mu buziba bw'obuntu bwaffe ne yeefuula omu naffe, okubikkula omwo Kitaffe n'Omwana, okuba Amaanyi ga Katonda amangi agakolera mu ffe, n'okwefuga obuntu bwaffe bwonna. Asaba kintu kimu kyokka, okugonda okwangu eri obuluŋŋamya bwe. Emmeeme eyeewaayo ddala erisanga mu kuddamu obuggya okwa buli lunaku okw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu ekyama eky'okukula n'amaanyi n'essanyu.

fields.title: Okuddamu Obuggya okwa Buli Lunaku — Ekifaananyi
fields.body_html:
"Temulimbagananga, kubanga mweyambulako omuntu ow'edda n'ebikolwa bye, ne mwambazibwa omuntu omuggya, afuulibwa omuggya mu kumanya ng'ekifaananyi ky'oyo eyamutonda bwe kiri." — Abakkolosaayi 3:9-10.

"Obanga ddala mwamuwulira, era ne muyigirizibwa mu ye ng'amazima bwe gali mu Yesu, mufuuke baggya mu mwoyo gw'ebirowoozo byammwe, era mwambale omuntu omuggya, eyatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda mu butuukirivu ne mu kutukuzibwa okw'amazima." Abaefeso 4:21, 23, 24.

Mu buli kigendererwa, kikulu okuba n'ekiruubirirwa ekinnyonnyoddwa obulungi. Tekimala nti waliwo okutambula n'okugenda mu maaso; twagala okumanya oba okutambula kuli mu kkubo ettuufu, nga tulaga butereevu ku kiruubirirwa; na ddala bwe tuba tukolera wamu n'omulala gwe twesigamiddeko, twetaaga okumanya nti ekigendererwa kyaffe n'ekikye bikwatagana ddala. Okuddamu obuggya kwaffe okwa buli lunaku bwe kuba nga kuli kutuukiriza ekigendererwa kyakwo, twetaaga okumanya bulungi era okunywerera ku ekyo kye kigenderera.

"Mwambadde omuntu omuggya, afuulibwa omuggya mu kumanya." Obulamu obw'Ekikatonda, omulimu gw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu munda mu ffe, si maanyi ga muzibe ng'agali mu butonde. Tuteekwa okuba abakozi awamu ne Katonda; okukolagana kwaffe kuteekwa okuba okw'amagezi era okw'okweyagalira, "Omuntu omuggya afuulibwa omuggya buli lunaku mu kumanya." Waliwo okumanya okw'okutegeera okw'obuntu kwe kuyinza okuggya mu Kigambo, naye ne kubulwamu obulamu n'amaanyi, amazima ag'ennyini n'omuwendo, ebyo okumanya okw'omwoyo kwe kuleeta.

Kuddamu obuggya kw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu kwe kuwa okumanya okw'amazima, okutali mu birowoozo na ndowooza, wabula mu kukombera munda, okwaniriza okulamu ebintu byennyini bye ebigambo n'ebirowoozo bye bifaananyi byabyo byokka. "Mwambadde omuntu omuggya, afuulibwa omuggya mu kumanya." Ka okusoma kwaffe Ebyawandiikibwa kubeere kwa bunyiikivu butya, tewali kumanya kwa mazima kufunibwa okusukka we kutuuka okuddamu obuggya okw'omwoyo kw'ofuna; "okudda obuggya mu mwoyo gw'ebirowoozo," mu bulamu bwakwo ne mu buntu bwakwo obw'omunda, kwokka kwe kuleeta okumanya okw'amazima okw'Ekikatonda.

Kale kaakano kifaananyi ki ekiribikkulirwa okumanya kuno okw'omwoyo, akuva mu kuddamu obuggya ng'ekiruubirirwa kyakwo eky'amazima era ekyokka? Omuntu omuggya afuulibwa omuggya mu kumanya, ng'ekifaananyi ky'oyo eyamutonda bwe kiri — si kirala wabula ekifaananyi, ekifaananyi kya Katonda. Ekyo kye kigendererwa ekimu eky'Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu kuddamu obuggya kwe okwa buli lunaku; ekyo kye kiteekwa okuba ekigendererwa ky'omukkiriza anoonya okuddamu obuggya okwo.

Kino kye kyali ekigendererwa kya Katonda mu kutonda, "Tukole omuntu mu kifaananyi kyaffe, afaanane naffe." Ekitiibwa ekitakoma eky'ebigambo bino nga kirowoozebwako katono nnyo. Si lwa kirala okusinga kino, Katonda kyeyava afuuwa obulamu bwe ye mu muntu, bulyoke buzaale mu muntu ku nsi ekifaananyi ekituukiridde ekya Katonda ali mu ggulu. Mu Kristo, ekifaananyi ekyo ekya Katonda kibikkuliddwa ne kirabika mu ndabika y'omuntu. Twateekebwateekebwa, ne tununulibwa, ne tuyitibwa; era tuyigirizibwa ne tutendekebwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okufaananyizibwa mu kifaananyi ky'Omwana, okuba abakoppa ba Katonda, n'okutambula nga Kristo bwe yatambula. Okuddamu obuggya okwa buli lunaku kuyinza kutya okugenda mu maaso, era okusoma Ebyawandiikibwa n'okusaba okwa buli lunaku kuyinza kutya okugasa, wabula nga tussa omutima gwaffe ku ekyo Katonda kw'assizza ekikye — Omuntu Omuggya Afuulibwa Omuggya Buli Lunaku ng'Ekifaananyi ky'Oyo Eyamutonda bwe Kiri.

Mu kyawandiikibwa ekyokubiri, tulinamu endowooza y'emu eyogeddwa mu ngeri eyawukanako katono. Mufuuke baggya mu mwoyo gw'ebirowoozo byammwe, era mwambale omuntu omuggya, eyatondebwa mu kifaananyi kya Katonda, mu butuukirivu ne mu kutukuzibwa okw'amazima. Obutuukirivu bwe kukyawa kwa Katonda ekibi n'okukuuma ekituufu. Okutukuzibwa kwe kitiibwa kya Katonda ekitayogerekeka, mu kukwatagana okutuukiridde okw'obutuukirivu bwe n'okwagala kwe; okugulumira kwe okutakoma okusinga ekitonde; obumu bwe obutuukiridde n'ekitonde. Obutuukirivu mu muntu bulimu byonna Katonda by'ayagala ku buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe gy'ali oba eri bannaffe; okutukuzibwa kwe nkolagana yaffe ku bwaffe ne ye yennyini. Ng'omuntu omuggya bwe yatondebwa, bw'atyo ateekwa okuddamu obuggya buli lunaku, ng'ekifaananyi kya Katonda bwe kiri, mu butuukirivu ne mu kutukuzibwa okw'amazima. Kino kye kileetera amaanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu okukolera mu ffe, kiryoke kinywezebwe. Kino kye kimulindiza ffe buli lunaku, tulyoke tweweeyo gy'ali, mu kisa kye n'amaanyi ge ag'okuddamu obuggya.

Essaawa ey'oku makya edda buli lunaku ye kiseera eky'okunyweza okuddamu obuggya okwa buli lunaku okw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu mu kifaananyi kya Katonda ng'obutuukirivu n'okutukuzibwa okw'amazima. Nga twetaaga okufumiitiriza n'okusaba okussa omutima ku ekyo Katonda ky'agenderera, n'okufuna okwolesebwa okw'amazima okw'ekisoboka eky'ekitalo: omuntu ow'omunda okuddamu obuggya buli lunaku mu kifaananyi kya Katonda kyennyini, ng'akyusibwa mu kifaananyi kye kimu ng'olw'Omwoyo gwa Mukama. Ggwe omuyizi Omukristaayo!

Tewabanga kigendererwa kirala ekitono okusinga kino, wadde ekimalako okwegomba kwo. Ekifaananyi kya Katonda, obulamu bwa Katonda buli munda mu ggwe. Ekifaananyi kye kiyinza okulabika mu ggwe. Toddemu kwawula Katonda n'ekifaananyi kye; buli asemberera Katonda, na buli amwesiga, kibe kitegeeza kumusanga, mu kifaananyi kye ekikoleddwa munda mu ggwe olw'okuddamu obuggya okw'Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Kino kibe kye kusaba kwo okwa buli lunaku, okuddamu obuggya ng'ekifaananyi ky'oyo eyakutonda bwe kiri.

fields.title: Okudda Obuggya okwa Buli Lunaku — Omuwendo Gwakwo
fields.body_html:
Noolwekyo tetuterebuka; newaakubadde ng’omuntu waffe ow’ebweru afa, naye omuntu waffe ow’omunda adda buggya bulijjo. 2 Abakkolinso 4:16.

“So temwefaananyirizanga ba mirembe gino, naye mukyusibwe olw’okudda obuggya mu birowoozo byammwe, okukakasibwa okusiimibwa kwa Katonda, okusanyusa era okw’amazima.” Abaruumi 12:2.

Si kintu kitono wadde kyangu okuba Omukristaayo omukulwe era ow’amaanyi. Ku ludda lwa Katonda, kitegeeza nti kyagula obulamu bw’Omwana wa Katonda, nti kyetaagisa amaanyi ga Katonda amangi okutonda omuntu ng’omuggya, era nti tewali kisingako okulabirira kwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu okutakoma kwa buli lunaku okusobola okukuuma obulamu obwo.

Ku ludda lw’omuntu, kyetaagisa nti bwe tuyambala omuntu omuggya, omuntu omukadde ateekwa okwambulwa. Empisa zonna, obuyonjo bwonna, n’ebisanyusa byonna eby’obuzaale bwaffe, ebikola obulamu bwe tubaddemu, byonna biteekwa okusuulibwa. Byonna bye tulina olw’okuzaalibwa kwaffe okuva mu Adamu biteekwa okutundibwa, bwe tuba nga twagala okufuna eluulu ey’omuwendo omungi.

Omuntu bw’aba ng’ayagala okugoberera Kristo, ateekwa okwefiiriza, okwetikka omusaalaba gwe, okuleka byonna, n’agoberera Kristo mu kkubo mwe yatambulira. Ateekwa okusuula si kibi kyokka, wabula na buli kintu, ne bwe kiba nga kyetaagisa era nga kya mazima era nga kya muwendo, ekiyinza okufuuka enkola y’ekibi; okuggyamu eriiso, oba okutema omukono. Ateekwa okukyawa obulamu bwe, okububuza, bw’aba ng’ayagala okubeera mu ‘maanyi g’obulamu obutaggwaawo.’ Kintu kya ntiisa, ekisingira ddala okuntiisa okusinga abantu abasinga obungi bwe balowooza, okuba Omukristaayo ow’amazima.

Kino kituufu nnyo ku by’okudda obuggya kw’omuntu ow’omunda kwa buli lunaku. Pawulo akyogerako ng’ekigenderako era nga kirina okusookako okufa kw’omuntu ow’ebweru. Ebbaluwa yonna (2 Abakkolinso) etulaga engeri okussaako kimu n’okubonaabona kwa Kristo, okutuukira ddala ku kufaanana okufa kwe, gye kwali ekyama ky’obulamu bwe obw’amaanyi n’omukisa eri Ekkanisa. Nga tulaga okufa kwa Yesu bulijjo mu mibiri gyaffe, obulamu bwa Yesu bulyoke bulabisibwe mu mibiri gyaffe. Kubanga ffe abalamu tuweebwayo eri okufa olwa Yesu, obulamu bwa Yesu bulyoke bulabisibwe mu mibiri gyaffe. Kale nno okufa kukolera mu ffe, naye obulamu bukolera mu mmwe.

Okufuna okujjuvu okw’obulamu obuli mu Kristo mu bantu baffe, mu mibiri gyaffe, ne mu mulimu gwe tukolera abalala, kwesigamiziddwa ku kussaako kimu kwaffe mu kubonaabona kwe n’okufa kwe. Tewayinza kubaawo kudda buggya kunene okwa muntu ow’omunda awatali kwewaayo, awatali kufa kw’omuntu ow’ebweru.

Okusobola okujjuzibwa eby’omu ggulu, obulamu buteekwa okufulumizibwamu eby’ensi. Tulina amazima ge gamu mu kyawandiikibwa kyaffe eky’okubiri, ‘Mukyusibwe olw’okudda obuggya mu birowoozo byammwe.’ Ennyumba enkadde eyinza okuddibwamu obuggya, ate n’ekyusigala n’endabika yaayo enkadde nnyingi, oba okudda obuggya kuyinza okuba okujjuvu ennyo abantu ne beewuunya nga bagamba nti nkyukakyuka ki eno! Okudda obuggya kw’ebirowoozo olwa Omwoyo Omutukuvu kitegeeza enkyukakyuka enjuvu, engeri ey’enjawulo ddala ey’okulowooza, okusala emisango, n’okusalawo. Ebirowoozo eby’omubiri biwa ekifo ‘okutegeera okw’omwoyo’ (Abakkolosaayi 1:9, 1 Yokaana 5:20). Enkyukakyuka eno tefunibwa okuggyako nga tuwaddeyo byonna eby’obuzaale. ‘So temwefaananyirizanga ba mirembe gino, naye mukyusibwe.’

Olw’obuzaale, tuli ba nsi eno. Bwe tuddibwamu obuggya olw’ekisa, tukyali mu nsi, nga tufugibwa obuyinza obw’enkwe obubuna wonna bwe tutasobola kwewalako.
